m100001.――うぅ、気にするなと言われても！\nわっ、わぁあ！？\n頭撫でられるの、くすぐ: —Ugh, even if you tell me not to worry! Wa—Whoa!? Having my head patted is ticklish…!
m100001.――分かった、逃げ延びよう。\n生きて、反撃の時を待とう。: —Alright, we'll survive and hide. Live, and wait for our chance to strike back.
m100001.――王子、そろそろ戦いの準備はよろしいですか？\nあっ……ソーマさん、アリサさん: —Prince, are you ready for battle? Ah… Soma, Alissa, thank you for tending the scouts and troops earlier.
m100001.……いけない、泣いてる場合じゃないですよね、\n今は皆を逃さないと！\n皆さんこ: ...I can't... this isn't the time to be crying. I have to get everyone out! Everyone, this way! You can escape from the courtyard to the outside!
m100001.……ちっ、来たか魔物め。\nあんたたちは逃げろ！ ここは俺たちが――: ...damn, the monsters have arrived. You all run! We'll hold this spot—
m100001.……もし王子が、ここで命を捨てるつもりなら、\n私も最後まで、王子と一緒に戦いま: …If you're planning to throw yourself away here, Prince, I'll fight alongside you till the end!
m100001.……王城が、英雄王さまの築いたお城が、\n陥ちてしまうなんて……。: …The castle built by the Hero King… falling like this…
m100001.お、王子！？ どうしてここに……！？: Oh, Prince!? Why are you here...!?
m100001.くっ……王子、城壁が破られました！\n次の魔物の群れが来ます！！: Damn… Prince, the walls have been breached! Another horde of monsters is on its way!!
m100001.ぐっ……あんたは……メイドのソーマさんだったか？\nすまない、避難誘導は警備兵の: Ugh... you were... Soma the maid, right? Sorry, evacuation guidance is supposed to be a guard's duty...
m100001.そのための移動経路確保は、\n私たちにまかせてください！\n魔物の少ない道を、先: Leave the route-clearing to us! We'll scout a path with fewer monsters ahead.
m100001.だが、ここを捨てるわけにはいかない。\n今、王宮に救出部隊が向かっているんだ。\: But we can't abandon this place. A rescue team is heading to the palace now. If we give the courtyard to the monsters, we'll lose our escape route.
m100001.は、はいっ！ 無事です！ ぴんぴんしてます！！: Y-yes! I'm fine! I'm in good shape!!
m100001.はぁ……はぁ……っ、\n王子、ここにいたんですね……！: Hah… huff… Prince, you were here all along…!
m100001.はぁ……はぁ……っ！\nま、まだ魔物が向こうから……。: Haa... haa...! But more monsters are coming from over there...
m100001.はっ、私も準備しないと！\n王子、絶対に、私たちの故郷を取り戻しましょうね！: Right, I need to get ready too! Prince, we'll definitely take back our homeland!
m100001.はは……メイドに叱られてたら、\n警備兵を名乗っていられなくなるな……。: Ha... if a maid scolds us, we can't call ourselves guards...
m100001.まずい、反対側の城壁にヒビが……。\nあちらからも魔物が来るぞ！！: This is bad, there's a crack in the opposite wall... monsters are coming from that side too!!
m100001.まだまだ、戦いは続くんですよね……。\n王国と、平和を取り戻すその日まで。: The fighting still goes on, doesn't it… until the day we reclaim the kingdom and peace.
m100001.わがままを言っている場合ではないんです。\nもう、昔とは違うんですよ……？: Now's not the time to be selfish. Things aren't the same as they used to...?
m100001.ソーマ、話は後にしましょう。\nリッチがひるんでいる、今が好機です。: We'll talk later, Soma. The Lich is faltering; now's our chance.
m100001.今日は非番だったので、こんな格好ですけどね。\nさぁ立ってください、ここもすぐに: I'm off duty today, so I'm dressed like this. Now, stand up—this place will become a battlefield soon!
m100001.伝令です！ 王城は完全に占拠されました。\n生き延びた兵は王都の外にて、\n部隊: Messenger! The royal castle has been fully seized. The surviving soldiers are outside the capital, reorganizing, but we don't have many forces that can move…
m100001.全部を選んで、全部を救うなんて、\nそんなわがままが許される状況では――: Trying to save everyone and everything... that's a selfish wish we can't afford right now—
m100001.北の大国からも部隊が派遣されたそうですが、\nおそらく、もう間に合わないかと……: Even troops from the great northern nation were sent, but I doubt they'll make it in time…
m100001.城の外では、政務官のアンナさんが\n各部隊をまとめているはずです。\n王子、どう: Outside the city, Administrator Anna should be rallying the troops. Prince, please—ensure the kingdom's future!
m100001.城壁は突破されましたが、\nまだ城下町方面への突破口は残されています。\n皆で血: The walls have been breached, but there's still a way into the castle-town area. Let's all cut a path forward!
m100001.待て、何だこの音は……。\n破城槌……いや、魔法か……？: Wait, what's that sound... a battering ram... no, magic...?
m100001.必ず、俺が皆の故郷を取り戻す。\n王都を、この世界を、必ず――。: I'll definitely reclaim everyone's homeland. The capital, this world—I'll get it back—
m100001.救出部隊はまだ戻ってこないのか……！\n国王陛下、王妃様……どうか、どうかご無事: The rescue team still hasn't returned...! Your Majesty the King, Queen... please, please be safe...
m100001.激戦続きでしたからね……。\nけれど、そろそろ次の戦いが始まる頃ですので……。: It's been a nonstop battle… but it looks like the next fight is about to start…
m100001.無論、我々もですよ、王子。\nあなたの存在は、我らの最後の希望なのですから。: Of course we're with you, Prince. Your very existence is our last hope.
m100001.王城を脱出したら、\nまずは生き残った部隊との合流を目指しましょう。: Once we escape the castle, we should head straight for the surviving units and regroup.
m100001.王子……わ、わかりました。\nそれなら私が、陛下を探しにいきます！: Prince... I... understand. Then I'll go look for His Majesty!
m100001.王子、いったい何を……。\nまさか、戦うおつもりですか！？: Prince, what on earth are you doing…? You actually intend to fight!?
m100001.王子、どうかあなただけでもお逃げください！\n英雄王の血筋を、ここで絶やすわけに: Prince, please at least get yourself out! We can't let the heroic king's blood line end here!!
m100001.王子、どうして私なんかをかばって……。: Prince, why are you protecting someone like me…?
m100001.王子、傷を癒します。\n走れそうですか……？: Prince, let me heal your wounds. Can you run…?
m100001.王子、微力ながら、背中をお守りします。\n我ら警備部隊、最後の時まで王家に忠誠を: Prince, I'll do my best to protect your back. We, the guard corps, remain loyal to the royal family until the very end!
m100001.王子、王子……？\nあっ、王子が目を覚ましました！: Prince… Prince…? Ah, you've finally woken up!
m100001.王子、私も戦います！\nこれでも弓の心得がありますから！: Prince, I'll fight too! I still know a thing or two about archery!
m100001.王子、肩を貸します。\n急いで王城を脱出しま――: Prince, I'll lend you my shoulder. Let's hurry and get out of the royal castle—
m100001.王子、魔物の攻勢が弱まりました！\n西門から抜けられそうです！: Prince, the monsters' assault is weakening! We should be able to break out through the western gate!
m100001.王子が戦い続ける限り、\n私たちも、必ず付いていきますから！: As long as you keep fighting, Prince, we'll stand by you to the end!
m100001.私たちに支えられて、王城を脱出した時の夢……。\nはっ……あの時は王子に\n無礼: A dream of us escaping the royal castle with everyone's help… Ha… back then I spoke far too disrespectfully to you…
m100001.私もです！\n王子が逃げないのなら、\n皆、ここで命を捨てる覚悟です！: So am I! If you won't run, then we're all prepared to give our lives here!
m100001.英雄王ノ系譜……王国ノ民……。\nスベテ……スベテ死ニ至レ……。: Heroic royal lineage… the kingdom's people… All… all shall die…
m100001.（お城が、王子のお城が燃えて……）: (The castle... the Prince's castle is burning...)

m200566.――いったい何なんだあれ！？\nすっごくデカい神像が動いてたぞ！？: ――What on earth is that!? A massive statue was moving!?
m200566.――こんこんこーん。\nアンブローズ様、もろもろ告知してきましたよー。:
—Knock knock—
Lord Ambrose, I've brought the announcements.
m200566.――なるほど、にわかには信じ難い話ですが……。: I see… it's a hard story to swallow at first glance, but…
m200566.――ばっばーん。\n打開策が、必要かなっ！？\n超有能天才最強美少女エルフ！ ロ: —Bam! A solution, you say? The ultra-talented, genius, strongest beautiful-elf—Royji-sama—is what we need!?
m200566.――必ず、皆が生き残る未来を、この手で掴み取ろう。: —I'll seize a future where everyone survives with my own hands.
m200566.……いえ、あり得る事象です。\nリンネさん、あなたは時間遡行を行ったのではなく、: …No, it's a possible phenomenon. Rinne, you haven't traveled back in time; you've been meddling with causality itself, haven't you?
m200566.……えっと、どうやってここに？\nいまちょうど、物質界にも戻れないし、\n手詰ま: …Um, how did we get here? We were just talking about being stuck—unable to return to the material realm—when…
m200566.……これだけの苦労をして、\n本当に大変な目にあって、それでも\n戦い続けてくれ: After all that hardship, you really went through so much, and you kept fighting, right…?
m200566.……すまぬ、吾の力ではかの神像に抗えぬ。\nこの世界に渡ってきた直後、\nそこま: …Sorry, even my power can't oppose that statue. Right after we arrived in this world, that's as far as I can reach….
m200566.……では、此度の件は、\n兵たちには伝えないでよろしいのですね？: …So, it's fine not to tell the troops about this, right?
m200566.……まぁ、むしろ隠し通す方が難しいかなって。\nリンネは元から、王国の民によく知: …Well, actually keeping it hidden might be harder. Rinne's always been well-known among the kingdom's folk.
m200566.……よいのじゃ。\n王子に、死んでほしくはない。\n仲間となってくれた、汝たちも: …It's fine. I don't want the Prince to die. And you, who have become my comrades, feel the same…
m200566.……リンネさんが提案しなくとも、\n今回の勝利の立役者の皆さんには、\n全員演説: …Even without Rinne's suggestion, I was planning to have everyone who helped secure this victory give a speech.
m200566.……分かりました。\n覚悟を決めているというのなら、協力しましょう。: …Understood. If you're resolved, then let's cooperate.
m200566.……原因は、分かっておる。\n天眼ノ国の者たちが「神」と称する、\n巨大なる彫像: …I know the cause. It's the influence of that massive statue the people of the Land of the Heavenly Eye call a “god”….
m200566.……向こうから入ることはできる、ということ？: …So we can enter from the other side, then?
m200566.……然り。\n因果とは……物事の原因と結果……。\nつまりは、吾の識る運命そのも: …Indeed. Causality… the cause and effect of things… in other words, the very destiny I perceive.
m200566.……王子のダイオージよりも大きかった。\n乱戦になる前に、王子が撤退指示を\n出: …It was even larger than the Prince's Daiōji. If the Prince hadn't ordered a retreat before the melee broke out, we all might have been in danger.
m200566.あの日、あの時に、「リンネ」は生まれたのじゃ……。: That day, at that moment, “Rinne” was born…
m200566.いつもめちゃくちゃな作戦で、\nめちゃくちゃな戦力比で……。\nそれでも、一個一: Always a chaotic strategy, with a wildly mismatched force… Yet we kept stacking up victories, one by one…
m200566.いや、じゃ……。\nあと何度、繰り返そうとも……。: No…! No matter how many times I repeat it…
m200566.うん……王子と一緒に、戦い始めた頃みたい。: Yeah… it feels like when we first started fighting alongside the Prince.
m200566.うん、私も気になってた。: Yeah, I've been wondering about that too.
m200566.うんうん、頑張りたまえ若人よ。\n……じゃ、僕はひきこもりライフに戻るから――: Yeah, yeah, do your best, youngster. …Well, I'm off back to my hermit life—
m200566.えっ、グリムちゃんの作った、\n簡易版の転移魔法で普通にゲートから……？: What, using Grimm-chan's makeshift teleport magic to just walk out of the gate…?
m200566.おそらく、リンネさんが\n王子を中心に因果を書き換え続けたことで、一時的に\nリ: Probably, because Rinne kept rewriting causality centered on the Prince, you temporarily gained the same vision as Rinne.
m200566.ここからは、俺も共にある。: From here on out, I'll be with you too.
m200566.ここに、その力の全てを捧げよう……。\n王子よ……我が唯一の運命よ……。\n必ず: Here, I'll offer all my power... Prince... my one true destiny... May victory be in your hands.
m200566.この命を燃やし尽くそうとも、\n必ず、汝だけでも、生きながらえる未来へ――: Even if I burn this life to ash, I'll ensure that at least you survive…
m200566.されど、その未来に、吾はおらぬ……。: But I won't be there in that future...
m200566.しかし、そんなことを繰り返したら――: But if we keep doing that—
m200566.すまない、待たせてしまった。\nロイジィ姉さま、\n皆びっくりしてるからテンショ: Sorry for keeping you waiting. Royji-nee, everyone's shocked, so please calm down!
m200566.そ、そんなすごいところに立てないっていうか、\nあっ、あのっ、なんで！？ どうし: I-I can't stand on such a… uh, why!? How come—!?
m200566.そこのうさみみローブの女の子、だれ？: Who's that bunny-ear-cloaked girl over there?
m200566.それで、この場所は？\nいったいどこなんだ？: So, where are we? What is this place?
m200566.それでも、吾は……。\n再び汝に会いたいと、言葉を交わしたいと、\nそう、願って: Still, I… I find myself wishing to meet you again, to speak with you once more… Yes, I can't help but hope for that…
m200566.それでもよい。\n運命が吾の消滅を指し示そうとも……。: Still, that's fine. Even if fate points to my disappearance...
m200566.それでも汝はきっと、\n暗闇の中から、吾を再び見つけてくれるはずじゃ。: Even so, I'm sure you'll find me again, even from the darkness.
m200566.それにしても……。\n王子様たちは、あっちで何を話してるんだろ？: Still… what are the Prince and his companions talking about over there?
m200566.そんなに頑張ってくれたのに、\n誰も記憶してないなんて、嫌じゃないですかぁ……。: Even though you worked so hard, nobody remembers—doesn't that bother you?
m200566.ただ、この世界の現状は極めて異質な状態です。\nまるで世界の法則そのものを支配さ: However, the current state of this world is extremely abnormal. It's as if the very laws of the world are being controlled, making even our magical time travel difficult.
m200566.ただ、それだけでは打開策には――: But that alone isn't enough for a solution—
m200566.ではせめて、ぷりやんかも。: Then at least Pri… Priyanka too.
m200566.でも、リンネさんの功績が、\nこのままでは伝わらないのでは……。: But Rinne's achievements might not be recognized like this…
m200566.ならば吾も……。\n決して諦めぬと、たとえひとりの旅路だろうと、\n未来永劫繰り: Then I too… I won't give up, even if I walk this path alone, even if the wheel of fate repeats forever—
m200566.ふっふっふ。\nいつかこういう日が来るかもって思ってたしね！: Heh heh heh. I always thought a day like this might come!
m200566.ふむ……王子の方は？\n王子もこの数回の因果の繰り返しを\n記憶しているんだろう: Hmm… Prince, what about you? You must remember the repetitions of causality we've gone through, right?
m200566.ぷりやんかよ……王国では、\nこういう時……王城にて\n演説を請われるものなのじ: Priyanka… In the kingdom, at times like this, you're expected to give a speech at the royal castle.
m200566.ほんの小さな変化を起こしても、\nその結末は、決して変わらない……。: Even the tiniest shift won't alter the outcome…
m200566.まぁ、あたしたちみたいな異種族は\nここの人たちより下に見られてるんだけど。: Of course, we “other-races” are looked down on even more than the locals here.
m200566.もしかして、ご存知ありませんでした？: Did you perhaps not know about it?
m200566.もちろん。\n王子の窮地を幾度も救ってきたんだから。: Of course. She's saved the Prince from danger countless times.
m200566.よ、よい……褒め称えられては、恥ずかしい……。: Th-thank you… being praised is embarrassing…
m200566.ユージェンちゃんがおだて過ぎるからですよぉ？\n――って、あれ？ どうしたんです: It's because Yuugen-chan is over-praising you, you know? —Wait, what's with this atmosphere?
m200566.リンネが操れる因果は、どのタイミングまでなの？\nすごーく前に遡れるなら、\n王: Rinne, how far back can you control causality? If you can go far enough back, couldn't we just bring the entire kingdom's army here?
m200566.リンネちゃん様が異世界の巨大なる神の結界を破り、\n王子ちゃん様が神殺しの槍を突: It's about the famed kingdom war history where Rinne-chan shattered the massive divine barrier of another world, and Prince-chan drove the God-slayer spear into it—
m200566.世界の法則すら操る神像、ですか……。\nそしてグリムさんの転移も、私たちの時魔術: A god statue that can manipulate the laws of the world, huh…? And that means Grimm's teleportation and our time magic are nullified.
m200566.今回も、勝ち取ろう。\n王子の目指す世界の先を見るために！: Let's win again, to glimpse the world you're aiming for, Prince!
m200566.光り輝く、未来が見える……。: I can see a radiant future...
m200566.吾は流転の刻詠……。\n永劫に繰り返す輪廻であれど、\nその全ての因果を識る者…: I am the Chrono-chant of the flux... Though it's an endless cycle of reincarnation, I know every cause and effect...
m200566.天眼ノ国に潜入したときも思ったけど、\nよくこんなに、市街の抜け道を知ってるね。: When we infiltrated the Land of the Heavenly Eye, I wondered how you knew so many back-alley shortcuts.
m200566.天眼ノ国の……えーっと、\nまぁ、言葉を選んでも仕方ないか。\nいわゆる貧民街っ: It's the… uh, well, no point in beating around the bush. It's basically a slum.
m200566.天眼ノ国は貴族院が何もかもを取り仕切っていて、\n貴族の血を継いでいない人は\n: In the Land of the Heavenly Eye, the Noble Council runs everything, and anyone without noble blood can never reach the city center, no matter how hard they try.
m200566.戦場で、危険な状況下にありながら、\n王国軍を案内してくれた……勇気ある娘じゃ…: She guided the kingdom's troops on the battlefield, even in a dangerous spot… a truly brave girl.
m200566.時の亜神たるクロノシア、時魔術の使い手たるトワたち、\nそれから時の観測が可能な: Chronosia, the demi-god of time, Towa the time-mage, and even I, who can observe time… to think we'd be oblivious to this endless loop…
m200566.王子とリンネさんが言うのなら、間違いないでしょう。\n私たちはすでに、千回近くの: If the Prince and Rinne say so, it must be true. We've already endured nearly a thousand total annihilations and rewound fate that many times.
m200566.王子は、決して負けぬと誓ったのじゃ。: The Prince swore he would never lose.
m200566.王子！ 後は任せたわ！\nあなたの誓いを、この世界に響かせて！: Prince! I'll leave the rest to you! Let your oath echo throughout this world!
m200566.現代の英傑、王子の運命を守護せし\n麗しき刻詠のリンネ様。\n――と、城下では大: The modern hero, protector of the Prince's destiny, the beautiful Chrono-chant Rinne—now a huge hit in the castle town!
m200566.生きることの意味を、価値を、\n生きていくことの喜びを、教えてくれた……。: You taught me the meaning of living, its worth, the joy of continuing…
m200566.皆は吾を、風水士と規定したようじゃ……。\nされど、それは真実にあらず……。: Everyone seems to label me a geomancer... but that isn't the truth...
m200566.神なる像よ、吾は、諦めぬ……。: Divine statue, I will not give up…
m200566.自分たちが何度も死んでいたなんて、\nできれば教えたくないしね。: We'd rather not tell them we kept dying over and over, if we can help it.
m200566.見えているのなら、触れることができるのは道理。\nそうして私たちが全滅する未来を: If you can see it, it's only natural you can try to touch it. So every time we observed a future where we're wiped out, we searched for a way to avoid it and rewrote causality.
m200566.諦めるしか、ないというのか……？: So we have no choice but to give up, huh?
m200566.（あー、被害者を増やそうとしてる……。\n分かるなぁ……すごく分かるなぁ……。\: (Ah, trying to make more victims… I get it… I really get it… Being in the spotlight is scary, huh.)
m200566.（ただ刻を詠み、未来を識るだけでは、\nこの結末を覆すことなど……）: (Just chanting the ages and foreseeing the future won't ever overturn this ending…)
m200566.（なにゆえ……吾には、\nさだめに抗うだけの力がないのじゃ……）: (Why… I have no power to defy destiny…)
m200566.（冷たく、暗い檻の中、\nただ永劫を見つめていた、あの頃……）: (In that cold, dark cage, just staring into eternity, back then…)
m200566.（吾の世界を照らしてくれたのが、\n手を差し伸べてくれたのが、王子じゃった……）: (It was you, Prince, who reached out and lit up my world…)
m200566.（幾度運命を繰り返しても、\nその果てに待つのは、王国の敗北のみ……）: (No matter how many times fate repeats, at the end only the kingdom's defeat awaits…)
m200566.（王子よ、あのとき手を差し伸べるべきは、\n吾ではなかったのかもしれぬ……）: (Prince, perhaps I wasn't the one who should have reached out back then…)

Now, this is the moment—

Prince, let's take that guy down quickly.

Prince!

m300293.――えっ、こ、これを読むんですか？\nは、はい、パレード素敵ですね、華やかですね:
――Eh? I'm supposed to read this?
Y-yes, the parade is wonderful, so vibrant!
So, this is Lady Mary of Suika!♪
m300293.――おお、これが晴れ着というものか。\n東の国のドレス、ということかな？:
――Oh, so this is what a kimono is.

Phew, that concludes the regular talks with the Steel Capital.

――Well, that's fine! But before we start the quiz!
Leone-chan,
why don't you tell everyone what happens if they cheat and pick both?
m300293.――やっぱり、今回も王子の\n夢の中はすごいことになってますね。:
――Just as I thought, things are getting wild
inside the Prince's dreams again.

――Six! Hey, are you listening to me?!
Why did you kill Nine?!
Weren't we comrades?!

――My Lord, forgive me for interrupting your pleasant chat.

circling the perimeter since a moment ago?

――The Mutants, remember?
A technology that strips even Demons of their will
and twists them into hideous, aberrant creatures.
m300293.――敵の中に、ちらりと私が見えたからよ。: ――Because I caught a glimpse of myself among the enemies.
m300293.――旦那ー！！ 王子の旦那ー！！\nたいへんっ！ 大変だよー！！:
――Boss!! Prince Boss!!
It's an emergency! Something terrible has happened!!
m300293.――本場の初詣、ですわね！: ――So, a proper first shrine visit of the year!

……Ah, th-this is bad!

But there's something I really need to tell you.
m400183.ご存知の通り、魔界に充満する瘴気は\n我々物質界の者の能力を半減させる効果があり: As you know, the miasma that fills the Demon Realm halves the abilities of us from the material world. Things work differently here, so please be cautious.
m400183.そうした人々が住んでいる地区ほど、魔王軍による\n『補給』を名目とした略奪が行わ:
In those areas where those people live, the Demon King's army will inevitably conduct raids under the pretext of “supply.”
If anyone resists, it could even turn into a massacre.
m400183.それでは、出撃前に幾つか\n留意事項をご説明させていただきます。: Then, before we set out, let me go over a few points you should keep in mind.
m400183.それではこれより、\n『大討伐ミッション』\n開始いたします！: Then, let's begin the “Grand Hunt Mission”!
m400183.それに、ここで我らが圧勝すれば兵どもはおごる。\nそうなれば、いずれ物質界に侵攻: Besides, if we crush them here, the troops will get cocky. Then, when they later invade the material world, we'll suffer unexpected setbacks from enemies who're fully prepared.
m400183.ふむ……確かにそうだな。\n遠路の行軍で兵卒どもの士気も落ちていることだ。:
Hmm…that makes sense.
The long march has lowered the soldiers' morale.
m400183.ほう……。\n魔王様直属の親衛隊員、竜将クロコともあろう者が\n一兵卒に混じって:
I see…
So the Dragon General Croco, a direct retainer of the Demon Lord himself, wants to mingle among the foot soldiers as a spear-man?
m400183.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんので: Also, note that defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400183.ん？ お、お待ちください！\nまさか、『魔界審判』を行使して\n兵たちの戦力を低:
Huh? W-wait!
Are you planning to use “Demon Realm Judgment” to weaken our troops!?
m400183.ソノ道を阻まんトスル者は誰デアレ、\n我ガ槍ノ一撃で葬ってキタ。\n硬キ鎧をも貫:
Anyone who tries to block that path, I'll bury with a single thrust.
This spear holds the power of lightning, capable of piercing even the toughest armor.
m400183.今回は通常のミッションとは異なり、\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This mission differs from the usual ones; it's a “Grand Hunt Mission.”
m400183.例えライフが0になってもクリアとなりますので、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカ: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and every enemy you've slain will be tallied as your final score.
m400183.兵どもの真価を見極めるためだ。\n人間共に対する有利を解消した程度で敗れるような: To gauge the soldiers' true worth. If we lose simply because we removed the advantage over humans, we'll never be able to conquer their land.
m400183.大討伐ミッションでは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: In a Grand Hunt Mission, the sole objective is to defeat the enemies.
m400183.恐れながら私見を申し上げますと、\n可及的速やかに救援に向かうべきだと存じます。: If I may offer my opinion, I think we should head to the rescue as soon as possible.
m400183.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも、いかに多くの\n敵を倒すかが重要なミッションです。\n:
Rather than minimizing our own losses, the key is to slay as many foes as possible.
Let's do our utmost to bring down as many enemies as we can.
m400183.魔王軍の向かう先がどこなのかはわからない。\nけど、近くの村の住民はみんな怯えて:
We don't know where they're headed, but the nearby villagers are all terrified.
They fear their own homes will be looted by the army.
m400183.魔界に住むのは我々の敵だけではありません。\nグレーテルさんのようなダークエルフ:
The demons aren't the only enemies in the demon realm.
I've heard that many humans are captured and enslaved by Dark Elves like Gretel and by demons.
m400183.魔界への急な遠征となりますので、十分な補給線の\n確保は困難かと。此度の戦いでは: Since this will be a sudden expedition into the Demon Realm, securing a reliable supply line will be difficult. Also, deployment costs won't recover over time in this battle, so be careful.

m400363.『妖怪猫娘よ。決起の時は来たれり。\nあまねく妖怪の力を結集し、再び千鬼夜行を巻: "O youkai cat-girl, the time of uprising has arrived. Let us gather the power of all youkai and stir up the Thousand Night Parade once more. Meet us on the next full moon, in the Eastern lands."
m400363.『追伸\n こたびの夜行には復活を果たした鬼の大将\n 酒呑童子も加われり』: "P.S. This night parade also includes the resurrected demon general, Shuten-doji."
m400363.この手紙の内容によると、たくさんの妖怪が\n東の国を襲撃するらしいです。\nなの: According to the letter, a massive youkai force is set to assault the Eastern lands. So, Prince, let's go protect the people there.
m400363.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないから\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Because the deployment cost won't recover over time, be sure to include anyone with the "Request Reinforcements" skill and a Valkyrie in your sortie team!
m400363.それじゃ王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Then, Prince, let's issue the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400363.それと、今回は急な遠征なので、\n思うように部隊が展開できないんです。: Also, this is a sudden expedition, so we can't deploy our troops as freely as we'd like.
m400363.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的です。: First, the only objective is to destroy the foes.
m400363.もう一つ！ 敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできな: One more thing: defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400363.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life gauge hits zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've defeated is tallied as your battle record.
m400363.今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』です！: This battle is a "Grand Annihilation Mission," where the sole goal is to defeat the enemies!
m400363.傷つくことを恐れずに、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してくださいね。: Don't fear getting hurt—focus on taking down as many monsters as possible.
m400363.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点があるので\n注意して: Grand Annihilation Missions differ from regular missions in several ways, so pay attention.
m400363.実は……、\nつい昨日、私にこんな手紙が届いて……。: Actually… just yesterday, I received a letter like this…
m400363.差出人に妖怪総大将って書いてるんですが、\n私を誰かと勘違いしているのでしょうか: It's signed by the Grand General of the Youkai, but I wonder if they've mistaken me for someone else?
m400363.王子！ 『千鬼夜行』という言葉を知っていますか？: Prince! Have you heard of the "Thousand Night Parade of Demons"?
m400363.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要！: It's more about how many enemies you can slay than minimizing your own casualties.
m400363.集団でさまよう妖怪たちのことを『百鬼夜行』、\nさらに千体もの妖怪が参加するもの: The wandering hordes of youkai are called the "Hundred Night Parade," and when a thousand of them gather, it's known as the "Thousand Night Parade."

m400396.――悪いね王子、時間とってもらって。\n実は昔の知り合いから、不穏な噂を聞いてさ: — Sorry to take up your time, Prince. Actually, I heard some unsettling rumors from an old acquaintance...
m400396.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ人や、ワルキューレを\n出撃メンバーに入れることを忘れ: Make sure to include someone with the “Request Reinforcements” skill and a Valkyrie in your squad.
m400396.あっと、今回は普段よりも大規模な戦いになるから、\nいくつか重要なことを伝えてお: Oh, and this time the battle will be larger than usual, so I need to go over a few important points...
m400396.あとは、ライフが０になってもクリアになって、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウントされ: Even if your life hits zero, the mission still clears, and the number of enemies you've slain counts toward your results.
m400396.えーっと、大討伐ミッションでは、\n『多くの敵を撃破すること』が唯一の目的。: In a Grand Extermination Mission, the sole objective is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400396.おっと、出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も、\nしっかり覚えておいて。: Oh, and remember that your deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400396.このまま見過ごしたら、連中のことだから、\n次はどんな暴挙に出るか分からない……: If we just ignore this, who knows what kind of reckless move they'll pull next... We have to stop them before that happens.
m400396.それから敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできないよ: Also, you won't earn EXP, gold, or drops from the enemies you defeat—I'm not stealing them, I swear!
m400396.それじゃあ王子、頼りにしてるよ。\n『大討伐ミッション』開始だ！: Alright, Prince, I'm counting on you. Let the Grand Extermination Mission begin!
m400396.だから、ま、前みたいに騙したりしないから！\nアンタの力を、アタシに貸してくれな: So, I won't try to trick you like before! Could you lend me your strength?
m400396.だから、傷つくことを恐れるよりも、\n少しでも多くの相手を倒すことを考えた方がい: So, rather than fearing damage, you'd be better off focusing on racking up kills.
m400396.でも、アタシひとりじゃ、\n厳重な『見張り』を突破するのも正直難しい……。: But on my own, breaking through their heavy “watch” is honestly tough.
m400396.どうやら、闇の組織に新たな幹部が台頭して、\nその勢力を急速に伸ばしてるらしいん: Apparently, a new leader is rising within the Dark Organization, and they're rapidly expanding their influence.
m400396.今回の戦いは普段の魔物討伐とは違う、\n『大討伐ミッション』って形になるんだ。: This fight isn't a regular monster hunt; it's a “Grand Extermination Mission.”
m400396.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれが一番重要ってことらしい。: In short, the more foes you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400396.組織でも有力な、\n数字のコードネームを持つ連中も集まって、\nアジトの防衛戦力: Even the high-ranking members with those numeric code names have gathered, and the base's defenses have swelled considerably.
m400396.闇の組織って覚えてる？\nアタシが昔いた闇ギルドの、\n残党たちが作った組織のこ: You remember the Dark Organization, right? The group formed by the remnants of the dark guild I used to belong to.
m400396.闇の組織のアジトは多数の防衛戦力だけじゃなくて、\n遠目の利く見張りがいるはずだ: The Dark Organization's base isn't just packed with defenses; there are long-range sentries too. Keep an eye on troop placement so you don't get spotted.

m400404.――よし、じゃあ教えてやろうか。\nまずあの辺りの海岸だが、海流の影響で、\n満:
—Alright, then I'll tell you.
First, that stretch of coast is heavily affected by currents,
so the tides are extremely violent there.
m400404.おっと、それから出撃コストも時間経過じゃ回復しない。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持:
Oh, and the deployment cost doesn't recover over time.
If you have someone with the ‘Call Reinforcements' skill, or bring the Valkyries along, that should help.
m400404.お前も俺が見込んだ男なら、\n傷つくことを恐れず、\nとにかく魔物をぶっ倒してや: If you're the man I think you are, don't fear getting hurt—just go out there and smash those monsters.
m400404.さぁて、それじゃあ戦場に行こうか王子。\n『大討伐ミッション』開始だぜ？:
Well then, let's head to the battlefield, Prince.
The Grand Extermination Mission begins now?
m400404.さっきまで陸地だった場所が\n今は海に沈んでる、なんてよくあることさ。: Places that were land just a moment ago are now submerged—nothing unusual.
m400404.さて、さっそくだが本題と行こうか。\n――漁村で頻発してる、魔物の襲撃は知ってる:
Alright, let's get straight to the point.
—You've heard about the frequent monster raids on the fishing village?
m400404.それからこいつは、あくまで海賊連中の噂話だが、\n海から這い出てくる魔物ども、ど: And this is just rumor among us pirates, but the monsters that crawl out of the sea don't seem to be just landing on instinct.
m400404.それから何だっけか、ライフが０になってもクリア、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウント: And also, even if your life hits zero you still clear it; the number of foes you defeat counts toward your record.
m400404.だがちょっと待ちな。\n海賊ならではの情報ってやつを、\nこうして持ってきてやっ:
But hold on a sec.
Since I'm bringing you pirate intel like this,
m400404.ははっ、さすがは王子だな。\nもう魔物討伐の準備まで整えているとは。:
Ha, just as I expected of you, Prince.
You've already got preparations for monster extermination in place.
m400404.まさかとは思うが、\n魔王軍が暗躍している可能性もあるだろ？\n注意しておくに越:
It sounds far-fetched, but there's a chance the Demon King's army is pulling strings behind the scenes.
Better to stay on guard.
m400404.よぉ王子。遅かったじゃないか。\nほら、軍議の時間だぜ？:
Yo, Prince. You're late.
Come on, it's time for the council meeting.
m400404.よし、じゃあ改めて出撃準備だな。\n今回の戦いは『大討伐ミッション』って形になる:
Alright, then let's get ready to deploy again.
I've heard from Katie that this battle will be a ‘Grand Extermination Mission.'
m400404.沈まない岩場もあるはずだが、\n兵の配置には気をつけることだ。: There should be some rocky outcrops that stay above water, so be careful where you station your troops.
m400404.漁村の連中が腕利きの傭兵を雇って、\n魔物を討伐してもらおうとしたんだが、\n統: The villagers hired skilled mercenaries to take care of the monsters, but they were overwhelmed by a well-coordinated horde.
m400404.漁村の連中の平和を守るのが最優先だからな、\nとにかく『多くの敵を撃破すること』: Protecting the villagers' peace is top priority, so crushing as many enemies as possible is key.
m400404.ＥＸＰやゴールドも手に入らないが、\n――ハハッ、別に俺達が奪ってるわけじゃない:
You won't get any EXP or gold either—
—Ha ha, it's not like we're stealing it.
I wouldn't chase after petty cash.

m400522.――それから王子よ、どうにもきな臭い噂を耳にした。\nこの件で亜神ディアスが動い: —And Prince, I've caught wind of some pretty nasty rumors. The demi-god Diath might be getting involved because of this! Never let your guard down against unknown threats!
m400522.――ほう、魔王城へ向かうのか。\nかつての戦場に再び立つ戦士、心が踊るなッ！！: ——Oh, heading to the Demon King's Castle, are we? A warrior standing again on the old battlefield—my heart's racing!!
m400522.……これは、激戦になりそうですねぇ。: ...Looks like this'll turn into a fierce battle.
m400522.……ところで、魔王城の財宝は、\nこっそり大胆に盗んじゃってもいいのか？: ...By the way, are we allowed to sneakily and boldly steal the castle's treasure?
m400522.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となりますから、\n敵の討伐を優先し、\n魔王城内: Since "clearing even with zero life" is allowed, prioritize enemy kills and whittle down the castle's forces as much as you can.
m400522.「援軍要請」のスキルを持つ兵や、\nワルキューレのような兵科を\n出撃メンバーに: I'd recommend adding troops with the "Request Reinforcements" skill or units like Valkyries to your deployment roster.
m400522.えぇ、今回は敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を得ることはできないでし: Yeah, I don't think you'll get any EXP, gold, or drops even if you defeat the enemies this time...
m400522.それも抜かりなく♪\nデモシェフ商会の方々が先遣隊として、\n魔界の様子を調査し: We've got it covered♪ The Demochef Trading Company sent a vanguard to scout the demon realm for us!
m400522.ただ城内には、ガリウスを信奉する、\n多数のデーモンが彷徨っているとのことで……: However, the castle is now haunted by countless demons who worship Garius...
m400522.つまりこの戦いは、神の楔捜索隊のため、\n出来るだけ多くの『敵を倒すこと』を\n: So this fight is a mission for the Divine Wedge search team—kill as many enemies as possible!
m400522.ふむ……それで、\n魔王城の現在地は分かっているのか？\n闇雲に魔界に突入するわ: I see... So, do we know its current location? We can't just barge into the demon realm blindly!
m400522.まぁ、知っていたとしても、\n決戦後に回収できたとは思えないが。: Well, even if we knew, I doubt we could retrieve it after the final battle.
m400522.また、今回は特殊な作戦ですから、\n時間経過で出撃コストが回復しません。: Also, this is a special operation—deployment costs won't recover over time.
m400522.むっ……それはすまんなッ！\nしかしまさか、魔王城に神の楔があるとは……！: Hmm... sorry about that! But to think the Demon King's Castle holds the Divine Wedge...!
m400522.ガオレオンさま、声が大きいですよぉっ！\n執務室が壊れちゃいますぅぅ！: Lord Gaoleon, you're being awfully loud! It'll wreck the office!
m400522.同時に、魔王城の調査も兼ねていますから、\n討伐数もすべて記録されていきます。: At the same time, we're also investigating the castle, so every kill will be logged.
m400522.敵が数で押してくるなら、\n全部倒せば良いって話だろ？\n今までやってきた事じゃ: If the enemy's just coming at us in numbers, we just take them all down, right? That's what we've always done.
m400522.決戦後まもなくして、\n魔王城は魔界へ沈んでいってしまいましたからね。: Shortly after the final battle, the Demon King's Castle sank back into the demon realm.
m400522.自軍の被害を怖れるなってことね。\nふふっ、私たちらしくて良いんじゃない？: Don't worry about casualties on our side. Hehe, that's just like us, right?
m400522.連中によれば、魔王城には未だ、\nガリウスを討った時の、三女神の力が残っているら: According to them, the castle still retains the power of the three goddesses from when we defeated Garius. Thanks to that, it's untouched by the realm's miasma.
m400522.魔王城は魔王ガリウスが作り出した要塞だからな……。\n財宝なんてどこにもないと思: The castle's a fortress created by Demon King Garius... I doubt there's any treasure to speak of.

m500215.――あっ、と、突然すみませんっ！\nでもどうしても急ぎお伝えしなければならないこ: —Ah, um, sorry to spring on you like this! But there's something I must tell you urgently!
m500215.――その槍のひと突きが掠めただけで、\n全身は痺れ、痛覚を何倍にも引き上げられ、: —just a single thrust of that spear will numb your whole body, amplify pain manyfold, and make you suffer like hell.
m500215.――魔神アスタロト。\n毒の湿原にいた者の正体は、\n魔神アスタロトに間違いない: —The demon god Astaroth. The ones in the poisonous swamp must be Astaroth, no doubt.
m500215.……これは、聞いていた以上の惨状ですね。: …This is even worse than we heard.
m500215.……つ、つまり、どうにかなった、ということですか？\nもうぬるぬるうねうねは、出: …S-So, does that mean it's over? No more slimy writhing things coming out?
m500215.あれが報告にあった、変異したローパーですね。\n発見した兵士さんの話では、\n獲: That's the mutated roper from the report. According to the soldier who found it, even after it paralyzes its prey it keeps attacking relentlessly.
m500215.あわわわ……大変、大変なんです王子様ぁ！: Ahhh… This is terrible, terrible, Your Highness!
m500215.ここ数日、特定の方角からの\n気の流れが異様に歪んでいた為、\nケイティさんに相: These past few days, the flow of ki from a certain direction has been oddly twisted, so I consulted Katie about it.
m500215.このままでは、伝承にあるとおりに、\nあらゆる地域が\n汚染されてしまうのも時間: At this rate, it'll only be a matter of time before every region gets contaminated, just as the legends say…
m500215.この場所も、つい先日までは\n美しい草原だったんです。\n今は毒の湿原となってし: This place was a beautiful meadow not long ago. Now it's become a poisonous swamp…
m500215.こんなこと、普通の人間や、\n魔物にだって出来ることではありません。: This is something no ordinary human—or even a monster—could do.
m500215.そ、それから、周囲の毒は……えぇと、\n私達風水士にお任せください、王子様……。: A-and, about the surrounding poison… um, leave that to us feng shui masters, Prince… (Ugh, it's so slimy… disgusting)
m500215.そうそう、その調子その調子♪: That's the spirit, that's the spirit♪
m500215.そしてそれは序章に過ぎず、アスタロトが真の力を\n解放せし時、その者がただ過ぎ去: And that's only the prologue; when Astaroth unleashes his true power, that being will simply pass on, while all life around will be infected by poison and vanish.
m500215.その中には『バジリスク』と呼ばれる、\n強力な毒牙に矢刃を通さぬ強固な鱗を備えた: Among them we've confirmed a creature called a “Basilisk”—a dangerous monster with powerful venomous fangs and scales so tough they can't be pierced by arrowheads.
m500215.その文献には、こう書かれていました。\nかの者が振るう大槍からは、\n常に強力な: The text said: from the great spear the being wields, a potent toxin constantly drips—
m500215.どうかそうなる前に、\n王子様の力を貸してください……！！: Please, before that happens, lend us your power, Prince…!!
m500215.ひぁっ……ぬ、ぬるぬるうねうねですぅ！？: Eek… it's all slimy and writhing!?
m500215.ふあぁ……良かったです……。\nでもこの辺りの自然は、\nメチャクチャになっちゃ:
Phew… that's a relief…
But the nature around here is a total mess…
m500215.また、アスタロトの毒に引き寄せられたのか、\n彼の地には毒を好む魔物が\n何体も: Also, perhaps drawn by Astaroth's toxin, many poison-loving monsters have begun gathering in his domain.
m500215.もう、暗くなってちゃだめですよ！\n無事に勝利できたんです、\n自然も皆で取り戻: We can't let it stay dark! We won safely, so let's all work together to bring nature back!

m920098.……いえ、何者であろうと最早関係ありません。\nすでにバステト様の復活の儀は完了: …No, it doesn't matter who you are. The ritual to revive Lady Bastet has already been completed.
