m920098.……こ、コホン。なんでもない。\n兎に角、私の心配なんて必要ないよ。:
……Ahem. It's nothing.
Anyway, you don't need to worry about me.
m920098.……と言いながらポケットに入れたそれは\nさっきの宝箱に入っていた宝石の欠片だな: …and yet you slipped that very fragment from the chest into your pocket, didn't you?
m920098.……なッ！？\n王子、いつの間にサバルさんを\n捕まえていたのですか？: …What!? Prince, when did you manage to catch Saval?
m920098.……へぇ、魔物まで操れるなんて。\n流石は『呪われた宝石』の欠片なだけあるね。\: ???: …Huh, you can even control monsters. No wonder it's a fragment of the “Cursed Gem.” …Well, if it weren't, it wouldn't be fun.
m920098.……まぁ、予告状もなく盗むのは主義じゃない。\n今盗んだものはちゃんと返す、安心: …Well, stealing without a warning isn't my style. I'll return what I just took, so rest assured.
m920098.……む？ 気をつけろ。\n何やら強い呪いの力を感じる。\nこの気配……呪われた宝: …Hm? Be careful. I sense a strong cursed power. That aura… must be the cursed gem's power.
m920098.……もう。\n王子は逃げる貴方を捕まえただけで、\n抱きしめたわけではありません: …Good grief. The Prince only caught you as you were running away; he didn't actually hug you, you know?
m920098.……ダガ、我ヲ永劫ノ眠リカラ\n覚マサセタ功績ハ評価シヨウ……。\n望ミ通リ、目: ……Daga, the deeds that roused me from endless sleep shall be judged… I'll wipe out the vermin before my very eyes!
m920098.……チッ、バステトを抱えて逃げやがった。\nこのピラミッドは奴らの庭だ。\n追い: …Damn, they fled with Bastet in tow. This pyramid is their playground. I don't think a chase will do us any good.
m920098.……ファァ……五月蝿イ小娘ヨノ。\n偉ソウニ指図スルデナイ。: …Faa… noisy little brat. I won't be bossed around by someone so pretentious.
m920098.……モーティマさん、\n貴方が犯人だということはお見通しですよ？: …Mortimer, we already know you're the culprit, you know?
m920098.……モーティマさんの手癖の悪さはともかく、\nバステトを信仰する民たちが有する\: …Regardless of Mortimer's clumsy habits, it's true that we need to gather the gemstone fragments the worshippers of Bastet possess.
m920098.……一体何故そのようなことを。: …Why would anyone do such a thing?
m920098.……力ずくで止めるしかなさそうですね。\n王子、騒ぎを起こしている方々を鎮圧しつ: …It looks like we'll have to stop them by force. Prince, while you subdue the troublemakers, if you get a chance, let's capture Saval.
m920098.……王子達に頼みって言うのは他でもない。\n私の仕事に、ちょっとばかし\n協力を:
…I'm asking you, Prince, because I need a favor.
I was wondering if you could lend a hand with my job.
m920098.……皆さん、準備は良いですか。\n合図に併せて一斉に敵を鎮圧します。: …Everyone, ready? On my signal, we'll take the enemies down all at once.
m920098.……私は天下の大怪盗サバル様さ。\n君達の事は聞かずとも判る、王国軍の人だろう。: …I am Saval, the world's greatest thief. I can tell you're from the kingdom army even without asking.
m920098.『トライアングル・フォーメーション』\n……さぁ覚悟なさい。地獄を見せてあげるわ: “Triangle Formation”… Now brace yourselves. I'll show you hell.
m920098.あぁ。かつてこの地に住む人々を\n守護していたと言われた神、\n『バステト』を信: Ah, yes. The people who worship Bastet, the god said to have once protected the locals here.
m920098.あった。間違いない、呪われた宝石の欠片だ。: Got it. No doubt this is a cursed gem fragment.
m920098.あの獣人のマミーが持つ武器、\n広域への攻撃に秀でてるようにも見えます。\nどう: That beast-mummy's weapon seems geared toward wide-area attacks. Please be careful, Prince.
m920098.あの程度の魔物に捕まってちゃ、\n大怪盗の名折れだよ……それじゃ、\n入口の敵は:
If I get caught by such low-level monsters,
my reputation as the Great Thief would be ruined... Anyway,
I'll leave the entrance enemies to you!
m920098.あらあらぁ。王子達じゃない。ちょうどいいわ、\nこの呪われた宝石の欠片に加え、私: Oh dear, not the Prince and his friends. Perfect timing—this cursed fragment and the power of our sisterly bond will be a great showcase… starting with the third sister!
m920098.ありがとうございます、サバルさん。\n王子、少し休憩してからピラミッドへと\n突: Thank you, Saval. Prince, shall we rest a bit before storming the pyramid? Good work.
m920098.ありがとうございます、サバルさん！\n案内をお願いします！:
Thank you, Saval!
Please lead the way!
m920098.あれが復活したバステト……。\n神だと聞いていましたが、どことなく猫っぽいという: That's the resurrected Bastet… I heard she's a god, but she somehow looks cat-like, almost like a beastfolk.
m920098.あれは……魔物達がピラミッドの入り口を\nまるで封鎖するように……。: That… the monsters are blocking the entrance as if sealing it off.
m920098.あんなノロマな連中に、\nこの私が捕まる訳ないだろう。: There's no way I'd get caught by those slowpokes.
m920098.いででででッ！ わ、わかった、渡す渡す！\n渡すから剣を突きつけねえでくれッ！: I-I get it, I get it! I'll hand it over! Just don't point your sword at me!
m920098.いや、敵が欠片を狙っているのなら……。: No, if the enemies are after the fragment...
m920098.いやぁ、それにしてもさすがだね。\n速さに自信のある者たちが束になっても\nこの: Well, still impressive. Even a bunch of speed-confident folks couldn't catch me, but you did…
m920098.いやぁ～、君たちが予想以上にしぶといから、\n何人かには痺れてもらおうと思ってね: Well, you guys are tougher than I expected, so I thought I'd let a few of you feel the numbness.
m920098.うぅっ……情けない限りだ。\n呪いに対する警戒は完璧だと思っていたんだが。: Ugh… This is pathetic. I thought our vigilance against the curse was flawless.
m920098.うふふ、なんとでも言いなさい。\n……さぁ妹達、帰るわよ。: Heh, say whatever you like. …Come on, sisters, let's go.
m920098.えぇ、次こそは私達が絶対に勝つわよ。\n覚悟しておきなさい、人間達。: Yes, next time we'll definitely win. Be prepared, humans.
m920098.お姉さまでしたら、そのような物だけでなく\nきっとどのような宝石でもお似合いです: If it's for you, sister, not only that piece but any jewel would suit you. You agree, little sister!
m920098.かつて、此の地で栄華を誇った獣人の国があった。\nその国を治めていた強大な力を持: Long ago, this land was home to a proud beastfolk kingdom. The powerful queen who ruled it was worshipped as a god—that's said to be the origin of the Bastet faith.
m920098.くぅ～～っ、言ったわねッ！\n待ちなさいサバル！ 捕まえてその首に\nでっかい猫: Kuu—! I told you! Wait, Saval! I'm going to catch you and put a huge cat bell on your neck!
m920098.くそっ、囲まれちまったか！\nバステトを崇める信者どもと……呪いの宝石の力で\n: Damn, we're surrounded! Looks like there are worshippers of Bastet… and monsters controlled by the cursed gem's power.
m920098.くっ……あの盗人の仲間ですか。\n……ここは退いた方が良さそうですね。: ???: Ugh… those thieves' comrades, huh. …We'd better retreat from here.
m920098.くっ……おのれ！\nいつか必ず雪辱を果たさせていただきますよ！: Damn… you! I'll have my revenge someday!
m920098.くっ……正面突破は難しいですか……！: Damn… a frontal push is impossible…!
m920098.くっそーっ！\n待ちやがれ、この泥棒猫め！: Damn it! Hold still, you thieving cat!
m920098.ぐぉおおおッ！ な、なんじゃこりゃあ！？\nお宝を見たら……目の前ガ、真ッ赤ニ…: Gghhh! Wh-what the—?! When I see treasure… my eyes just… turn blood-red!
m920098.ぐおッ！？\nな、なんだ……急に身体が痺れて……ッ！: Guh! Wh-what... My body suddenly went numb...!
m920098.ぐっ……仲間達を足止めに使うとは。\nなんという卑劣な……！: Ugh… using our comrades as a roadblock. How despicable…!
m920098.こ、こちらガご所望であっタ、\n例のアレでございまス。\nプリンセ……クイーン長: I— I present what you requested, the… that thing. Princess… Your Highness, the Queen's eldest daughter.
m920098.この天下の大怪盗、サバル様がついてれば\n魔物から平和を奪い返す日もそう遠くない: With the world's greatest thief, Saval, on our side, the day we reclaim peace from the monsters isn't far off!
m920098.これでも代々怪盗稼業を営む、\n由緒正しき怪盗一家の現当主、\n小さいからって、:
Even so, I'm the current head of a long-standing line of thieves—our family's reputation runs deep.
Don't think I'm easy just because I'm small.
m920098.こんな所にも大量の魔物が……。: Even here there are hordes of monsters...
m920098.さぁ、ピラミッドはこっちだよ……おおっと？: Here we go, the pyramid's this way… whoa?
m920098.さっきの戦い、近くで見せてもらった。\n腕が立つのは判った……その腕を見込んで\: I saw the fight earlier, from up close. Your skill's clear… Counting on those abilities, I have a favor to ask. Will you lend me your strength?
m920098.さっきの魔物達はずっと遠くに撒いてきた。\n当分は戻ってこれない筈だ、\n今なら: The monsters we just dealt with were sent far away. They shouldn't be able to come back for a while, so I think we can afford to take a short break now.
m920098.さっきまではいなかったのに……\n……そうか、欠片の気配を追って来たのか。:
They weren't here earlier...
...I see, they must've followed the fragment's aura.
m920098.さっき私を追って来た奴、アイツがまさにその\nバステトを信仰してる民なんだが。\:
The guy who was chasing me earlier—he's exactly one of those Bastet worshippers.
They're gathering this right now.
m920098.さて、あの厳重な警備。\n一体どうやって掻い潜ろうか……。: Now, with such tight security… how are we supposed to slip past?
m920098.しかし、それではサバルさんが危険です！: But that puts you in danger, Saval!
m920098.しかし大分荷物が増えてしまったね。\n少し整理しなければ……と、先ほど手に入れた: But my load has gotten a lot heavier. I need to sort it out… Ah, this sword I just obtained—consider it a token of gratitude. Will you take it?
m920098.しまった！ 私としたことが\n警戒を怠ってしまっていた！\n皆、ひとまず逃げるん: Damn it! I let my guard down! Everyone, fall back for now!
m920098.そうだそうだ！\nったく、これだからトーシローは。: That's right, that's right! Geez, this is why Toshiro is such a pain.
m920098.そうですか……ですが、\n無事に戻って来て頂けて本当に何よりです。\nこれでピラ:
Is that so… but
I'm really glad you returned safely.
Now the path to the pyramid is open.
m920098.そうはさせません！\n王子、敵の包囲を突破して\nなんとしても復活の儀を阻止しま: We won't let that happen! Prince, break through the enemy encirclement and stop the ritual at any cost!
m920098.それはそうかもしれませんが……ですが、\n今後あのような無茶はしないと約束してく:
That may be true, but… please promise not to do such reckless things again.
The Prince was worried too. Right, Prince?
m920098.そんな……っ！\n間に合わなかったというのか。: No…! You mean we didn't make it in time.
m920098.そんな、私の剣だったらここに……っ！？\nない、私の剣がありません！！: What? If that's my sword, it should be here…! No, my sword's gone!!
m920098.そんな連中が最近この辺りのピラミッドに入り、\n何やら探しているとの事だ。\n連: Those guys have apparently entered the nearby pyramid recently, searching for something. I wonder what they're up to…
m920098.だから心配なんていらないと……ってこら、\n頭を撫でるな！ み、耳をさわ……ふみ: So there's no need to worry… Hey, don't pat my head! I— I was going to touch your ear… fmyah.
m920098.だが、王子たちが探している宝石の欠片は\n魂を糧に所有者を強化する、\n呪われた: But the gemstone fragment the princes are after is said to be a cursed item that feeds on souls to empower its owner.
m920098.ちょ、ちょ、ちょっと待ってくれ。\n流石にあの警備、正面突破は無謀じゃないか。: Hold on, hold on—wait a sec. That guard is too strong for a frontal assault; it'd be reckless.
m920098.ちょ、ちょっとサバルさん！\n王子にくっつきすぎではないですか？: Hey, Saval! Aren't you getting a bit too cozy with the Prince?
m920098.ちょーっと分が悪いかしらぁ。\n……しょうがないわね、ゴブリン兵たち！: Hmm, this is a bit inconvenient. …Fine then, goblin soldiers!
m920098.ったく……お宝が見つかるかもしれねえっつうから\nついてきたってのに、なんでい、: Damn… they said we might find treasure, so we followed them, and what the hell is this rotten cave?
m920098.ったく、次から次にキリがねーぞ！: Damn it, they just keep coming nonstop!
m920098.っていうわけで、素早さに自信がある\nあたしたちモンクと、任務で王国に来てる\n: So, those of us Monks who are confident in our speed, and the ninjas on a mission in the kingdom, are teaming up for the Saval capture operation!
m920098.ですが、あの様子では当分の間は\nバステトを復活させることはできないでしょう。\: But at that rate, they won't be able to revive Bastet anytime soon. That's a win for us.
m920098.ですが、既に敵が内部に侵入しているとなれば、\n悠長にしている時間はあまりないか: But if the enemy's already inside, we don't have much time to waste.
m920098.な……なんということを！\n神に疑いを向けるとは……許せません！: What… how dare you! To question a god… I cannot forgive this!
m920098.な、なに言ってんだおめえ？\nこの天下の大山賊、モーティマ様が\n呪われた宝石な: Wh-what are you saying, you…? The world's greatest bandit, Mortimer… would never touch a cursed gem—
m920098.なにが怪盗サバルだ！\nアタシの縄張りに盗みの予告状なんか\n送ってきやがって…: What the hell, thief Saval! You sent a theft notice into my territory... Don't you dare!
m920098.なんてこった……。\n信じてなかったわけじゃないけど、\n本当に呪われた宝石の力: What the… I never doubted, but to think she truly rose thanks to the cursed gem's power.
m920098.なッ――宝箱を開けてしまったのか！？\n……うッ……身体ガ、言ウコトヲ聞カナイ…: Wh—did you actually open the chest?! …Ugh… My body won't listen to anything…!
m920098.なッ……あれだけの劣勢を覆すなんて！\n貴方たち、一体何者ですか……？: What… to think you could turn the tide from such a disadvantage! Who are you, exactly…?
m920098.にゃはは、いいっていいって。\nそれに、礼を言わなきゃいけないのは私の方さ。: Nyahaha, it's fine, it's fine. Besides, I'm the one who should be thanking you.
m920098.にゃはは、さすが王子、いい選択だ♪: Nyahaha, as expected of the Prince—good choice!
m920098.にゃはは、一応助けられた事になるのかな？\nありがとう、礼は言っておくよ。\n私: Nyahaha, I guess you could say I was saved, huh? Thanks, I'll at least say thanks. I'm Saval, a beast-man as you can see.
m920098.にゃはは、物分かりが良くて助かるよ。さぁ、\n呪われた宝石が眠るとされるピラミッ: Nyahaha, glad you get it. Alright, the pyramid where the cursed gem sleeps lies ahead. No time to dawdle—let's hurry!
m920098.にゃはは。事情も分からず人助けだなんて、\n噂に名高いお人好しの集団だね……そん: Nyahaha. Helping strangers without even knowing the circumstances—you're the kind of good-hearted group famed in rumors… With that attitude, you'll never notice when someone pulls the rug out from under you.
m920098.にゃはは。私は怪盗だ、\nそいつは無理な相談ってやつかもね。\n……っと、どうや: Nyahaha. I'm a thief, so that might be an impossible request. …Ah, looks like we have a customer.
m920098.にゃははっ、そう言うなら早く捕まえてみなよ。\nまぁ、この天下の大怪盗、サバル様: Nyahaha, if that's the case, try catching me quickly. Well, nobody can keep up with the speed of the world's greatest thief, Saval-sama, right?
m920098.はぁ……。\n済んだことを責めても仕方ありませんが、\n軽率な行動は慎んでくださ: Sigh… There's no point blaming the past, but please be more cautious in the future.
m920098.はぁ。そういう事でしたら……っ！\nこれは、アサルさんの剣では！？: Hah. If that's the case…! That's Asar-san's sword!?
m920098.はぁっ、はぁっ……。\nあーあ、結局捕まえられなかったかぁ。\nさすがは天下の大: Hah, hah... Ah, we never managed to catch them. As expected of the world's greatest thief, even the getaway is top-notch.
m920098.はい……ゴブリン達も、新たな力を\n身に着けていっているようでしたね。: Indeed… the goblins seem to be gaining new powers as well.
m920098.はい、お姉さま！ まずは私が皆さんに\n回復魔法を……！ これで呪われた宝石の呪: Yes, sister! First I'll cast a healing spell on everyone… With that, the curse won't scare us! …Now, second sister!
m920098.はい、ケイティさん。よろしくお願いします！\n……それでは王子、帰還致しましょう: Yes, Katie-san. Thank you! …Well then, Prince, shall we return? Good work, everyone.
m920098.はい、間違いありません！\nお姉さま達でしたら、きっとどのような\n宝石でもお似: Yes, absolutely! If you two, sisters, wear any jewel, it'll look perfect!
m920098.はい。サバルさんが作ってくれたこの好機、\n無駄に出来ません。\n王子、ピラミッ:
Yes. We can't waste this opportunity Saval created.
Prince, let's secure the path to the pyramid!
m920098.はっ！ 既に配備は完了しております！！\nいつでもご指示を頂ければと！: Yes! The deployment's already complete!! Just give the word and we'll move!
m920098.ば、バステト様！？\nそんな……まさか、\n復活の儀が失敗していたというのですか: B-Bastet! No… could it be that the resurrection ritual failed?
m920098.ひとまず入口は確保できました。\nあとは、サバルさんが戻ってくるのを待つだけです:
For now we've secured the entrance.
Now we just wait for Saval to return.
m920098.ひとまず応戦しましょう！\n彼らを正気に戻せるかもしれません。: Let's fight back for now! We might be able to bring them back to their senses.
m920098.ふふ……そろそろお目覚めになります。\n神の再臨を妨げようとした罪過を、\nその: Heh… it's about time you awaken. Let the sin of trying to thwart the god's return be atoned with your own blood.
m920098.ふふ、二人とも正直者ねぇ。ゴブリン博士、\n貴方もよく手に入れてくれたわね。\n: Heh, you two are honest. Doctor, you did well getting this. If you want anything, just say.
m920098.へぇ……これが呪われた宝石の欠片ねぇ。\nふふ、中々綺麗じゃない。私に似合いそう: Hmm… so this is a fragment of the cursed jewel. Heh, it's pretty nice. It would look good on me.
m920098.ほ、本当ですカ！？ そ、それでしたらワタクシ、\n是非とモ作りたい兵器ガございま: R-really? I… if that's the case, I have a weapon I'd love to make, and I need a budget—
m920098.まぁ、完璧な俺がそんな宝石ごときの\n呪いにかかるわけはないが――: Well, perfect as I am, I won't fall for a curse from some mere gemstone—
m920098.まったく、急がば回れって奴だ。焦ってる時こそ、\n落ち着いて活路を見出す事こそが: Seriously, the “haste makes waste” saying… When you're panicking, staying calm and finding a way through is the true thief's…
m920098.まったく、腕はたっても脇が甘すぎるね。\n無防備すぎて、盗んでくれと言ってるよう: Honestly, your skill's impressive but your guard's way too lax. You're practically inviting theft.
m920098.みゃ？ あれはまさか王国軍……？\n……ふぅん、面白そうじゃないか。: ???: Huh? Is that the kingdom's army…? …Hmm, this could be interesting.
m920098.むッ！ 貴方はあの時の……！: ???: Hmph! You're the one from that time…!
m920098.も、モーティマ殿。そう早まりなさるな。\nそのような怪しい宝箱は、えてして\n開: M-Mortimer, hold on. Don't be so hasty. Those shady chests usually trigger a curse the instant you open them—
m920098.やはりピラミッドから来た魔物達でしたか。: So the monsters really did come from the pyramid.
m920098.よくやったわ二人とも。あとは私がゴブリン軍団\n全員の力を引き上げれば……うふふ: Well done, both of you. Now if I boost the power of the entire goblin legion… uhuh. Perfect formation. I'll call it—
m920098.んん～？ なにを言ってるんだい？\n先に抱きしめてきたのは王子だよ、アンにゃ？: Hmm? What are you saying? It was the Prince who gave the first hug, you know, Anna?
m920098.ギャギャー！ \nシニタクナイ！ シニタクナイ！\nイノチガケ！ イノチガケ！:
Gya gya!
Can't die! Can't die!
Life on the line! Life on the line!
m920098.グフッ……ナ、ナンダ、コレハ……。\nチカラガ、抜ケテイク……ッ。: Heh… what… is this? My power… it's draining away…!
m920098.ゴブリン軍団、どうやら連携を強化してきたようですね。\n……まずはあの連携を打ち: It seems the goblin legion has strengthened their coordination. …First, breaking that coordination would be the best move. Prince, please give us calm orders.
m920098.サバルさん、\nこの度は本当にありがとうございました。: Saval, thank you so much for everything.
m920098.サバルさん、ですか。このような場所で何を？\n一体、何故追われていたのですか？: Saval-san, huh? What are you doing in a place like this? Why were you being chased?
m920098.サバルさん、欠片を持ってどこへ……！: Saval, where are you going with the fragment...!
m920098.ハァッ、ハァッ……め、面目ない……。\n正気を失っていたとはいえ、\n味方に危害: Haa… haa… I'm sorry… Even though they lost their minds, I never imagined I'd end up hurting my own allies…
m920098.バステトがどんな奴かなんて知らないが、\n呪いの力で蘇るなんて、どうせろくなもん:
I don't know what kind of being Bastet is, but resurrecting something with a cursed power won't be anything good.
It's a problem you can't just ignore, either.
m920098.バステト様、この邪なる異教徒どもに\n神の裁きをお下しください！\n愚かなる罪人: Lady Bastet, deliver divine judgment upon these heretical sinners! Punish the foolish criminals with eternal torment!
m920098.バステト様を蘇らせる方法は他にもあるはず……！\n総員――退却ッ！: There must be another way to revive Bastet! Everyone—retreat!
m920098.ピラミッドの内部に通じる裏道を見つけた。\nそっち側のほうが、警備は手薄みたいだ: I found a back passage that leads inside the pyramid. The guard's lighter on that side!
m920098.三女の癖にやるじゃない。そして\n次は私が王子達の魔法への抵抗を奪って……と。\: The third sister did well for a start. Next I'll strip the Prince's resistance to magic… and… Sister!
m920098.人間の分際で……覚えてなさい！: Humans think they can… remember this!
m920098.今すぐこの騒ぎを止めてください。\n近隣住民から苦情が出ています。: Please stop this uproar right now. We're getting complaints from the nearby residents.
m920098.今回、王子たちと行動を共にしたことで、\n自分のための盗みが世のために繋がるって: But working together with you, Prince, has shown me that my thievery can actually benefit the world.
m920098.何度も言ってるでしょ。お母様亡き今、私達がクイーン。\nいつまでもプリンセスと思: I've told you many times. Since Mother's gone, we are the queens now. Being called a princess forever is absurd. So that earlier thing… never mind… heh.
m920098.先ほど『ピラミッドに眠る呪われた宝石を狙う』と、\n予告状を出してきたからね。バ: Earlier they sent a warning about targeting the cursed gem sleeping in the pyramid. The Bastet cultists must be scrambling to find the fragments now.
m920098.先ほどの盗みの技、見事なものでした。\nですが、悪用してはいけませんよ？: Your thieving technique just now was splendid. But please don't misuse it, okay?
m920098.各員、戦闘の用意を！\n……見慣れない魔物もいるようですね。\n獣人のマミーでし: Everyone, prepare for battle! …Looks like we've got some unfamiliar monsters. Beast-mummy, perhaps?
m920098.呆気なく盗めて少し退屈してたんだ。\n折角だ、少し遊んでもらおうかな。: ???: I stole it so easily I'm getting bored. Since I'm here, maybe I'll have a little fun.
m920098.呪われた宝石の欠片には、\nマミー達を操る力もあるみたいだったね。\n連中が用意: Looks like those cursed gem fragments can control mummies. So they're basically the gatekeepers they set up.
m920098.報せを聞いて駆けつけてみれば……。\n皆さん、これは一体なんの騒ぎですか！？: When I heard the news and rushed over… Everyone, what on earth is going on!?
m920098.報告にあった『バステト信仰』の者達ですね。: The ones you reported, the followers of the “Bastet faith,” right?
m920098.天下の王子軍様が、怪しい動きを見せてる連中を\n放っておくはずないからね。: The world's prince army wouldn't just ignore anyone acting suspiciously.
m920098.安心するといい、ちょっと痺れさせるだけさ。\nそれに、私の投げナイフに何度も当た: Don't worry, it's just a little tingle. And unless you're so clumsy you keep getting hit by my throwing knives, you won't be paralyzed.
m920098.宝石の欠片の大半は私たちが頂いたからね。\n不完全な状態で復活してたんだろうさ。: We took most of the gem fragments, so she probably revived in an incomplete state.
m920098.少数民族の為情報は少ないが、\n神を絶対視するあまり、\n危険な行動も顧みない奴: Information is scarce since they're a minority, but I've heard they revere the god so absolutely that they'll take dangerous actions without a second thought.
m920098.彼らが呪われた宝石の力を使って\nバステトを復活させてしまわないように、\n呪わ: We must collect those cursed fragments quickly so they can't use their power to resurrect Bastet!
m920098.復活の儀……？\nバステト神を蘇らせる準備が\nすでに整ったというのですか！？: A resurrection ritual…? Does that mean they're already prepared to bring Bastet back!?
m920098.恐らくはピラミッドの方から来たんだろうね。\n欠片を持つ魔物は普段より強力な力を: Probably came from the pyramid. Monsters holding fragments are stronger than usual, draining souls until they eventually fall.
m920098.成程……言われてみれば、\n確かにそうかもしれませんね。: I see… now that you mention it, that does make sense.
m920098.成程、あれが飴と鞭と言うものなのですね。\n……私も、頑張って見習わせて頂きます: I see, that's what they call "carrot and stick." …I'll do my best to learn from you!
m920098.我々も負けてはいられませんね。国に戻り次第、\n更なる鍛錬、仲間との連携強化を図: We can't afford to lose either. Once we return to the country, let's devise new training menus to further hone our skills and strengthen our teamwork.
m920098.断る。いくら王子の命でも、\n主君の領地で盗みを働くような不届き者を\n捨て置く: I refuse. Even if it's the Prince's life, I can't abandon a scoundrel who steals in my lord's lands—my ninja principles won't allow it.
m920098.最初は単に、君たちを利用して\nお目当ての大秘宝を華麗に奪ってやろうとしか\n考: At first I only thought of using you guys to snatch that great treasure…
m920098.果たして中で何が起こっているのか。\n……慎重に進まねばなりませんね。:
I wonder what's happening inside.
…We must proceed cautiously.
m920098.欠片の気配がある以上、\n魔物には勘付かれてしまいますか。: Since there's a fragment's aura, the monsters might've caught on.
m920098.気をつけてください！\nフタの開いた棺からはマミーが現れるようです！: Watch out! It seems a mummy emerges from the opened coffin!
m920098.決まっているだろう？ ただ盗むだけじゃただのこそ泥。\n困難な条件で盗んでこそ、: It's obvious, right? Just stealing makes you a common crook. Only by pulling off a heist under tough conditions does the art of theft truly shine. A real phantom thief issues a warning first!
m920098.流石お姉さまですわ。ゴブリン博士の\n情けなく落ち込んだ顔、たまりませんわ。: As expected of you, sister. That pitiful, dejected look on the doctor's face is just adorable.
m920098.王子、『呪われた宝石の欠片』を集める為、\nどうか私に協力してくれないかな。: Prince, could you help me gather the cursed gem fragments?
m920098.王子、このような所までご足労頂き有難うございます。\n実は最近、この地で怪しい動:
Prince, thank you for coming all the way out here.
Actually, we've recently spotted a suspicious group moving around these parts…
m920098.王子たちが来た途端に、この結果だ。\nその統率力、心底尊敬するよ……王子。\nん: The moment you princes showed up, that's the result. I truly respect your leadership, Prince… ♪ fumiyaa ♪ rub rub rub rub~
m920098.王子もあまりサバルさんを\n甘やかしすぎないでくださいね？\n……それでは、そろ: Prince, please don't spoil Saval too much, okay? …Well then, let's head back to the castle.
m920098.王子達があそこに居た理由には察しがついてる。\n大方、バステトを信仰してる連中の:
I can guess why you princes are over there.
You've probably been tracking those who worship Bastet, right?
m920098.皆、急いでくれ！ 追っ手が来る前に\n呪われた宝石の欠片を盗み出さなくちゃ！\n: Everyone, hurry! Before the pursuers arrive, we have to steal those cursed fragments! …Hm? Who's that over there?
m920098.盗みに入る前には必ず予告状を出すにも関わらず、\n厳重な警備をいともたやすく掻い: Even though she always sends a warning before a heist, she slips past heavy guard with ease and always steals her target—truly a legendary thief.
m920098.目的が判らぬ以上は何も言えませんが、\nピラミッドの中は魔物が蔓延り危険な場所で: Since we don't know their objective, I can't say much, but the inside of the pyramid is overrun with monsters—it's a dangerous place. We can't just leave it be… Hmm, what's that?
m920098.相手は機動力に長けた者ばかり。\n気を抜けばすぐに脇を通り抜けられてしまいます。: Our opponents are all masters of mobility. If we let our guard down, they'll slip right past us. Keep your commands swift.
m920098.神を信仰する連中が躍起になって目指す事なんて、\n大体察しがつくもんだろう……そ: You can pretty much guess what those devout folks are after… yes, the revival of Bastet.
m920098.神出鬼没にして変幻自在の変装の名人。\nその猫のような身のこなしの軽さから、\n: A master of disguise, appearing and disappearing at will. With cat-like agility, she was even called the Black Cat thief.
m920098.私がおとりになって奴らを引き付ける。\n皆は残った敵を頼む。:
I'll act as a decoy and draw them in.
Everyone, take care of the remaining foes.
m920098.私がバステト様復活の儀を執り行います！\n信徒たちはその間、時間を稼ぎなさい！\: I will conduct the ritual to revive Lady Bastet! While the faithful buy us time! Come now, this is the moment our devotion is truly tested!
m920098.私の失敗がなければ……次までには、\nフォーメーションをもっと完璧なものに……。: If it weren't for my mistake… by the next time, I'll make the formation even more perfect…
m920098.私の父様であり師匠だからね、凄いのは当然さ。\n……ま、私だって負けているつもり: My father and master, after all—so of course he's amazing. …Well, I don't intend to lose either.
m920098.私は怪盗だ、何分貴重な道具には目がなくてね。\n私の狙いもその秘宝の欠片……王子:
I'm a thief, and I have an eye for valuable items.
My target is that treasure fragment… so our interests line up, don't they?
m920098.私達が逃げるまで、奴らの足止めをするのよ。\n……もちろん命懸けでね。\n手を抜: Hold them off until we make our escape. …Of course, it's a matter of life and death. If you slack off, I'll kill you later.
m920098.良かった……ご無事だったのですね。\nあれだけの量の魔物、\n逃げ切るには大変だ:
Good... you're safe.
With that many monsters, it must've been tough to get away.
m920098.行ってしまいました……ですが、魔物の大半は\nサバルさんを追って行ったようですね: She's gone... but it seems most of the monsters chased after Saval.
m920098.襲われてる理由は判りませんが、\nこのまま見過ごす訳にも参りませんね。\nそこの: I don't know why they're being attacked, but we can't just ignore it. You there, hurry over here!
m920098.見りゃわかるだろ？\nあのサバルとかっていう生意気な泥棒猫を\nとっ捕まえてやろ: Can't you see? They're trying to catch that cheeky thief cat, Saval!
m920098.逃がすものですか！\n皆の者、行きなさい！\n神の復活を妨げる愚か者どもを排除す: Escape them? No! Everyone, advance! Eliminate those fools who would hinder the god's resurrection!
m920098.長いこと怪盗をやっていて、\nこれほど気分が良くなったのは初めてさ！: After years of being a phantom thief, I've never felt this good!
m920098.長い年月でバラバラになってしまったようだが、\n欠片となってもその呪いの力は健在:
It's been shattered over the ages, but even as fragments the curse remains strong.
That's why they're scavenging the pyramid.
m920098.陣形が崩れました……今が好機！: The formation's collapsed… this is our chance!
m920098.魔物を操ってる者……あの恰好間違いない。\nどうやらバステト信仰の民のようだな。: Someone controlling monsters… that outfit is unmistakable. Looks like they're followers of the Bastet faith.
m920098.魔物達が溢れでてくるとは……ピラミッドの中で、\n何かが起こっているという事でし: Monsters pouring out… That means something's happening inside the pyramid.

m920102.――あ、初めて見る蝶だ♪: Oh, a butterfly I've never seen before♪
m920102.――おい、君たち。\nもう少し私の指揮に従ってくれてもよかったんじゃないか？:
Hey, you all.
You could've followed my commands a bit more, you know?
m920102.――きゃっ！？ \nだ、誰？ どうして武器を向けるのですか？: —Kya! Who—who are you? Why are you pointing a weapon at me?
m920102.――って、キョンシーである貴方が考えたわけね？\n意志のあるキョンシー、ね……ふ: —so that was you, a Jiangshi, coming up with that? A Jiangshi with a will… how amusing♪
m920102.――と同時に、その大望の実現を妨げていた\n憎き王子どもを抹殺するためでもあった: —and also to eliminate that detested Prince who was standing in the way of our grand ambition.
m920102.――なッ！？ あ、あの輝きは……ッ！？\nまさか……あやつも以前屍解仙が言ってお:
—What!?
That flash…!?
No way… could it be… the very vessel the Corpse-Breaking Immortal spoke of,
that summons the all-piercing heavenly thunder!?
m920102.――グフフ……当然よ。\nこの地には死者しかおらぬのだからなァ。:
???: —Guff… of course.
Only the dead remain in this place, you know.
m920102.――人？ カッカッカ、笑わせるわい。\n術によって仮初の命を与えられた死体の分際:
People? Kakkakka, you're funny.
A corpse given a fleeting life by magic—how dare it claim anything.
Jiangshi are nothing but slaves, tools of us evil immortals.
m920102.――報告！ 上空に多数の敵影を確認！ \n飛行する魔物の群れのようです。:
――Report! We've spotted numerous enemy silhouettes in the sky!
It looks like a flock of flying monsters.
m920102.――探したぞ、意志を持つキョンシーよ。\nしかし、なぜ王子たちと共におるのじゃ？:
――I've found you, will-bearing jiangshi.
But why are you with the princes?
m920102.――敵わぬと見るや逃げの一手か。\n手慣れたものだな、屍解仙よ？:
――Seeing you can't win, you choose to flee.
Quite practiced, Shikai-sen, isn't it?
m920102.――王子、あれを！\n報告にあったとおり、巨大なキョンシーたちが\n隊を成して町:
—Prince, look!
Just as the report said, massive jiangshi are forming squads and tearing the town apart!
m920102.…………え、私ですか？\nその……私になにか御用でしょうか？: ………eh, me? Um… do you need something from me?
m920102.…………ですが……ッ、\n貴方の下僕になど……断じてなるものですかッ！！:
…but…!
I will never become your servant!!
m920102.…………なるほど。確かに私の記憶が戻れば、\n私をキョンシーにした邪仙の企みにつ: ………I see. Indeed, if my memories return, I might learn something about the evil immortal's plot that turned me into a jiangshi…
m920102.……あ、来た来た。\nみんなー、こっちこっちー。: …Ah, here they are. Everyone—over here, over here.
m920102.……ありがとうございます、王子様。\n貴方という光が道を照らしてくださっている限: …Thank you, Prince. As long as your light continues to illuminate the way, I shall never lose my direction again!
m920102.……ありがとうございます、王子様。記憶が蘇った\n暁には、必ずや御恩に報いさせて:
…Thank you, Your Highness. When my memory returns at dawn, I will surely repay your kindness.
Until then, please lend me your strength.
m920102.……うん、完璧です。\n気の乱れを抑える呼吸法は習得できたみたいですね。\nあと: …Good, perfect. It seems you've mastered the breathing method that steadies your ki. Now it's just training until you can wield it in real combat!
m920102.……え、一緒にその地を探してくださるのですか？\nそんな……そのようなお手間をお:
…Eh? You'll help me search for that land?
That… I can't possibly trouble you with something like that…
m920102.……おい、フェイ。\n言われた通りに風水羅盤に従ったら\n危険な道に来てしまった:
…Hey, Fei.
Following the compass the way you said got us into a dangerous path, didn't it?
m920102.……けれど、信じていただけないかもしれませんが、\n実は私……あの夜のことはほと: …But you might not believe me, and actually… I barely remember anything about that night.
m920102.……さぁて。\n相手が我らが仇敵、王子どもと判った以上、\n力試しなどという手ぬ:
…Well then.
Now that we know the opponent is that Prince, I won't waste time with a petty test of strength.
m920102.……そ、そうですよ！\n王子様の周りには元々変わった人が多いですから、\nキョン:
…Y-yes, that's right!
There are always eccentric folks around the Prince, so being a jiangshi doesn't matter.
m920102.……だが、ただでは逃さぬ。\n我ら邪仙の品格を卑しめてくれたお前に、\nこの私が:
…but I won't let you go that easily.
For the one who dared disgrace the dignity of us evil immortals,
I'll deal you a personal punishment… right now!
m920102.……って、あれ……？\nそんな……砂の壁みたいなものに\n矢が阻まれてしまいまし: …Wait, what? My arrow got stopped by that sand wall…
m920102.……って、なんでこっちを見るのぉ？\nメイリンが乗ってるのは、猫じゃなくて妖虎だ: …Wait, why are you looking at me? I'm riding a demon tiger, not a cat!
m920102.……っていうか、ひょっとしてあなた\nキョンシーなのに意志があるの？\n邪仙の妖: …Or rather, could it be you have a will despite being a jiangshi? Escaped the evil immortal's control?
m920102.……ですが、おかげさまで我が故郷を\n邪仙たちの手から解放することができました。:
…But thanks to you, I've freed my homeland
from the clutches of the evil immortals.
m920102.……ですが、意志でしたら確かにあります。\n私にはどうしても行かなければならない: …But if you mean will, I do have one. There's a place I must go… ugh…!
m920102.……なにか深い事情がおありのようです。\nひとまず安全な場所へお連れし、\nそこ: …It seems you have a deep backstory. Let's get you to a safe place and hear your story.
m920102.……なんとか退治できましたね。\n皆さん、お疲れ様でした。:
…We managed to take care of them somehow.
Everyone, good work.
m920102.……はい。お願いいたします。\n知りたいのです……仮初のものとはいえ、\n私がこ:
…Yes. Please.
I want to know… even if it's only temporary,
the meaning of my continued will…
m920102.……ふぅ。ありがとうございます、皆様。\nおかげさまで力を制御するコツを掴めたよ:
…Phew. Thank you, everyone.
Thanks to you, I think I've finally got the hang of controlling my power.
m920102.……ふぅ。いい特訓になりました。\nお二人とも、ご協力ありがとうございます。: …Phew. That was a good training session. Thank you both for your help.
m920102.……ふぅ。なんとか撃退できましたね。: …Phew. We managed to drive them off.
m920102.……やれやれ、ランファも大概変わり者だね。\nまぁ、そこが面白いんだけどさ。:
…Good grief, Lan-Fa's quite the oddball.
Well, that's what makes it fun.
m920102.……よし、と。この紙にとある土地の名を書いた。\nその地へ向かうがいい。そこです:
…Alright. I've written a certain place on this paper—
head there, and you'll see everything…
m920102.……アリス、大丈夫？\n表情が固まっちゃってるよ？:
…Alice, are you okay?
Your face looks all stiff.
m920102.……キョンシー？ 邪仙？ \nあの、仰ることの意味がよくわからないのですが……。: …Jiangshi? Evil immortal? I… don't really get what you're saying…
m920102.……メイリン、メイリン……。\n大きい猫……ワタシも乗っていいカ？:
…Meiling, Meiling…
Big cat… can I ride it too?
m920102.……大丈夫です。\nこれは後ろ向きな感情と決別するための涙ですから。:
…It's okay.
These tears are just me saying goodbye to the past.
m920102.……敵の撤退を確認。\nあと一歩、尊天君を討つには至りませんでしたね……。:
…Enemy retreat confirmed.
We fell just short of delivering the final blow to Sonten…
m920102.……本当に、それだけの理由で\nキョンシーである私にご協力いただけるのですか？: …Really, would you aid a jiangshi like me for just that reason?
m920102.……申し訳ありません。\n恐縮ですが、まだなんとも……。:
…I'm sorry.
I'm afraid I still can't say.
m920102.……皆様が仰っていた通り、\n私はキョンシーとなってしまったようですね。\n自分:
…As everyone has said, it seems I've become a jiangshi.
Admitting that I'm already dead is painful, but…
m920102.……確かに、私がキョンシーであることは事実。\nけれど私は失敗作でも、貴方の下僕:
…It's true, I am a Jiangshi.
But I'm neither a failure nor your servant.
m920102.……華の国の邪仙たちは、未だに私のような\nキョンシーを作り出し続けているらしい: …It seems the evil immortals of the Flower Nation are still creating Jiangshi like me.
m920102.……覚えておれ。\n此度は不覚を取ったが、\n再び相まみえた時は骨まで砕いてくれ:
…Remember this.
I was caught off guard this time,
but the next we meet, I'll crush you to the bone!!
m920102.あ、ぐぅッ……！\nはぁ、はぁっ……わ、私は……っ。\n……私、ハ…………キョン:
Ah, ugh…!
Hah, hah… I… I…
…I… am… a Jiangshi…!
m920102.あ、貴方は……う……ぐぅッ！\nあぁッ……い、たい……頭が、割れ……ッああッ！！: Ah, you… ugh! Ah… my head… it's splitting… Ahhh!!
m920102.あたしの風水羅盤が\n大体の行き先を指し示してくれるから。\nあとはその通りに進:
My feng shui compass will point us toward the general destination.
All we have to do is follow it.
m920102.あたしもそう思う。聞いたことない？\n一部のキョンシーは危機にさらされると\n身: I think so too. Haven't you heard? Some jiangshi fight back when they're in danger to protect themselves.
m920102.あの恰好は――間違いない、キョンシーだよ！\nほら、顔にお札が貼ってあるでしょ？:
That outfit—no doubt, it's a jiangshi! 
Look, there's a talisman on its face, right?
m920102.あの砂の壁には剣や術での攻撃がほとんど効きません。\nそのうえ、近づいた者は彼の: That sand wall is virtually immune to swords or spells. And anyone who gets close gets shredded by the sand swirling around him…
m920102.あはは、どういたしまして。\nこっちも久しぶりにいい訓練になったよ。: Ahaha, you're welcome. It was a solid training for me too, after a while.
m920102.あははははッ！\n流石は屍解仙、いい声で鳴くではないか。:
Ahahaha!
As expected of Shikai-sen, you've got quite the scream.
m920102.あら、いいじゃない？\nちょっとしたスキンシップよ。ね、ダーリン♪: Oh, come on, it's fine. Just a little skin-contact, darling♪
m920102.あらためまして、私はランファと申します。\n先日は皆様を襲ってしまったようで、\:
Allow me to introduce myself properly—my name is Lan-Fa.
I'm truly sorry for having attacked everyone the other day.
m920102.ありがとうございます、アリスさん。\n他の皆さんも、お集まり頂き感謝いたします。: Thank you, Alice. And thank you all for gathering here.
m920102.ありがとうございます、皆様。\nキョンシーであるばかりか、あまつさえ皆様に\n危:
Thank you, everyone.
Not only am I a jiangshi, but you've even helped the one who has harmed you…
m920102.あれは……！ 皆様、離れてください！\n私たち――この地に住む住人たちは、\n尊: That…! Everyone, get back! We… the residents of this land were annihilated by Sonten's technique!
m920102.い――イヤぁあああッ！！\nやめて……それ以上言わないでぇッ！！: N-no!! Stop… don't say any more!!
m920102.いいのよ、愛するダーリンのためだもの♪\nそれに、対アンデッドの特訓をするには\: It's nothing, darling—it's for my beloved.♪ Besides, training against the undead needs the power of us necromancers.
m920102.いいわ、そういうことなら一肌脱いであげる。\nよろしくね、ダーリン♪: Fine then, I'll lend a hand. Looking forward to it, darling♪
m920102.いえ、お気になさらないでください。\nそれでは、引き続き手がかりを探していきまし:
No, please don't worry.
Then let's keep searching for clues.
m920102.いずれにせよ、屍解仙ら邪仙たちは\n東の国の支配をますます本格的に\n推し進めよ: Either way, those evil sages are pushing the conquest of the eastern lands more aggressively…
m920102.うぅ……ここはどこ？ 私は……誰？: Ugh… where am I? Who… am I?
m920102.うぅッ……なぜか……急に、頭が……ぅあぁッ！: Ugh… why… suddenly my head… aah!
m920102.うおッ！？ お、おい、見たかよ？\nあのアマ、袖ン中に暗器を隠してやがるぜ！: Whoa! Hey, did you see that? That dame's got a hidden weapon up her sleeve!
m920102.うげっ！？ 大変だよ王子、逃げようよ！\n金光聖菩っていったら十天君の中でも\n:
Ugh!? This is bad, Prince, we gotta run!
Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu is famous for being insanely powerful even among the Ten Heavens!
m920102.うん、ぼくも応援してるよ。\nもうすぐ王子たちが到着するはずだから、\n存分に手: Yeah, I'm cheering you on. The princes should be arriving soon, so you can spar with them and get a feel for things.
m920102.うーん……華の国は広いですから、\n闇雲に探すのは得策じゃなさそうですね。: Hmm… The Land of Flowers is vast, so searching blindly doesn't seem wise.
m920102.え、ええと……。\n蝶を見ながら猫の真似をしつつ、\n呼吸を整えてヘレナさんの指: Um, so… I watch butterflies, imitate a cat, steady my breathing, and follow your orders, Helena?
m920102.え、ええと……。\n蝶を見ながら猫の真似をすればいいのですね？: Uh, um… so I should imitate a cat while watching butterflies?
m920102.ええ、そのための修業ですから。\n初めて皆様とお会いした時の二の舞いにならぬよう: Yes, that's what this training is for. I'll do my best not to lose control and repeat the fiasco from when we first met.
m920102.ええ。そのためにも今後は、\n邪仙たちの動向により警戒を強めていきましょう。: Yes. That's why we need to keep a closer watch on the evil sages' movements from now on.
m920102.お……お断りしますっ！\n私は、その……物ではありませんので。: I… I refuse! I'm not… that kind of thing.
m920102.お、おやめください！\nどうか、どうか御慈悲を…………うっ……！: P-please stop! I beg you, have mercy… ugh…!
m920102.お、お待ちください！ \n私について知っていることをお教えください！\n私は……:
P-please wait! 
Tell me what you know about me!
Who… who am I, anyway?
m920102.お、お気になさらないでください。\n先日の一件は、確認もせずに貴方を\n危険だと:
P-please don't worry.
We're at fault too, since we jumped to conclusions and labeled you dangerous without confirming.
m920102.お前は――屍解仙！？\nまさか、ランファさんをキョンシーにしたのは……。:
You… are Shikai-sen!?
No way, you're the one who turned Lan-Fa into a jiangshi…
m920102.ぐ、ぅうっ……思い、出しました……ッ！\n許さない、尊天君……このッ――人殺しぃ: Guh… I… remembered…! I won't forgive you, Sonten… you murderer!!
m920102.ぐがぁああアッ！！ し、失敗作めぇッ！！\nキョンシーの分際で……主に逆らうとは:
Ggghaa!! You worthless failure!!
A Jiangshi daring to defy its master…!!
m920102.ぐぬぅッ……つ、つけあがるな！！\n禍血陣が破られる前にうぬを討てばよいことだ！:
Grr… don't get cocky!!
If we take you down before the cursed-blood formation breaks, that's all we need!
m920102.こ……ここです！ 思い出しました！\nこの地は私が生まれ育った故郷です！: Th…this! I remember! This is my hometown!
m920102.このランファ、\n感涙で袖が濡れっぱなしです……ぐすん。: My sleeves are soaked with tears… sob.
m920102.ご存知の通り、キョンシーとは死んだ人間が\n華の国の邪仙たちが得意とする妖術によ: As you know, a jiangshi is a dead person controlled by the dark sorcery favored by the evil immortals of the Land of Flowers.
m920102.さぁ……認めるのだ。\n自分はキョンシーであり、\n尊天君様の忠実なる下僕である:
Come now… admit it.
You are a Jiangshi,
and a loyal servant of Sonten!
m920102.させません！\n王子、ランファさんを援護いたしましょう！:
I won't let that happen!
Prince, let me cover Lan-Fa!
m920102.されば、大人しく主に従うだけのキョンシーに戻れ。\n意志のない道具に戻れば、辛い: So return to being an obedient Jiangshi. Shed your will, become a simple instrument, and you can forget the painful past. You won't even feel the horror playing out before you.
m920102.しかし、巨大化したキョンシーですか……。\nまた厄介な敵が増えてしまいましたね。:
But giant jiangshi…
We've got another troublesome foe.
m920102.す、好きって……ひっ！？\nあ、あの……お顔が近すぎでは……？: L-like that… huh!? Um, aren't you getting a bit too close…?
m920102.すんすん……皆さん、本当にいい人たちばかりで……。: Sigh… Everyone really is just wonderful people…
m920102.そう……その調子ですよ、ランファさん。\nそのままゆっくり、おへそのあたりに\n: That's right… keep it up, Lan-Fa. Just keep your focus around your navel and steady your breathing…
m920102.そして、そやつらを大勢詰めさせた以上、\n此の地の陥落など時間の問題に過ぎん。: And now that I've gathered so many of them, the fall of this land is only a matter of time.
m920102.その仇敵をわざわざ我が本拠に連れてきてくれるとは。\nおかげでこちらから攻め込む: Bringing that rival to my stronghold yourself saves me the trouble of having to launch an invasion.
m920102.その口振り……私についてなにかご存知なのですね？\n教えてください。どんな些細な:
Such words… you seem to know something about me?
Please tell me. Anything, no matter how trivial.
m920102.その地に行くことさえできれば、\n失った記憶を取り戻せる……そんな気がしています: If I could just get to that land, I feel I could regain my lost memories…
m920102.その通り。わしの道具の分際で\n半端な自我などを保ち続けるから、\n此度のような: Exactly. Because you, a mere tool, kept clinging to a half-baked sense of self, you caused this tragedy.
m920102.その邪仙から邪な使命を受けている可能性があります。\n発見でき次第、真偽を確認い: They may have received a nefarious mission from those evil immortals. Once we locate her, we'll verify the truth.
m920102.それじゃあ、そろそろ始めるよ～。\nあ、そういえばこのあたりにいた魔物も\n呼び: Alright, let's get started~. Oh, by the way, it looks like we also attracted some monsters nearby, so watch out.
m920102.それに、此の地に住まう者共は\n既にキョンシーの素材とすべく死体にさせてもらった: Besides, the locals have already been turned into corpses for jiangshi material. You've seen it with your own eyes, haven't you?
m920102.そんな……いつのまにか消えてしまわれました。\n折角お礼を申し上げようと思いまし: …What…? He disappeared before I could even thank him properly…
m920102.だ、大丈夫？\nなんか、ものすご～く頭痛そうだけど？: A-are you okay? You look like you have a massive headache.
m920102.だいじょーぶ！\nこの超有能な風水士であるところの\nフェイちゃんに任せて！:
Don't worry!
Leave it to me, the super-capable feng shui master, Fei-chan!
m920102.だが、まあいい。\n此の地で製造したキョンシーどもの力を試すいい機会だ。\n道士: Still, fine. This is a perfect chance to test the jiangshi we've made here. Taoists, eliminate them together with the jiangshi!
m920102.だが、此の地を返すわけにはゆかん。\n此の地の龍脈より充溢する気は術の力を高め、: But I can't give this land back. The dragon veins here overflow with energy that amplifies my arts, perfect for crafting jiangshi.
m920102.だが、真実は時に残酷なもの。\n記憶が戻ったとて、それが良きこととは限らぬぞ？\:
But truth can be cruel.
Even if your memories return, it may not be a blessing.
Do you still want the truth, Lan-Fa?
m920102.だって……何一つ思い出せないのです。\n自分がなぜキョンシーになったのかも、\n:
Because… I can't remember a single thing.
I don't know why I turned into a jiangshi, or who I was before.
m920102.だって、素敵じゃない♪\n意志があって利発なキョンシーだなんて。\n是非近くに置: Because it's wonderful♪ A Jiangshi with will and brains. I'd love to keep you close.
m920102.だ～か～らぁ～っ！\n猫じゃなくて妖虎だよぉーっ！:
I-told-you-so-! 
It's not a cat, it's a demon tiger!
m920102.ち、違いますッ！\nそんな……そんなことをするつもりでは……。: N-no! That's not… I never intended…!
m920102.ちぃっ……人間風情に後れを取るとは。\nここは一旦退くしかあるまい。:
Tsk… to be outpaced by a mere human.
I guess I have no choice but to retreat for now.
m920102.ですから私は、どうしてもそこへ行きたいのです。\n他のキョンシーと違い、私に意志: So I absolutely must go there—to learn what it means for me to have a will, unlike other jiangshi…
m920102.ですが、これでようやく手がかりを得られました。\nさっそく金光聖菩が記した名の地:
Now we finally have a clue.
Let's head straight to the place Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu wrote down.
m920102.ですが、どうやってその地へ行けばいいのかも\nわかりませんし、先日のようにキョン: But I have no idea how to reach that place, and thinking that my jiangshi powers might go out of control again, like the other day, scares me…
m920102.ですが、なにかが変です……。\n以前はもっと生気に溢れていたはずですが……。:
But something's off…
It used to be so full of life before…
m920102.ですが、キョンシーを巨大化させる術を\n屍解仙が以前から使えたとは思えません。\:
But I doubt Shikai-sen has been able to enlarge jiangshi for long.
He must've gained new power, or perhaps…
m920102.ですが、名前の他に思い出せることが一つだけあります。\nそれは、華の国のどこかと:
However, besides my name, there's one thing I can recall:
the landscape of a place that must be somewhere in the Land of Flowers.
m920102.ですが、巨大化したキョンシーたちは通常の彼らよりも\n耐久力と攻撃力が上がってい:
However, the enlarged jiangshi seem to have greater durability and attack power than normal ones.
Please be especially careful.
m920102.ですが、魔物の巣はまだあちこちに見えます。\n渓谷を抜けるまでは気を抜かないでく:
But monster nests are still scattered everywhere.
Don't let your guard down until we get through the gorge.
m920102.でも、どうして急に\nボクたちと訓練がしたいだなんて言い出したの？: But why did you suddenly say you wanted to train with us?
m920102.でも、ランファさんの記憶にある風景を\n見つけるには、どうしたらいいのでしょうか: But how can we find the scenery that's in Lan-Fa's memory?
m920102.ところで、ひとつお願いがあるのだけど……。: By the way, I have a favor to ask…
m920102.となれば、わしが此処に留まる必要はあるまい。\n此の地は巨大キョンシーどもに任せ:
In that case, I have no need to stay here.
Leave this place to the giant jiangshi, and I'll set my sights on conquering the whole eastern realm… Ka-ka-ka!
m920102.なに、我ら邪仙の覇業を度々阻害しているという\n王子とやらの実力を試してみたくな:
Well, I've grown curious about testing the so-called Prince's strength,
the one who keeps thwarting our evil immortal ambitions.
So I came all the way here just for that.
m920102.なんということを……許せません！\nランファさんの故郷を滅ぼしたのみならず、\n: This is unforgivable! Not only have you destroyed Lan-Fa's hometown, but you even turned her and the villagers into jiangshi!
m920102.ねぇ、貴方……私のものにならない？: Hey, why don't you become mine?
m920102.ねえ、ランファさん。\n記憶にある景色に近づいてる感じはする？:
Hey, Lan-Fa.
Do you feel like we're getting closer to the scenery you remember?
m920102.はぁ？ なに言ってんだよ。\n戦いってのはこう、勢いが大事なんじゃねーか。なぁ？:
Huh? What are you talking about?
In battle, it's all about momentum, isn't it? Right?
m920102.ふふ……気に入ったぞ、王子。\nいずれ我が足下にひれ伏させてやろう。:
Heh… I like you, Prince.
One day you'll kneel before me.
m920102.ふふ、そうかそうか。\nよかろう、ならば教えてやる……。:
Heh, very well.
Then let's… teach you.
m920102.ふふ、そう言うと思ったわ。\nでもね……私は貴方のそういうところが好きなのよ♪: Heh, I thought you'd say that. But you know… I love that side of you♪
m920102.ふふ、頼りにさせていただきますね。: Hehe, I'll be counting on you.
m920102.ふふっ……そうみたいですね。\n皆様と一緒なら、キョンシーになったことを\nあま:
Hehe… seems that way.
If I'm with all of you, I don't think I'll have to worry much about being a jiangshi.
m920102.ふふっ、仲間なんだから当然じゃないですか。\nね、皆さん？:
Hehe, we're comrades, so of course.
Right, everyone?
m920102.ふふっ、案ずるなランファ。\n天才戦術家であるこの私の指揮に従って行動すれば、\: Hehe, don't worry, Lan-Fa. Follow my commands—after all, I'm a brilliant tactician—and you'll never be led astray by wayward ki!
m920102.ふふふ……そうかそうか。\nそんなに知りたいか……ん？:
Heh heh… I see, I see.
You want to know so badly… huh?
m920102.ふむ、そういえばそういう約束だったな。\nよかろう、教えてやるのはやぶさかでない:
Hmm, now that you mention it, that was the deal.
Fine, I won't refuse to tell you.
m920102.ふむ。噂になっておった意志を持つキョンシーか。\nその風体……ひょっとすると、お:
Hmm. A jiangshi with a will, as the rumors say.
That form… perhaps you're from his land…?
m920102.ほう……少しはできるようだな。\nよし、たまにはわしも体を動かすとするか。: Hm… you're getting the hang of it. All right, I'll join the fray myself.
m920102.ほう……記憶が戻ったか。\n仮にも死してキョンシーと化された者が\n生前の記憶を: Hm… so your memory's back. Even a corpse turned jiangshi regains its past memories… impressive resolve.
m920102.ほう、お前が噂の王子か。\n会いたかったぞ……ふふっ。:
Ah, so you're the rumored Prince.
I've been wanting to meet you… heh.
m920102.ほう、喋りが得意なキョンシーってのも珍しいな。\nだが、邪仙の手先を見逃すわけに:
Well, a jiangshi that can talk is a rarity. 
But I can't let the evil immortal's minion slip by!
m920102.ほほう……あれだけの人数を退けるか。\nさては、ぬしらが噂の王子たちだな？\nグ: Hoho… you repelled that many. So you're the rumored princes, huh? Guff… Gahaha, Gahhahhah!!
m920102.ま……負けませんよ！\n体格の差は功夫の差で埋めればいいのです！:
I… won't lose!
We can make up the size difference with skill!
m920102.ま、まずいよ王子！ \n分身が増えれば増えるほど金光聖菩は強くなるって、\nむか:
This is bad, Prince! 
The more duplicates he creates, the stronger Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu becomes,
just like Master said ages ago!
m920102.まずいですね……魔法も矢もほぼ効かず、\n近寄れば周囲の砂で相手を切り刻む、禍血: This is bad… Neither magic nor arrows work, and if you get close the sand slices them up—this cursed-blood formation… If we can't break it, we'll be wiped out.
m920102.まったく……メトゥスさんには困ったものですね。\nそれでは、そろそろ帰還いたしま:
Good grief… Metus really is a troublemaker.
Well then, let's head back soon.
m920102.みんなー、この峠を越えれば華の国だよー。: Everyone—once we cross this pass, we'll be in the Land of Flowers!
m920102.むぅ……しょ、しょーがないでしょ？\n情報が少なすぎる以上、あたしの羅盤じゃ\n:
Hmm… Well, there's nothing we can do.
With so little information, my compass can only give a rough direction.
m920102.やはり、もっと具体的な手がかりがないと\nランファさんが記憶している風景の土地に: As expected, without more concrete clues it'll be hard to reach the land from Lan-Fa's memory.
m920102.ゆけ、キョンシーども！ 総攻撃だ！\nぬしらとの戦いで疲弊した人間どもを、\n我:
Attack, Jiangshi! All out!
We'll slaughter those exhausted humans with our cursed-blood formation!
m920102.ようやく大人しくなったか。\nそんじゃ、悪いが捕まってもらうぜ？:
Finally calmed down. 
Well then, sorry, but I'm taking you in.
m920102.よかろう。だが、タダで教えてやるのも面白くない。\n知りたくばこの私の金光陣を破:
Very well. But it wouldn't be fun to teach you for free.
If you wish to know, try breaking my Golden Light Formation!
m920102.よくやった、失敗作よ。\n邪仙郷の仇敵、王子どもを\nよくぞ我が本拠まで連れてき:
Well done, you failure.
You've brought the Prince, the enemy of Jasenkyō, all the way to my stronghold.
m920102.わしはただ、意志のあるキョンシーが\n近くをうろついているという噂を聞いて\n研: I only heard rumors of a willing jiangshi roaming nearby, thought it might be useful for my research, so I came to collect it.
m920102.んな話知るかってんだよ！\n……ん、てこたぁこのキョンシーの姉ちゃんは\n俺が脅:
I don't know any such story! 
…Anyway, looks like this jiangshi's sister attacked because I threatened her.
m920102.カッカッカ……どの死体をキョンシーにしたかなど、\nいちいち憶えてはおらぬわ。: Kakkakka… I don't bother remembering which corpse I turned into a jiangshi.
m920102.キョンシーである私に\nこんなに良くしてくださって……\n……ぐすん……感激です:
As a jiangshi, you've been so kind to me…
…sniff… I'm deeply moved…!
m920102.キョンシーということは、\n今回の一件もやはり屍解仙の仕業なのでしょうか？: Since they're jiangshi, this must be Shikai-sen's doing, right?
m920102.キョンシーとなった後に逃げ出すなぞ、\nとんだ失敗作だと思っておったが……その実: I thought a Jiangshi that runs away would be a total failure… but you were actually setting the stage for my triumph.
m920102.キョンシーの暗器はあらゆる守りを貫通して\nダメージを与えるといいます。\n皆さ: Jiangshi weapons can pierce any defense and deal damage. Everyone, stay on guard!
m920102.グハハッ！ \n我が無敵の禍血陣の前では\nそんな矢など取るに足らぬわ！: Gahaha! Against my invincible Curse-Blood Formation, arrows are nothing!
m920102.グフフ……ぬしらに許しを請うたつもりはない。\nそれに村人どもを滅ぼしたのはわし: Guff… I have no intention of asking your forgiveness. I was the one who wiped out the villagers, but it was the evil sage, the Corpse-splitting Immortal, who turned the bodies into jiangshi.
m920102.グフフ……違わぬとも。結果がそう証明しておる。\nキョンシーとなったうぬは、\n: Guff… you're right. The results speak for themselves. Now that you're a Jiangshi, you're destined to be my loyal servant.
m920102.フェイさん、落ち着いてください。\n……それで、その十天君の一人がなんの御用です:
Fei, please calm down.
…And what business does that one Ten Heaven have here?
m920102.フフ……それにしても段違いじゃのう。\n通天教主様にお貸しいただいた宝貝の力で\:
Heh… still, it's on another level.
With the power of the treasured shell lent by the Lord of the Heavens, the strength of these giant jiangshi…
m920102.フン、なかなかの上玉だが死人を拝む趣味はねえ。\n悪さをしでかす前にとっちめてや: Hmph, decent specimen, but I have no taste for worshipping the dead. I'll put a stop to this before it causes trouble!
m920102.メメントさん、メトゥスさん、ありがとうございます。\nお忙しいなか訓練にお付き合: Memento-san, Metus-san, thank you. We really appreciate you joining the training despite your busy schedules.
m920102.ランファさん……。\n（故郷を取り戻せたとはいえ、\nランファさんのご家族やご友:
Lan-Fa…
(Though you've reclaimed your home,
your family and friends are… gone.)
m920102.ワタシ……いい方法知ってル。\nチカラ、暴走シそうにナったら……猫の真似スル。: I… know a good method. When my power starts to run wild… I imitate a cat.
m920102.久しいなァ、失敗作よ。\n短い逃亡生活は楽しかったか？ ん？: It's been a while, failure. Did you enjoy your short life on the run? Huh?
m920102.今後もそうしたキョンシーたちと\n戦うことになると予想されますので、\nアンデッ: Since we'll likely keep fighting those Jiangshi, we'll need countermeasures against the undead—
m920102.全てを貫く天雷……ならば、\n貴方のご自慢の禍血陣をも貫けるということですね？:
The all-piercing heavenly thunder… then it could shatter
your prized cursed-blood formation, couldn't it?
m920102.共に歩み、戦う中で気づいたのです。\n私の往くべき道は、貴方が歩む大道と同じであ: I've realized, as we walk and fight side by side, that the path I must follow is the same great road you walk.
m920102.同胞たちの弔いが終わりましたら、王国に参ります。\nその時になりましたら、またお:
When the memorial for my comrades is finished, I'll head to the kingdom.
When that time comes, let's meet again.
m920102.否定せんでも良いではないか？\nうぬはキョンシーとして――主であるわしの道具とし: You don't have to deny it. As a Jiangshi—​as my tool—you performed perfectly.
m920102.嘘じゃナイ……。\nワタシ……ランファと同じキョンシー。\nキョンシーの気持ち、: I'm not lying… I… am a jiangshi just like you, Lan-Fa. I understand a jiangshi's feelings better than anyone…
m920102.幸い、彼は本気で攻めてくるつもりはないようです。\nうかつに近寄らないよう、ご注: Fortunately, he doesn't seem intent on a serious attack. Just stay clear and be careful!
m920102.待ってください。\nそちらの方にはもう、私たちに対する\n敵意があるようには見受: Hold on. It doesn't seem like they harbor any hostility toward us anymore.
m920102.此の地でキョンシーを大量に製造していたのは、\n東の国を我らが手中に収めるための: We were mass-producing Jiangshi here to build an army for conquering the eastern lands.
m920102.死体……回収……？\n研究に有用……ですって？:
Corpses… collect…?
Useful for research… you say?
m920102.気にすんなって、同郷のよしみってヤツだ。\n……ま、後ろからいきなり雷落とすのだ: Don't worry about it—it's hometown camaraderie. …Just don't go blasting lightning from behind, okay?
m920102.無敵にすら思える尊天君の禍血陣も、\n全てを貫くという彼女の雷の力があれば\nき:
Even Sonten's seemingly invincible cursed-blood formation
can be broken with her thunder that pierces everything!
m920102.王子、キョンシーらしき姿の女性を見かけたという\n報告のあった場所はこの辺りのよ: Prince, the reports say the woman resembling a jiangshi was spotted around here.
m920102.王子様、御恩に報いる時が来ました。\n全てを貫く天雷を操る我が力、\nどうか今後: Prince, the time has come to repay your kindness. Please put my power—mastery over the all-piercing thunder—to use in the battles to come.
m920102.申し訳ありません……お手数をおかけして。\n地名だけでも思い出せれば、とは思うの:
I'm sorry… I hate to trouble you.
I wish I could at least recall a place name…
m920102.知りたいか？ ふふ……ならば教えてやろう。\n私は華の国の仙人、十天君が一人の金:
Want to know? Heh… then I'll tell you.
I am a sage of the Land of Flowers, one of the Ten Heavens, Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu.
m920102.禍血陣の力が弱まれば、我々にも勝機はあります！\nランファさんと力を合わせ、\n:
If the formation weakens, we have a chance!
Together with Lan-Fa, we'll free this land from Sonten's rule!
m920102.私のせいです……私が皆さんを連れてこなければ……。: It's my fault… If I hadn't brought everyone here…
m920102.私はランファ、貴方のような邪悪を滅ぼす者です！: I am Lan-Fa, a destroyer of evils like you!
m920102.良いぞ、巨大キョンシーども。\nその調子で町を破壊し尽くすがよい！:
Fine, you giant jiangshi.
Keep destroying the town!
m920102.華の国らしい街並みが見えてきましたね。\nなにか手がかりが見つかるといいのですが:
We can see a town that looks like it's from the Land of Flowers.
I hope we find some clue…
m920102.蝶を見るのもオススメだよ。\n蝶を見ていると全てを忘れられるんだ……。: Watching butterflies is also recommended. When you look at them, you can forget everything…
m920102.覚えているのは……武器を向けられた瞬間に\n得体の知れない衝動が身体中を駆け巡っ: All I recall is… the moment a weapon was pointed at me, an unknown impulse surged through my body… and when I came to, I was surrounded by all of you.
m920102.言い遅れたな。\nわしは十天君が一人、尊天君。\nうぬらの命脈をここで断つ者だ！:
I should've said it sooner.
I am Sonten, the sole Ten-Heaven Lord.
I'll be the one to cut off your lifelines here!
m920102.話は終わりじゃ。ゆけ、キョンシーども！\n邪魔者どもを退け、あの女キョンシーを捕:
That's all there is to say. Forward, jiangshi!
Drive away the interlopers and capture that female jiangshi!
m920102.近くに魔物の巣があるようですね。\n王子、ひとまず迎撃いたしましょう。:
There seems to be a monster nest nearby.
Prince, let's intercept them for now.
m920102.違う……そんなことのために逃げ出したのでは……。: No… I didn't run away for that…
m920102.酷い……人をなんだと思って――: How cruel… what do you think people are—?
m920102.金光聖菩に教わった地はこの辺りでしょうか？\n……おや、ランファさん？: Is this the ground taught by Kinmitsu Shobo? …Oh, Lan-Fa?
m920102.（……本当に大丈夫でしょうか？）\n……あ、王子様たちが来ましたよ。\n皆さん、:
(…Is everything really okay?)
…Ah, the Prince and company have arrived.
Everyone, please get ready for the sparring!
m920102.（ぐぬぅッ……この地を手放すのは惜しいが、\nこれ以上粘ってもいたずらに損害を増:
(Grr… I hate to let this ground go,
but dragging this out will only cause more needless loss.)

m920135.――『破滅の力』とは、千年戦争以前の\n古の破壊神が作ったという、根源的な力その: —The 'Power of Ruin' is the primordial force itself, created by an ancient god of destruction before the Millennium War.
m920135.――『破滅の力』の在り処が見つかった、と？: —We've located the source of the 'Power of Ruin', have we?
m920135.――あーあ、頑張っちゃってるねー。\nただの威力偵察のつもりだったのに、\n人間: —Ah, you're really giving it your all. I was just doing a simple power survey, and humans are so weak, huh?
m920135.――えっ？ も、模擬戦？\nこれから魔王軍と戦うっていうのに、\n体力を温存して:
Wait, a... a sparring match?
We're about to face the Demon King's army, aren't we?
Don't we need to conserve our strength?
m920135.――お、ようやくお出ましか。\nこの前のポーションの礼をしに来たぞ。:
――Oh, you're finally here.
I came to thank you for the potion last time.
m920135.――きゃぁぁあっ！？\nな、なんですかこの風っ！\n飛ばされてしまいますよぉぉっ:
Kyaa—!?
W-what's with this wind!?
It's going to blow me away!
m920135.――ここが最後の\n『破滅の力』が隠されている孤島よ。:
This is the final isolated island
where the "Power of Ruin" is hidden.
m920135.――さて、それであんた達は、\n『破滅の力』についてどれだけ知っているのかしら？:
—Well then, how much do you all know about the
'Power of Ruin'?
m920135.――それならば、次の演習は、\n帝国領内にて実施してはいかがでしょうか？:
――In that case, how about we hold the next exercise
within Imperial territory?
m920135.――ちょっとあんた達！\nここは立入禁止よ！: ――Hey, you three! This area is off-limits!
m920135.――となれば、私達の出番じゃない？: In that case, it's our turn to step up, isn't it?
m920135.――なるほど。\n国家規模で守っちゃうってわけか。\nよーし、そうと決まれば作戦: —I see. So we protect it on a national scale. Alright, if that's decided, time for a strategy meeting!
m920135.――ヘイオス、本当に我らの故郷を再興したのだな。: —Heios, you really have rebuilt our homeland.
m920135.――ヘイオスさん、何の騒ぎですか？\n……って、で、デシウス！？ なぜここに！？: ――Heios, what's all this commotion? …Wait, Decius!? What are you doing here?!
m920135.――待ってフィリス！\nこの物音……洞窟の奥から魔物が迫ってるわ！: ——Wait, Phyllis! That noise… monsters are coming from deep inside the cave!
m920135.――王子！ 伝令！ 伝令です！\nこちらに魔物の群れが接近中です！: ――Prince! Messenger! A messenger! A horde of monsters is approaching!
m920135.――私は、この暗黒の力を、人々を、\n街を守護するために振るうことを決めたのです: —I decided to wield this dark power to protect the people, to guard the city.
m920135.――総督！ 報告します！\n既に市街に魔王軍が侵入、\n各戦線共に突破されつつあ: —Governor! Report! The Demon King's army has already entered the city, and they're breaking through on every front!
m920135.――魔物の気配はなさそうだな。\nこれで亀裂から飛び出した魔物も、\n海の魔物も:
There don't seem to be any more monster signatures.
It looks like we've defeated both the monsters that burst from the rifts
and the sea monsters.
m920135.…………否、だ。\nヘイオスよ、我輩がここへ来たのは、\nお前を魔王軍に入るよう: …………No. Heios, I came here to persuade you to join the Demon King's army.
m920135.……『破滅の力』を知っているのか？\n良ければその場所に連れて行ってほしいんだが: …You know about the Power of Ruin? If you don't mind, could you take us to its location?
m920135.……あいつは、人の言うことを聞かないので。\n友達も少ないし、卑怯な手段をすぐ選: …He doesn't listen to anyone. He has few friends, chooses cowardly tactics, yet he's single-minded when it comes to his goals.
m920135.……あっ、あのほこらにあるの、\nもしかして『破滅の力』じゃない？: …Hey, that shrine over there—could that be the “Power of Ruin”?
m920135.……あのバリケード、\n敵を狙うのにすごく邪魔ですね……。:
……Those barricades are really getting in the way
of aiming at the enemy……
m920135.……いにしえの、破壊神？\n魔王ガリウスが作ったものではないのですか？: …An ancient god of destruction? Isn't that something the Demon King Garius created?
m920135.……いや、待てカタラ。\n先程、私達では『破滅の力』を制御できない、\nというよ: …Wait, Katara. Didn't we just say we can't control the 'Power of Ruin'?
m920135.……いやいや、\nそんな縁起でもないこと言わないでほしいな。\n本当に出てきたら:
…No, no,
don't say such ominous things.
What will we do if they actually appear?
m920135.……えぇと『破滅の力』を探すのを、\n手伝っていただけるということですか？: ...So, you'll help us search for the “Power of Ruin”?
m920135.……これからは、仲間がいる。\n『破滅の力』を回収し、防護を固めた後にも、\n王: …From now on, you'll have companions. After retrieving the “Power of Ruin” and fortifying defenses, you'll stay with the kingdom, right?
m920135.……それなら、この場所も危ないですよね。\nあの、お願いです。\n『破滅の力』を:
...If that's the case, this place is dangerous too, right?
Um, I have a request.
Could you hand over the “Power of Ruin” to us…?
m920135.……そんな奥地で、寂しくありませんでしたか？: …In such a remote place, weren't you lonely?
m920135.……つまり、この先も同じように、\n過酷な場所に行かないといけない、ということか: …So that means we'll have to keep going into harsh places, right?
m920135.……つまり『破滅の力』は、\n全部で七つということですか？: …So there are seven “Powers of Ruin” in total?
m920135.……どうやら、これで一段落のようですね。\n王子、此度の魔物討伐、お疲れさまでし:
……It seems we have reached a turning point.
Prince, well done on the monster extermination!
m920135.……なるほど、鍛錬は怠っていないようだな。: ……I see. You have not neglected your training.
m920135.……ふぅ。魔法都市からゴーレムも連れてきました。\n最終調整、ここでさせてもらい:
...Phew. I brought the Golems from the Magic City, too.
I'll need to do some final adjustments here, alright?
m920135.……ふふっ、みんなに慕われているみたいね。\nでも王子にも大役があるから忘れない:
……Heh, it seems everyone looks up to you.
But don't forget, Prince, you have a major task of your own.
m920135.……へぇ、王国？ 魔物と戦って回ってるっていう？\nってことは、ここに来たのは\: …The Kingdom, you say? Fighting monsters all over? So you came here for the Power of Ruin, didn't you?
m920135.……へぇ、魔界と物質界の間に、\n空間の亀裂が生じ始めてるってことか。:
...Hm, so the rifts between the Demon Realm and the Material World
are starting to form.
m920135.……へぇ。確かに魔力の波動が和らいだ。\nこんな術を伝える一族があったんだね。: …Hmm. Indeed the magical wave has softened. So there's a clan that passes down such techniques.
m920135.……まぁ、ちょっとはね。\nでもこれは、世界を守る大事な使命だったし。: …Well, a little. But this was an important mission to protect the world.
m920135.……もう暗黒騎士団は解散したんだから、\n正確には元副団長なんだけどね。\nちょ:
……The Dark Knights are already disbanded, so
technically I'm the former Vice-Captain.
But I'll lend you a hand, Prince.
m920135.……もはや、物質界に未練はない。\n我輩が歩むのは、やはり闘争の道のみだ！: …I have no lingering ties to the material world. The only road I walk is the road of battle!
m920135.……わかりました。\n王子、私達も戦線に加わりましょう。: …Understood. Prince, we'll join the front lines as well.
m920135.……ディアナ、全ての騎士を招集しろ。\n王子、今は戦友として手を貸してやろう。:
……Diana, summon all our knights.
Prince, I will lend you my hand as a comrade in arms.
m920135.……デシウス、あなたは一度、この街を捨てました。\n欲しい物全てが手に入る世界で: …Decius, you once abandoned this city. This isn't a world where you can have everything you want, you know? Wanting both is simply impossible…
m920135.……デシウス、撤退していきます。\nヘイオスさん、よろしいのですか？: Decius, we're withdrawing. Heios, is that alright?
m920135.……人だった頃には、いつも引き分けでしたよ。\nデシウス、もう共に戦うことはでき: …When I was still human, we always ended in a draw. Decius, can we no longer fight together?
m920135.……何だか、昔よりも手応えがあるような？: ……I feel like I'm getting a bit more of a challenge than before.
m920135.……何を勘違いしている。\nお前は民を守るために戦った、それで十分だ。: …What are you misunderstanding? You fought to protect the people, and that's enough.
m920135.……千年戦争の時を思い出しますね。\nいえ、むしろそれ以上、でしょうか？:
……It reminds me of the time of the Millennium War.
No, perhaps even more so?
m920135.……帝国と王国、ここまで練度を高めていましたか。: …The Empire and the Kingdom have honed their skills this far, have they?
m920135.……皇帝陛下、そして王子殿下、\n街を守ってくださったこと、感謝いたします。: …Your Majesty the Emperor, and Prince, thank you for protecting the town.
m920135.……相談は終わったか？\nでは行くぞ、かつての友よ、そして王子よ……！！: …Is the discussion over? Then let's go, old friend, and Prince…!!
m920135.……確かに、ご先祖様から\n英雄王の系譜が現れた時には『破滅の力』の\n扱いを委: …Indeed, it's said that when a hero-king lineage appears from one's ancestors, the handling of the Power of Ruin is entrusted to them...
m920135.……遊撃のために、飛空艇に慣れる必要もあるだろう。\n悪い提案では無いと思うが。:
……It would be good to get used to the airship for guerrilla operations.
I don't think it's a bad idea.
m920135.……駄目です。すぐに兵を撤退させます。\nこれはあくまで威力偵察、\n雑兵はとも: …No. I'll order the troops to retreat immediately. This is only a power reconnaissance; we can't afford to lose you, even if the fodder can go.
m920135.……魔王軍、撤退していきます。\n市街に潜んでいた魔物も、現在兵が掃討中です。: …The Demon King's army is withdrawing. The monsters lurking in the city are being swept up by our troops now.
m920135.『破滅の力』とは違う、もうひとつの魔力の乱れが……。\nこの感じはアトナテスさん:
It's not the "Power of Ruin," but another disturbance in the mana...
It feels just like when Atnates was...
m920135.『破滅の力』を使わせる前に、\n魔王ガリウスを討伐すれば良いわけですからね。:
That's right. We simply need to defeat the Demon King Garius
before he can use the "Power of Ruin."
m920135.あ、あれ……？ 大変です王子っ！！\n追い風に乗って魔物がこちらへ突っ込んできま:
Ah, that...?
This is bad, Prince!! Monsters are riding the tailwind straight at us!
m920135.ああ。他愛もない。\nだが魔王軍もこの地に『破滅の力』があると、\n気付いてるっ: Yeah, nothing special. But that means the Demon Lord's forces have realized there's a Power of Ruin here, too.
m920135.あたしが持っているのは、\n一族に受け継がれている一個だけね。\n他の欠片は、封: What I have is the only one passed down in my clan. The other fragments can only be found by seeking their sealed locations.
m920135.あたしの術と、先祖代々の血の力で、\n『破滅の力』を制御しているから、\nあんた:
With my techniques and the blood of my ancestors, I'm controlling the “Power of Ruin,”
so it shouldn't affect you much.
m920135.あたしはカタラ。\nこの地に封じられし『破滅の力』の欠片を\n代々守護してきた一:
I'm Katara.
I'm the descendant of the clan that has guarded the sealed fragment of the “Power of Ruin” here for generations.
m920135.あたしも一族の伝承でしか\n知らないから、確証はないけどね。: I only know it from my clan's legends, so I can't be certain.
m920135.あたし達、竜人の部族も協力しますよ！\n普段は同じ種族で喧嘩ばかりしているけれど:
Our Dragonkin tribe will help too!
We're usually fighting amongst ourselves, but
when the world is in crisis, we can work together!
m920135.あった！ 『破滅の力』は回収できたわ！: Got it! We've recovered the “Power of Ruin”!
m920135.あとはこれらを、どうやって防衛するかですが……。: Now, the question is how to defend them...
m920135.あとは各勢力の連絡手段が必要ですよね？\n魔術師ギルドで、各地を結ぶ連絡網を展開:
We'll also need a way to communicate with each faction, right?
Let's have the Mages' Guild set up a communication network connecting the regions.
m920135.あのお方のようになれるなら光栄です。\nさぁ、急ぎますよ。: It would be an honor to become like that person. Come on, let's hurry.
m920135.あの人にも、見せてあげたかったな。\n子孫がこんなに頑張ってるよって。:
I wish I could have shown her.
That her descendants are working so hard.
m920135.あら、魔力の乱れが読めるのね？\nでもここにはあたしがいるから大丈夫よ。:
Oh, you can sense the magical turbulence?
Don't worry, I'm here.
m920135.あるいはフロストジャイアントくらい、だろうな。: Or maybe frost giants, I suppose.

m920135.いいや、アタシも知らなかったよ。\nむしろこの海域には、\n生半可な船じゃ入れな:

m920135.いえいえ、見つけたわけではありません。\nあくまで星が、このあたりに大きな力が眠: No, we haven't actually found it. The stars are merely indicating that a great power lies somewhere around here.

Before we knew it, we've become quite the large group.
Ugh~ I'm so excited to spar with everyone!

m920135.えぇとぉ……私が守っていて、\nがおがおちゃんに取られちゃったのが一個とぉ……。: Um… I was guarding one, but Gaogao-chan took it… that's one.

What!? What did you say?!

m920135.おっ、でかしたネーニャ！\nさっそく回収して――: Nice work, Nenya! Let's retrieve it right away—

m920135.くぅぅっ……結局お前には、\n一度も勝てなかったか……。: Ugh… In the end, I never managed to beat you even once…
m920135.くっ……だが……我輩は……お前を救おうと……。: Damn… but… I… I want to save you…
m920135.くっ……また一段と、\n力の影響が大きくなったな……。: Damn… the power's influence has grown even stronger…

m920135.けれど、あたしの一族には偶然にも、\n『破滅の力』への耐性があったのよ。\n特殊: But my clan, by chance, has resistance to the 'Power of Ruin'—thanks to special sorcery and blood passed down through generations.
m920135.こ、こんな風の中じゃっ、\nまともに戦えないですよぉっ！: I—In a wind like this, we can't fight properly!
m920135.この世界を滅びから救うためにも、\n力を合わせ、魔王軍に勝利しましょう！: Let's join forces and defeat the Demon King's forces to save this world from destruction!
m920135.この地で生きる魔物にとっては、\nむしろ滑って突撃ができて好都合ってことね。: For the monsters that live here, it's actually convenient—they can slip and charge.
m920135.この海域に、こんな島があったなんてね。\nデューオ、あなたは知っていたかしら？:
I had no idea there was an island in these waters.
Duo, did you know about it?

m920135.こら、戦士を侮辱してはいけません。\n物質界の破壊によって死にゆく者たちなれど、: Hey, don't insult the warriors. Even though they're dying from the destruction of the material world, you must still show them respect.
m920135.これまで魔物の現れなかった場所に、\nこうして進軍してきたということは、\nそれ: Since they've advanced into a place where monsters never appeared before, there's no other explanation, is there?

I don't want to stay in this scorching place any longer.
Prince, let's finish this quickly!

Good work.
Please continue preparing for the sparring match.
m920135.さっきの魔物を撃退する手腕。\n確かに、あんた達なら\n『破滅の力』を守れるかも: Your skill in repelling those monsters just now... Indeed, if it's you, you might be able to protect the “Power of Ruin.”
m920135.さて、今は何とも言えないさ。\nだが王子達は本気で勝つ気でいる。\nそれなら、俺:
Well, it's hard to say for sure right now.
But the Prince and his crew are serious about winning.
If that's the case, we have no choice but to lend a hand.
m920135.しかし世界の危機となれば、\nギルドメンバー全員、\n全力で頑張ってくれると思い:
However, when the world is on the line,
I'm sure every member of the Guild
will give it their all!
m920135.ぜぇ……はぁ……。\nまったく、ひどい目にあったぞ……。\nこんな強風の中で戦う: *pant* … *pant*… Good grief, what a terrible ordeal… Fighting in a gale like this…
m920135.そ、そうですね！！\nでもこの風じゃっ、遠距離攻撃は難しそうですよぉっ！:
Y-yes, that's right!!
But with this wind, ranged attacks will be tough!
m920135.そいつぁ何よりだ……。\nで、『破滅の力』は後何個あるんだ？: That's the most important thing… So, how many “Powers of Ruin” are left?
m920135.そう、ですね。\nそれでは演習を続けることにしましょうか。: That's right. Then let's proceed with the exercises.

Exactly.
The "Power of Ruin" cannot unleash its true potential
unless all seven pieces are reunited.
m920135.そういうことよ。\nあんた達だけじゃ、『破滅の力』に飲み込まれて、\n制御できな:
That's right.
If it's just you, you'd be swallowed by the “Power of Ruin” and lose control.
m920135.そういうもの、なのかしら……？: Is that really how it works...?
m920135.そういうものなのよ。\n兵の皆も、決戦を前に、少しでも\n自分の実力を確かめてお:
That's exactly how it works.
The soldiers want to check their own readiness before the final battle, don't you think?
m920135.そうだったな……。\nこの砦群も、嗚呼、彼方に見える街並みも、\nどれもこれも、: That's right… This chain of forts, ah, the townscape far off… all of it is just as it was when I was still human…
m920135.そうですね……。\n暑いのは嫌いじゃないですけど、\nこの暑さはちょっと耐えきれ: That's right… I don't hate the heat, but this is a bit too much to endure…
m920135.そうではないことを祈りますが……。\nとはいえ、考えても仕方ありませんね。\n王:
I hope that's not the case…
Still, there's no point dwelling on it.
Prince, let's hurry onward.
m920135.そうね……。\n『破滅の力』自体が魔力を放っている以上、\n今みたいに魔王軍も感:
That's right...
Since the "Power of Ruin" itself is emitting mana,
the Demon King's army will likely sense it, just as they did before...
m920135.そしてかつての魔王が倒れた後、\n『破滅の力』は世界各地に散らばったそうよ。: And after the former Demon King fell, the 'Power of Ruin' apparently scattered across the world.
m920135.そして今現在のガリウスは、\n己の器の範囲内の力を取り戻しはしたが、\n千年戦争: And now, Garius has reclaimed power within his own limits, but he hasn't obtained the power from the era of the Millennium War.
m920135.そのとおりです。\n王子、既に市街には魔物が侵入しています。\n慎重な指揮をお願: Exactly. Prince, monsters have already infiltrated the city. Please command carefully!
m920135.その前に、あんた達は\nいくつの欠片を確認しているの？: Before that, how many fragments have you all confirmed?

Also, there's only limited space to fight.
But that platform heated by lava might become usable after some time…
m920135.それができるなら、最初からご先祖様も、\n秘境に分散して『破滅の力』を隠したりし: If it were that simple, our ancestors wouldn't have scattered the "Power of Ruin" across the hidden realms in the first place.
m920135.それじゃああたしが教えてあげるから、\n聞き逃さないように集中しなさい？: Then I'll tell you, so focus and don't miss a word, okay?
m920135.それでは、場所を移して次の模擬戦にしましょう。\n皆さん、準備をお願いします！:
Then, let's move to the next sparring match.
Everyone, please make your preparations!
m920135.それでは、模擬戦を開始します。\n皆さん、怪我の無いようにお願いしますね！:
Then, let's begin the sparring match.
Everyone, please be careful not to get hurt!
m920135.それでも大きな一歩です。\n未だ『破滅の力』の正体は分かりませんが、\n魔王ガリ: Still, it's a huge step forward. We don't yet know the true nature of the Power of Ruin, but it's clear that Demon Lord Garius is after it.
m920135.それに足場が随分と悪い。\n床まで凍っているとはね……。:
And the footing is terrible.
The floor's frozen solid…

And it's not just one or two.
Rifts are about to open all around this island!
They'll keep multiplying as time passes!
m920135.それより！ 合同演習を続けましょう！\n我が街も微力ながら、\n魔王軍との戦いに: More importantly, let's continue our joint exercises! Our city will do its part, however small, to aid the fight against the Demon King's army!
m920135.た、たたた、たしかにっ、\nさっきは暑い暑いって言ってたけどぉっ！！:
T-t-t-that's right,
you said it was hot earlier, but now—!!
m920135.た、立入禁止ですか！？\nそんな立て札はどこにも……。: Off-limits, you say?! There's no sign of that anywhere...
m920135.だから何だと言うのですか！\n魔界の瘴気の中で、人々が生きていけるとでも！？: So what? You think people can live in the miasma of the demon realm!?

So I believe the best course of action is to disperse the pieces we've gathered
among the various factions that have friendly relations with the Kingdom.
Prince, do you have any factions in mind that could be trusted with them?
m920135.だが、お前に実力が足らなかったのも事実だ。\n……今後も精進しろ。: But it's also true that you lacked the strength. …Keep honing yourself.

Then let us begin this exercise with the volunteers.
Both sides, give it your all and prepare for the war against the Demon King!
m920135.では、ひとつは妖精郷にて預かりましょう。\nエルフと人間、今こそ手を取り合う時で:
Then, let the Elven homeland hold one piece.
It is time for Elves and Humans to join hands.
m920135.では、移動手段として、\n帝国の飛空艇をお貸ししましょう。\n遊撃部隊には機動力:
In that case, we will lend you the Empire's airships.
The guerrilla units will need the mobility.
m920135.でも、だからこそ誰も、\nこんな場所に来ようとは思わないのよ。: But that's exactly why no one would think of coming to a place like this.

But I can't just hand it over outright.
Given the circumstances, as the guardian of this land's fragment, I'll accompany you.

But the Demon King's army has formidable forces.
We need to be ready for all sorts of situations…!

But from the way they're built,
they look pretty shoddy.
They might just fall apart if we wait long enough.
m920135.でもおかげで、一個目の『破滅の力』を回収できたわ。\nほら、奥のほこらに隠されて: But thanks to that, we recovered the first “Power of Ruin.” See, it was hidden in the shrine back there.
m920135.でもダメよ！\n『破滅の力』にむやみに近付くと、\nそれだけで心や身体に影響を及: But that's a bad idea! Getting too close to the Power of Ruin will affect your mind and body on its own!
m920135.というわけで王子、あたしが『破滅の力』を\n抑え込んであげるんだから、\nたっぷ: So, Prince, I'll suppress the 'Power of Ruin' for you, so you'd better be grateful, alright?
m920135.となれば、今私が声をかけても、\n考えを変えたりはしないでしょう。: So even if I speak to him now, he won't change his mind.

m920135.どうやら、魔物を迎え撃つしかなさそうですね……。\n王子、この熱気の中では、\n:
It looks like we have no choice but to fight the monsters…
Prince, in this heat our stamina will wear down gradually.

m920135.な、なるほどっ、なっ！\n二個目の『破滅の力』は、\nこの強風吹き荒れる谷にある: I—I see! So the second “Power of Ruin” is in this wind-blasted valley!
m920135.なっ……ケラウノスに\n街を滅ぼされた時のことを忘れたのですか！\nこの街を二度: Wh—have you forgotten how Keranos razed the city! You intend to erase this city from the world a second time!?
m920135.なるほど……。\n『破滅の力』自体の由来については、\n何もわかっていないってこ: I see... So we don't know anything about the origin of the 'Power of Ruin' itself.
m920135.なるほど……。\n複数の『破滅の力』が集まった結果、\n確かに大きな魔力の乱れが:
I see…
With multiple “Powers of Ruin” gathered, I can definitely feel a massive magical disturbance.
m920135.なるほどな。ガリウスが本来の力を取り戻した時、\n『破滅の力』までその手にできな: I see. When Garius regained his original power, the fact that he couldn't get hold of the 'Power of Ruin' might be because that power never truly belonged to him.
m920135.なるほどね……。\n海流と呪術、二重の障害で、\nこの島への接近を阻んでいたって:
I see...
The currents and the curses formed a double barrier,
preventing anyone from approaching this island.
m920135.ねぇねぇお姉ちゃん！\nあたしあの王子で遊びたい！\n戦ってきていい？ いい？: Hey hey sis! I want to play with that Prince! Can I fight? Okay? Okay?
