Alright.
—Huh? Sis, do you see something over there?
m920135.ば、ばかものっ！\n咎を受けるのは私ひとりで十分です！: You fool! I alone am enough to take the blame!
m920135.ふぅ……皇帝陛下、総督、\nバリケードの敷設も完了しました。:
Phew… Your Majesty, Governor,
the barricades are all set up.
m920135.ふふっ、きっとどこかで見ていますよ。\nあの人にとって、\n王子君は自慢の子孫で:
Hehe, she is surely watching from somewhere.
To her,
the Prince is a source of great pride.
m920135.ふふっ、むしろこれは、\n決戦を前に、士気と練度を\n高めるためのものではないで: Heh, on the contrary, wouldn't this be a perfect opportunity to boost morale and sharpen our skills before the decisive battle?
m920135.ふふっ、当然よ。\n『破滅の力』を隠すために、呪術で何重にも\nあたしのご先祖様:
Heh, naturally.
My ancestors used curses to hide it
in layers to conceal the "Power of Ruin."
m920135.ぶっつけ本番だったけど、\nあたしの術でちゃんと制御ができそうよ。\n――ほら、: It was a trial by fire, but I think I can control it with my technique. —There, this should be fine.
m920135.へぇ……だがどうやら、\n俺達の方が先手を打てたようだ。\n向こうの出現を察知で:
Hm... But it seems
we've struck first.
We were able to detect their emergence.
m920135.まぁ、確かに好んでこんな場所にいるのは、\n寒いところが好きな動物連中か……。: Well, those who actually enjoy being here must be the cold-loving beasts…
m920135.まさかこんな強風の中に隠されていたとは、\nどうりで誰にも見つからないわけだ……: No wonder no one could find it—it's hidden within this raging wind.
m920135.むぅぅ、暗黒騎士団には負けませんよ！\n王子と手合わせをするのは\nあたし達竜人:
Mmm, we won't lose to the Dark Knights!
We Dragonkin get to spar with the Prince first!
m920135.むぅぅぅぅっ！ けちけち！\nそんなんじゃクロちゃんみたいになっちゃうぞー！: Muuuu! Stingy! If you keep that up you'll end up like Kuro-chan!
m920135.むしろこれはもう、溶けるというより、\nそのまま蒸発してしまいそうだぞ……。: Actually, it's less melting and more like we're about to evaporate…
m920135.むむ、お姉ちゃんは堅物なんだからぁ。\nあーあ、つまんなーい。クロちゃんも、\n: Hmm, sis is such a stickler. Ah, boring. Kuro-chan, you should just go on the offensive instead of scouting.
m920135.もし敵が強力な攻撃を放つなら、\nその時は私に指示をお願いします。\n守りの加護: If the enemy launches a powerful attack, just give me the order. I'll weave a protective shield and keep everyone safe.
m920135.もちろん、砂漠の国もご一緒しますよ？\n王国との関係は、どこよりも長いのですから:
Naturally, the Desert Kingdom will be joining in.
Our relationship with the Kingdom is the longest of them all, after all!
m920135.ゆえに遠路はるばる、華の国まで来たわけだが……。\nさて、『破滅の力』はどこに隠: That's why we've traveled all this way to the Land of Flowers... Now, where could the Power of Ruin be hidden?
m920135.よぉし、地雷の敷設も完了っと。\n王子、踏まないように気をつけるんだぞ？:
Alright, the minefield is laid.
Prince, watch your step, yeah?
m920135.よし……この洞窟の『破滅の力』は\n無事に回収できたわ。:
Alright…
We've successfully retrieved the “Power of Ruin” from this cave.
m920135.わかりました。\nそれでは王子、一度王国へ帰還しましょう。:
Understood.
Then, Prince, let's return to the kingdom for now.
m920135.わがまま言わないの！\nあたしの手元に封印していた『破滅の力』以外は、\n人の手:
Don't be selfish!
Besides the “Power of Ruin” sealed with me, the rest is locked away where no one can reach!
m920135.んー、もし魔王軍が\n封印された地を把握しているなら、\n先を越されてしまう可能:
Hmm, if the Demon King army knows the sealed site,
they could get ahead of us quite easily…
m920135.カタラさんのおかげで、\n『破滅の力』が集まったことによる魔力の乱れも、\nほと:
Thanks to Katara, the mana disturbance caused by the gathering of the "Power of Ruin"
has been almost entirely brought under control.
m920135.カタラの術で、\n完全に隠してしまうことはできないのかしら？: Is there really no way Katara's magic could hide them completely?
m920135.ギャギャ！\nケンキョナ王子！ マッテタ！:
Gya-gya!
Courageous Prince! I waited for you!
m920135.クロコ様と呼びなさい。\n私達の上官にあたる方ですよ。: Call me “Lord Kuroko.” I'm your superior.
m920135.デシウス、ここへ帰ってきたということは、\n私達と共に、再び民を守護する騎士とし: Decius, the fact that you've returned here means you'll fight alongside us again as a knight protecting the people in this city, right…?
m920135.ドワーフの国も協力するわ。\n何しろ坑道だらけの国だから、\nいっぱい時間を稼げ:
The Dwarven nation will cooperate as well.
It's a country full of tunnels, after all,
so we should be able to buy plenty of time.
m920135.マンモン、がおがおちゃんじゃなくてガオレオンね！\nそれから、私達と魔王軍で半分: Mammon, it's not Gaogao-chan, it's Gaoreon! And also, we and the Demon King's army each secured one fragment shaped like magical thread, right?
m920135.ロケットトルーパー隊からも、\n配置完了との報が入りました。\nいつでも演習を開:
The Rocket Troopers have reported their positions are set.
We can begin the exercise whenever you are ready.
m920135.了解了解っとぉ。\nさぁて、がんばりますよー？:
Roger that.
Alright, let's do our best!
m920135.二個は所在が確認されているのね……。\nそれじゃあ残る『破滅の力』は、\n今確保: So two locations are accounted for… That means the remaining “Powers of Ruin” total four sites, including the one we just secured.
m920135.今や魔王軍は軍備、士気共に完全。\nしかし戦には読むべき時流というものがあるので: Now the Demon King's army is perfect in both arms and morale. Yet there's a right timing to read in battle. To seize the opportunity, knowing the enemy is also crucial.
m920135.仲間の状況には\n常に気を配るようにした方が良さそうです。: We should always keep an eye on our comrades' condition.
m920135.件のフロストジャイアントってやつか。\nそれに可愛い雪だるまも付いてきてるぜ？: That frost giant, huh? And a cute snowman came along with it, too.
m920135.元より、東の国は王国と友好を結ぶ国。\n侍の戦いぶり、魔王軍に見せてやるわ。:
The Eastern nation has always been on friendly terms with the Kingdom.
We will show the Demon King's army what true warriors are capable of.
m920135.別にどっちが先でもいいでしょ！？\n王子の取り合いしてどうするのよ！:
It doesn't matter who goes first!
Why are you fighting over the Prince?
m920135.各戦線の兵を後退させなさい！\n援軍が……援軍が必ず来るはずです！: Pull back the troops on all fronts! Reinforcements… reinforcements will definitely arrive!
m920135.合同演習の最中だったのが功を奏しましたね。\n帝国の飛空艇で、ここまで来ることが: Our joint exercise paid off. We were able to reach here aboard an imperial airship.
m920135.喜んでる場合じゃないです……！\nこの凍った足場、こちらは不利になりますが……。: This isn't the time to be happy…! This frozen footing puts us at a disadvantage, but…
m920135.大規模な魔術なので、魔力消費も大きいし、\n人数も必要になるので、\nこうした緊:
It's a large-scale spell, so it consumes a lot of mana
and requires a significant number of casters.
It's a spell reserved for emergencies like this.
m920135.帝国で模擬戦をするよーって言ったらさ、\n王子のためなら頑張るって\n義勇軍が集:
When we said we'd be doing a sparring match in the Empire,
a bunch of volunteers showed up saying
they'd do their best for the Prince.
m920135.当時の魔王は、己の器を超えた力を、\n『破滅の力』という形で行使していた。: Back then, the Demon King wielded power beyond his own capacity in the form of the 'Power of Ruin'.
m920135.当然よ……。\nさぁ、早く『破滅の力』を手に入れて、\n次の場所へ向かいましょう: Of course… Come on, let's grab the “Power of Ruin” quickly and head to the next location…
m920135.後で一斉起爆するから、\nそれまでに上手く解体しろよな！:
I'll detonate them all at once later, so
make sure to dismantle them properly before then!
m920135.御名答！ 七つの『破滅の力』が揃えば、\nその所有者は本来の力を起動することがで: Exactly! Once we gather all seven, their owner can activate their true power. We need to move them to a safe place before the Demon King snatches them.
m920135.心配してくれるのはありがたいのですが、\n魔王軍にその力を渡すわけにはいかないの: I appreciate your concern, but we can't let the Demon Lord's army get their hands on that power. We have to retrieve it as quickly as possible—
m920135.必ずや、勝利をこの手にしましょう、王子。: We will surely claim victory, Prince.
m920135.恐らくは、あんた達のいう魔王軍の仕業ね。\nここ最近になって、一族の知り合いから:
It's probably the work of that so-called Demon King army.
Lately I've been getting a lot of similar reports from acquaintances in my clan, and it's a real hassle.
m920135.悪いことは口に出すと本当になるって、\n昔お婆ちゃんに聞いたわね……。: They say speaking ill of something makes it come true—my grandmother used to say that…
m920135.戦士は何かと縁起を担ぐものじゃ。\n王子との手合わせとなれば、\n兵達の士気もき:
Warriors are prone to superstition, you know.
If they get to test themselves against the Prince, their spirits will surely soar.
m920135.暑すぎて、溶けて、しまいそう……です……。: It's so hot I feel like I'm going to melt…
m920135.最後の『破滅の力』も回収できたわ。\n魔王軍に奪われる前にこの島に到着できて何よ:
We've recovered the final "Power of Ruin" as well.
I'm glad we reached this island before the Demon King's army could.
m920135.最後の戦いが控えているわけですからね。\n皆、これまでの全ての訓練と戦いが、\n: With the final battle looming, everyone wants to feel that all their training and past battles have led to this moment.
m920135.本来なら、戦力の分散は避けるべきだがな。\nしかし今は状況が違う。\n全て奪われ:
Normally, splitting up our forces would be a mistake.
But the situation demands it now.
This is a fight where we win by keeping even a single piece from being taken.
m920135.本来は我ら帝国だけで対処すべき事態だ。\n……巻き込んでしまってすまないな。: This was originally a situation the Empire should have handled alone… Sorry for dragging you into it.
m920135.王国、帝国だけではない。\nお前がこれまで成してきたことによって、\nこうして義:
It is not just the Kingdom and the Empire.
Because of what you have done,
volunteers are gathering in droves.
m920135.王子、空間の亀裂から魔物が出てくるぞ。\n残さず迎え撃ってやろうぜ！: Prince, monsters are pouring out of those spatial rifts. Let's take them all down!
m920135.王子、魔物の予期せぬ行動に注意してください！\n迎撃の準備をお願いします！: Prince, watch out for the monsters' unexpected actions! Prepare to intercept!
m920135.王子、魔王ガリウスとの決戦は目前です。\n必ずや、ここでかつての千年戦争を終わら:
Prince, the decisive battle with the Demon King Garius is at hand.
Let us end the old Millennium War here, once and for all!
m920135.王子っ、英雄王陛下の子孫の実力っ！\nあたしにみせてみなさいっ！: Prince, show me the power of the heroic king's lineage!
m920135.王子に助けられたり、王子と戦ったり、\n一緒に助けを求める誰かのもとへ走っていっ:
Being saved by the Prince, fighting alongside him, rushing to help others in need...
We've really been through a lot, haven't we...?
m920135.王子に助けられてばかりっていうのもね。\nドワーフの国の底力を見せてあげるわ。:
We can't just keep relying on the Prince for everything.
It's about time we showed what the Dwarven Kingdom is truly capable of.
m920135.王子は本当にお人好しだからね。\n困っている人がいたら、\nすぐに助けにいってし:
The Prince is such a good soul.
He can't help but rush to aid anyone who's in trouble.
m920135.王子よ、我がかつての友、\nヘイオスのことは任せたぞ。: Prince, I'll leave Heios, my former friend, in your care.
m920135.王子殿下、暗黒の力を解き放つがゆえに、\n私の身体は傷ついていきますが、\nどう: Prince, unleashing this dark power will wound my body, but please don't be alarmed.
m920135.砂漠の国にもおまかせを。\n幾度も窮地を救っていただいた大恩、\nここでお返しし:
You may entrust one to the Desert nation as well.
We have received countless acts of salvation from you.
It is time we returned the favor.
m920135.私が『破滅の力』をひとつ預かるわ。\n王国と私の国は、常に共に歩んできたのだから:
I will take one piece into my own custody.
My country and the Kingdom have always walked this path together.
m920135.私が彼らに伝えたのは『破滅の力』が、\n千年戦争当時の魔王の力の断片だということ: What I told them is that the 'Power of Ruin' is a fragment of the Demon King's power from the Millennium War.
m920135.私が攻撃を受ける度に、\n我が身に宿った暗黒の力は、\n周囲の味方を癒やしていく: Each time I'm hit, the darkness within me should heal our allies nearby.
m920135.私も同感だ。暗黒の力をこの身に宿したのは、\n危機に際して剣をとり、戦うためなの:
I agree. I harbor the power of darkness in my body
so that I can take up my sword and fight in times of crisis…
The Vice-Captain would surely say the same.
m920135.私達は王国の者です。\nここを訪れた詳しい事情はお話しできませんが……。: We're from the Kingdom. We can't go into detail about why we're here, but...
m920135.聞こえてるわよ！！\nさぁ、次が最後の『破滅の力』の隠し場所よ！\nちゃんと準備: I can hear you!! Now, the final hidden spot of the “Power of Ruin”! Be prepared and follow me!
m920135.致し方ありません。\n民を避難させたこの館周辺だけは、\n何があっても死守せねば: There's no other way. We must hold this manor and its surroundings—where the civilians were evacuated—no matter what.
m920135.英雄王陛下の命に従って、\nずーっと華の国の奥地で暮らしてたからね。\nこの術を: Following His Majesty the Hero King's command, I lived deep in the Land of Flowers all this time. I'm the only one who should know this technique.
m920135.英雄王陛下はその内の、物質界に散った欠片を、\n封印するように、あたしのご先祖様: His Majesty the Hero King ordered my ancestors to seal the fragments that fell into the material realm.
m920135.落ち着けバシラっ！\nこんな強風の中ならっ、逆風の時にはっ、\n魔物とて足が遅く: Calm down, Bashira! In this gale, when the wind turns against them, even monsters will be slowed!
m920135.袂を分かつ時、そう約束をしたはずです。\n私達の故郷がケラウノスによって滅ぼされ: When we vowed to part ways, we promised that. Our home was destroyed by Keranos, and you, Decius, chose the path of vengeance—
m920135.詳しいことは後で教えてあげるから、\nひとまず落ち着いて話のできる場所に行きまし: I'll tell you the details later, but for now let's go somewhere calm where we can talk.
m920135.説明は後です。王国の政務官殿。\nこれよりデシウスの手勢を迎撃します！: I'll explain later, Minister of the Kingdom. From now on, we'll intercept Decius's forces!
m920135.護衛の戦力も、連絡手段も揃いましたね。\n魔王軍に抗するためには、\n物質界全土:
We have both the escort forces and the means of communication in place.
To resist the Demon King's army,
we'll need the cooperation of the entire Material World.
m920135.責任は全て私にあります。\n何卒、何卒兵たちには――: All responsibility lies with me. Please, please to the troops—
m920135.違う！ 違うのだ！！\nかつてケラウノスに操られていた折には、\n魔王様は物質界: No! That's not it!! When I was once controlled by Keranos, the Demon King intended to annihilate the material world.
m920135.長い戦いの間に、皆成長してるんですよ。\n王国も、王国と共に歩む皆さんも！:
Everyone has grown stronger during our long campaign.
The Kingdom, and all of you who stand with it!
m920135.頼りにしていますね、カタラさん。\n……それにしても、今回の洞窟は、\n何者かに:
I'm counting on you, Katara-san.
…That said, this cave feels like someone has ravaged the whole area.
m920135.頼りにしていますね、カタラさん。\nそれでは王子、次の場所へ向かいましょうか。:
We are counting on you, Katala.
Now then, Prince, let us head to the next location.
m920135.風に煽られた魔物は足が速くなるでしょうけどっ、\n慌てず冷静に対処すれば問題ない: The wind-driven monsters may be faster, but if we stay calm and handle it steadily, we can manage!
m920135.騎士団も再建し、今は王国との合同演習の最中です。\nもう二度と、この街を破壊させ: The knights have been reconstituted, and we're currently conducting joint drills with the kingdom. We'll never let this city be destroyed again.
m920135.鬼刃衆も模擬戦に協力するよ。\nあてだって、皆だって、\n世界がなくなるのは嫌だ:
The Oni Blade Clan will help with the sparring match too.
I, and everyone else,
don't want to lose the world, right?
m920135.魔王はただ、破壊神の作ったこの力を、\n利用しているに過ぎないわ。: The Demon King merely uses this power that the destruction god forged.
m920135.魔王軍とこちらで半分ずつ所有している、\n魔力糸の護衛と、各国への遊撃部隊の派遣:
That's right. You need to escort the Magic Threads
that are jointly held by the Demon King's army and us,
and dispatch guerrilla units to the various nations.
And, of course, defeat the Demon King Garius.
m920135.魔王軍に『破滅の力』の在り処を感知されるなら、\n一箇所にまとめるのではなく、\:
If the Demon King's army senses the location of the "Power of Ruin,"
we can't keep it all in one place.
We need to disperse it and assign forces to guard each piece.
m920135.魔王軍も『破滅の力』の捜索に、\n躍起になっているということでしょう。\n王子君: The Demon Lord's army must be desperate to find the Power of Ruin. Prince, give the order to intercept them, okay?
m920135.（あら、でもそれを指摘したら、\n絶対ぴーぴー怒ってくるはずよ。\n今は黙ってお: (Oh, but if I point that out, she'll definitely get all worked up. Let's just keep quiet for now, okay?)
m920135.（ほ、本当にこれ、模擬戦……？\n戦いの規模が本物の戦争みたいよ……？）:
(I... is this really just a sparring match?
The scale of this feels like an actual war...)
m920135.（王子、いったいどれだけの人に慕われているのよ……。\nちょっと驚いちゃったじゃ:
(Just how many people does the Prince have looking up to him...?
I'm a little shocked!)

m920189.…………お嫁さんなら仕方ありませんね。: …………If it is a bride you wish to be, I suppose there is nothing to be done.
m920189.……えー、続きましては筋肉と質量のお時間です。: ……And now, it's time for the muscle and mass segment.
m920189.……こほん、折角の摸擬戦演武ではあるが、\nこの三人が集まって普通にやるのも芸が:
……Ahem, while this is a simulated battle,
it would be a waste to just fight normally with the three of us.
m920189.……しかし、私たちも今や王国の一員。\nもっと気軽に接してもらうにはどうすれば。:
……However, we are now part of this Kingdom.
How can we make it easier for people to interact with us?
m920189.……それなら、うちの子だって同じだよ。\nすごく頭が良くて、いつも助けてもらって:
……If that's the case, my mount is just the same.
It's incredibly smart, and I always count on it.
m920189.……ふーん、そっかー、そういうことなんだ。: ...Oh, I see. So that's what it is.
m920189.──いいでしょう、表に出なさい。\nその腐った性根、叩き直してあげます。:
—Very well, come out.
I will beat your rotten nature straight.
m920189.──続いては老若男女を問わず、\n幅広い層から支持を受けるお三方。:
Next up are three individuals who are popular with people of all ages,
young and old alike.
m920189.ああ、動きが緩慢に見えても一切無駄がねぇ。\n観客席への流れ弾を一人で全部処理し:
Yeah. Even though her movements looked slow, there was no waste at all.
She handled every stray shot heading toward the audience by herself.
m920189.ああっ、手が勝手に財布からおひねりを！: Ah! My hands are moving on their own, pulling out tips!
m920189.あっ、あははは……照れちゃいますね。: Ah, ahaha... You're making me blush.
m920189.あっ、シロガネさんお疲れ様です！\n今回の売上すっごいことになってますよ！\n配:
Oh, Shirogane! Good work!
The sales from this event are incredible!
I've already transferred your cut to your account!
m920189.あの、姫様、これは違くて──そう！\n鬼刃衆の、鬼刃姫様のためを思って──:
Um, Your Highness, that's a misunderstanding── I mean!
I was doing it for the good of the Kibahime Corps, for you!
m920189.あの亜神たち、素直でおもしろいのー。: Those Demigods are so straightforward and amusing.
m920189.あはは！ でも本当に頑張ってたね。\n最初パレードの司会をやるって言い出したとき:
Ahaha! But you really did try.
I was a little worried when you first volunteered to be the host, but it turns out I was worrying for nothing.
m920189.ありがとうね、ソーマちゃん。\nわざわざ海まで出向いてくれて。:
Thank you, Soma-chan.
I appreciate you making the trip all the way to the sea.
m920189.あるときは巫女、あるときは美人女将。\n最近は家事もメキメキと上達しています。\:
Sometimes a shrine maiden, sometimes a beautiful innkeeper.
Lately, she's been getting really good at housework too.
A long-standing veteran archer who has supported the Kingdom for years, Soma!
m920189.いえ、申し出はありがたいのですが、\nどちらもお断りさせていただきます。: No, I appreciate the offer, but I'll have to decline both.
m920189.いえいえ、深海の皆さんには、\nいつもお世話になっていますから。\n何かあればい:
Oh, please. The people of the Deep Sea
have always been so kind to us.
Feel free to call on us anytime you need anything.
m920189.うぇーす、分かってっすよー。\nお仕事ちゃんとしますってばー。:
Yeah, yeah, I get it.
I'll do my job properly, okay?
m920189.うっす、よっす、こんちゃーっす。\n鬼刃忍シロガネ、現着しやしたー。:
Yo, yo, what's up.
Shirogane of the Kiba Clan has arrived.
m920189.う～ん、爽やかっすねぇ。\n次もこうだと良いんすけど。: Huh… that's refreshing… Hope we can keep this vibe.
m920189.ええ、王国闘兵パレードで各地を巡りましたが、\nどうにも私たちは民草に避けられて:
Yes. We've been touring various regions for the Kingdom Fighting Soldier Parade,
but I can't shake the feeling that the common folk are avoiding us.
m920189.えー、これで王国闘兵パレード終了となります。: And that concludes the Kingdom's Warrior Parade!
m920189.えー、仲良きことは美しきかな。\n正解は全員一着、全員一着です。:
Well, a harmonious bond is a beautiful thing.
The correct answer is: everyone comes in first! Everyone!
m920189.えー、自分いつも真面目んやってっすよー。: Ehh, I'm always serious about my work, you know.
m920189.え！？ えっと、よく食べて、よく眠る。\nあとは……妹のマッサージ、でしょうか？:
E-eh? Well, eat well and sleep well.
And then… maybe my little sister's massages?
m920189.お、おう……うむ、ありがたく思えよ。: O-Oh... right. I'll take that as a thank you.
m920189.おい、見たかあの嬢ちゃん。: Hey, did you see that girl?
m920189.おい言うなそれを！？: Hey, don't say that out loud!
m920189.おっと、紹介が遅れちゃったね。\nこの子は鬼刃衆の一人、シロガネ。\nセツナやタ:
Oh, I'm sorry for the late introduction.
This is Shirogane, one of the Kiba Clan.
She's a junior to Setsuna and Tachibana.
m920189.おつかれシロガネ、よく頑張ったね。: Good job, Shirogane. You did great.
m920189.おーっと聞き捨てならないねー。\n竜に力では及ばないかもしれないけど、\nボクの:
Oh, that's quite a claim, isn't it?
My dragon might not match yours in power,
but my beloved horse is the best, no matter who you ask~?
m920189.お主たちは高貴すぎて近寄り難いのよ、\nいわゆる、高嶺の花とかいうやつであるな。:
You are simply too noble for them to approach easily.
They are what you might call "flowers on a high cliff."
That is a charm in itself, and not a bad thing.
m920189.お嫁さんなら仕方ないな。: If she wants to be a bride, I guess that's that.
m920189.お年寄りからのおひねり総額王国第一位。\nみんなの可愛い孫娘、踊り子シャルキー！:
The recipient of the highest total in tips from the elderly in the entire Kingdom.
Everyone's adorable granddaughter, the dancer Sharqi!
m920189.ここでディーネさんには特別に、\n王国在住の女の子からお手紙を預かっています。\:
We have a special letter for Dine from a girl living in the Kingdom.
It asks, "How do I get as big as you?"
m920189.こちらこそ、良い勉強になりました。\nベテランに褒められるのは嬉しいですね。:
The feeling is mutual. I learned a lot from this.
It's nice to be praised by a veteran.
m920189.この場の主役は誰なのか、\n上に乗ってるお前らじゃい。\nそんなツッコミは野暮で:
The star of this stage isn't the one riding on top,
it's the one below.
But that kind of quip would be quite rude, wouldn't it?
m920189.これが摸擬戦の効果ですか……民草からの畏敬が、\n少しずつ敬愛へと移り変わってい: So this is the effect of the mock battle... I can feel the people's awe slowly turning into admiration.
m920189.これは……師の顔に泥は塗れませんね。: I can't let my master's reputation be tarnished.
m920189.これもエンジュさんの助言のおかげですわね。: This is all thanks to Enju's advice, of course.
m920189.これよりこの三名を中心としました、\nパレード行進及び摸擬戦演武を始めます。:
We will now begin the parade march and simulated battle,
featuring these three.
m920189.ご覧の王国闘兵パレードは、\n王国商人会の提供でお送りします。:
This Kingdom Warrior Parade is
brought to you by the Kingdom Merchants' Guild.
m920189.ご観覧中の皆様につきましては、\n摸擬戦への参加、乱入は自由となっております。\:
To those watching,
you are free to join or interrupt the simulated battle.
If you have the skills, please feel free to participate.
m920189.さ、次行きましょう次。: Alright, let's head to the next one.
m920189.さて、王国闘兵パレードもいよいよ大詰め。\n次の舞台は、終点の王城前庭園となりま:
Now, the Kingdom Fighting Soldier Parade is reaching its climax.
The next stage is the royal palace's front garden, the final destination.
m920189.じゃっ、このまま遠乗りに行かない？\nみんなでウイニングランってことでさ！:
Hey, how about we go for a long ride?
A victory lap for all of us!
m920189.すごいですねシロガネさん！\n見事な司会進行役でしたよ！:
That was amazing, Shirogane!
You did a wonderful job emceeing!
m920189.そうですね、観客席にも力自慢さんがたくさんです。\n技どうこうは、あまり期待され:
That's true. There are plenty of strong types in the audience.
I don't think they're expecting much in terms of technique.
m920189.そりゃあ、もちろん来るに決まってるじゃーん！\n人気闘兵は私たちにとっても大切な:
Of course I'm coming!
The popular warriors are precious memories for us too!
m920189.それでは摸擬戦演武、始まります。: Then, let's begin the simulated battle.
m920189.それでは摸擬戦演武、開始でーす。\nどうか不殺だけは守ってくださいね。:
Then the mock-battle demonstration begins.
Please, just make sure you don't kill anyone.
m920189.それに加えて美しく聞き取りやすい、よく通る声。\nさすが鬼刃衆、ユニークな人材に:
And to top it all off, she has a beautiful, clear voice that carries perfectly.
As befitting the Kibahime, they never run out of unique talent.
m920189.それはこちらの台詞だな、妙道よ。\n相変わらずお前の辛気臭い顔には気が滅入る。\:
That's what I should be asking you, Miaodao.
Your gloomy face is as depressing as ever.
How about you retreat to the Immortal Realm, like you used to?
m920189.それを言うならエメルダさんたちもですわ。\nあの精密射撃は人馬一体と言う他ありま:
If you're going to say that, you must admit the same about you, Emelda.
That precision shooting was a perfect example of man and beast as one.
m920189.そんなものは決まっておるとも。\nこの国の人間は祝事の度に摸擬戦をする、\n摸擬:
The answer is already set in stone.
The people of this country hold mock battles for every celebration.
They are a gathering of mock battle enthusiasts, you see?
m920189.ただいまより、鬼刃衆ぷれぜんつ。\n王国闘兵パレードを開催いたします。:
Now, presented by the Kiba Clan.
Welcome to the Kingdom Warrior Parade.
m920189.ったく、こういうのはガラじゃねぇんだけどな。: Damn, this isn't really my style.
m920189.でもまあ、あと五か所回るんですっけ。\nお客さんにパレードを楽しんでもらえるよう:
But anyway, I think we have five more stops, right?
I'll do my best to make the parade enjoyable for the audience,
living up to my status as a member of the Kibahime.
m920189.とうとうこの日が来ましたわね。\n私の愛騎が最も優れたる騎竜であると、\n全世界:
So, the day has finally come.
The day when the world will know that my beloved mount is the finest of all riding dragons…!
m920189.とりあえず全員一発殴ってみれば良い。: Just hit everyone once to start.
m920189.どうも、いつも応援ありがとうございます。: Hello. Thank you all for your continued support.
m920189.なおキャリー選手は斜行のため失格とします。: And the carrier will be disqualified for taking a diagonal route.
m920189.なるほど、砂漠の民には強者が揃っているらしい。: I see. The desert people certainly have their share of strong fighters.
m920189.なるほど一考の余地がありますね。\n人の子よ、一戦お相手願えますか？:
I see. That is worth considering.
Child of man, would you be my sparring partner?
m920189.ね、年季が違いすぎんだろ……。: G-guy, the power gap is way too big…
m920189.はいはい、さっさと次行くっすよ。: Alright, alright, let's hurry along to the next one.
m920189.はっ、神仙郷の優等生に何ができる。\n公衆の面前で吠え面かいても知らぬぞ？:
Hah. What can the Immortal Realm's honor student do?
Barking up a storm in public? I don't care.
m920189.ふはははは！ 負けた！ 盛大に負けたぞ！\nこれほどまでに清々しい気分は久しぶり:
Fuhahaha! I lost! I lost spectacularly!
It's been a while since I felt this refreshed!
m920189.ふふ、私も二人と同意見ですわ。\nそれでは早速、参りましょうか。:
Hehe, I agree with the two of you.
Then shall we set off at once?
m920189.ふむ、我々の間に割って入るとは中々やるな。: Hmph. Interfering in our dispute. Not bad.
m920189.ほう、貴方のような女にも、\n流す涙が残っていたのですね。:
I see. Even a woman like you
still has tears left to shed.
m920189.まあ、男性ファンたちのために、\n深くは追及しないでおきましょう。:
Well, for the sake of her male fans,
let's not press the issue any further.
m920189.まずご紹介するのは年季が違うこの男。\n彼に師事を求める若者は後を絶ちません。\:
First up is a man with a wealth of experience.
Young warriors seeking his tutelage never stop coming.
The veteran of the desert nation, Hashim!
m920189.まずはこの方、一目で分かるぞダイナマイトボディ。\n王国の誇る鉄壁の二枚看板が一:
First up, a dynamite body you can see at a glance.
One of the Kingdom's proud iron walls, the Iron-Armed Maiden, Dine!
m920189.もうちょっとやる気が表情に出ないかな？: I wish you'd show a bit more enthusiasm on your face.
m920189.もう二度とやりたくないっす。: I never want to do that again.
m920189.やかましい！ 防御力を上げて出直せ！: You're so loud! Boost your defense and get back in line!
m920189.よほど良い師に恵まれたとお見受けします。\nどうです、神仙郷に来る気はありません:
It appears you have been blessed with an excellent master.
Would you consider coming to the Immortal Realm?
m920189.れでぃーすえーんじぇんとるめーん。\n皆様大変長らくお待たせいたしました。:
Ladies and gentlemen.
Thank you all for your patience.
m920189.アスラハー！ お前もマッサージだ！: Aslaha~! You're getting a massage too!
m920189.アラン様やメシナ様って、\nもっと雲の上のお方かと思っていたけど、\n案外親しみ:
I thought Aran and Meshina were people far above us,
but they're actually quite approachable!
m920189.イーファの竜、凄い迫力だったなー！: Yipha's dragon had such amazing presence!
m920189.クールな弓騎兵は多くを語ることなく、\n今日も神業を披露してくれることでしょう。:
The cool archer-cavalryman speaks little,
but is sure to display divine skill today, as well.
The gentle elder sister of the beautiful sisters, Emelda!
m920189.シロガネが成長してくれてあても嬉し──: I'm glad to see you growing, Shirogane, it makes me so happy──
m920189.シロガネさん、もしかして、\n摸擬戦演武の結果予想の胴元してたこと、\n鬼刃姫様: Shirogane, did you not tell Kibahime that you were the house for the mock battle predictions?
m920189.シロガネはやればできる子なんだけど、\nやる気にムラがあるのが難点なんだよね。\:
Shirogane can do amazing things when she tries,
but her motivation is all over the place.
If she could just be like this all the time, I could really count on her.
m920189.ディーナさんには叡智の園からのお便りです。\n『物理法則って知ってます？』とのこ:
Dina has a message from the Garden of Wisdom.
They ask, "Do you know what the laws of physics are?"
m920189.ディーネさん、ありがとうございます。\nそれでは続けまして、妹さんのご登場です。:
Thank you, Dine.
Now, let's continue with the little sister's appearance.
A sight that makes you doubt your eyes, the super-strong girl, Dina!
m920189.ト、トトノさん！？ その話はまた後で！: T-Totono-san?! We can talk about that later!
m920189.トラム様に恥じぬ武芸をお披露目しましょう。: I shall demonstrate martial arts worthy of Lord Tram.
m920189.ハシムの弟子か……戦士として手合わせ願いたい。: A disciple of Hashim... I'd like to test my skills against you.
m920189.ファンファーレの準備を、間もなく各騎出走です。: Prepare the fanfare. The riders will take the field shortly.
m920189.フリアさんの相棒もとっても速かったよ？: Fria's partner was incredibly fast too, wasn't it?
m920189.一度拳を交わせば強敵と書いて親友と呼ぶ、\nそんな特殊な仕組みの中でこの国は回っ:
In this country, once you exchange blows, a strong enemy is written as a close friend.
That is the peculiar mechanism by which this nation runs.
Fuhaha, you will surely gain a hundred friends.
m920189.今回のパレードの司会役をしてもらうんだけど……\nほらシロガネ、大事なお役目なん:
I'm going to have her host this parade, but...
Come on, Shirogane. It's an important role, so act professional.
m920189.何やら分かり合えたようですね。\n誰のお嫁さんとは言っていない割に、\n特定個人:
I sense you two have reached a mutual understanding.
You haven't specified whose bride she wants to be,
but there seems to be an unspoken consensus on a specific individual.
m920189.冷血なお前よりは人心に理解があってな。: You understand people better than a cold-blooded creature like you.
m920189.出ねーもんは出ねーっすね。: If it's not there, it's not there.
m920189.別に気に病むことはあるまい、\n嫌われておるわけではなかろう。:
There is no need to worry about it.
They are not hating you.
m920189.各々がオンリーワンでナンバーワン。\n種族を超えた絆に順位を付けようというのが、:
Each of you is a one-of-a-kind, number-one.
Perhaps it was a mistake to try and rank the bonds that transcend species in the first place.
m920189.大丈夫、私がマッサージする！: Don't worry, I'll give you a massage!
m920189.天界からはあの男の参戦です。\nアピールポイントを訊ねられ彼は言いました。\n『:
From the heavens, we have this man joining in.
When asked for his selling point, he said,
"Please support the Tram faith." The Hawk-Winged Birdman Soldier!
m920189.天界から伝説がやって来た。\n今日も皆様に正義をお届けします。\n放浪の聖騎兵、:
A legend has descended from the heavens.
Today, as always, I shall deliver justice to you all.
The wandering holy cavalry, Fria!
m920189.奇人変人の巣窟とはよく言ったもんだ。\nまっ、おかげで大分やりやすかったがね。:
A den of eccentrics, indeed.
Still, it made things a lot easier for me.
m920189.待て待て、あんな堅苦しい場所はやめておけ。\nそれよりも私と武の極みを目指そうで:
Hold on, hold on. Stay away from such a stuffy place.
Instead, let's pursue the ultimate in martial arts with me.
m920189.忙しない山賊頭を、支えるあいつはいぶし銀。\nワイルドな見た目の割に常識人、バァ:
The one who supports the frenzied bandit chieftain is a hidden gem.
Despite his wild appearance, he's a man of common sense, Bergan!
m920189.暑苦し──ではなく、摸擬戦演武、開始です。: Not sweltering… it's a mock-battle showcase, begin!
m920189.極めて悪い仙人がどの口で節度を謳うか。\n威圧的で上から目線なのは変わってないな:
For an extremely wicked immortal to preach about propriety.
You're still as intimidating and condescending as ever.
Honestly, I'm so terrified I'm about to cry.
m920189.正面から殴り合って最後に立ってたやつが優勝だー！: We fight head-on, and whoever is still standing wins!
m920189.熟練の技ってのを見せてやろうかねぇ。: Let me show you some seasoned skills.
m920189.熱砂の騎士、アスラハ！\n現在大絶賛お友達募集中！:
The Knight of the Scorching Sands, Aslaha!
Currently, she is enthusiastically recruiting new friends!
m920189.異論はもちろん大歓迎ですわ。\nそして決めようではありませんか！\nどの子がこの:
I welcome any objections, of course.
So let us settle it!
Which one of us is the true star of this stage!
m920189.知らないそうなので次に参ります。\n砂漠の国における最優の騎士とは誰か、\nそれ:
Apparently, she doesn't know. So, let's move on.
Who is the finest knight in the desert nation?
It is undoubtedly her, and no one else.
m920189.砂漠の国からは二人目の刺客です。\n日に焼けた小麦色の肌が魅惑の才女、アサル！\:
Our second assassin from the desert nation.
Her sun-kissed, wheat-colored skin is a charm in itself. The talented Asar!
She is a disciple of Mr. Hashim.
m920189.確かに……ちょっとはしゃぎすぎましたかね？: I suppose… I did get a bit carried away, didn't I?
m920189.私たちが亜神だからとも考えましたが、\nトラムさんやヘカティエさんは違うご様子。:
I considered whether it was because we are Demigods,
but Tram and Hecatie don't seem to face the same issue.
Perhaps there is something we are doing wrong…
m920189.私の将来の夢はお嫁さんなので。: My dream for the future is to become a bride.
m920189.私も少し、本気を出してみますわ。: I will try to show a bit of my true strength as well.
m920189.竜に乗って大砲ぶっ放せばそりゃ強い。\nこれが貴族の戦い方ですわ、とは彼女の談。:
Riding a dragon and blasting away with cannons is certainly powerful.
That's how the nobles fight, she says.
The purple wind that sweeps the battlefield, Yipha!
m920189.聞け者共！ これよりこの場のルールを説明する！: Listen up, you lot! I will now explain the rules of this arena!
m920189.観客席の皆さん！\n最後の摸擬戦演武を開始しますが！\n身の安全はご自身でお守り:
Everyone in the stands!
We are about to begin the final mock battle exhibition!
Please watch out for your own safety!
m920189.貴方こそ邪仙郷に戻って……ああ、すみません。\n確か十天君から追放され居場所がな:
You should return to the Demonic Realm… Ah, forgive me.
I recall you were expelled by the Ten Heavens and have nowhere to go.
Please conduct yourself with propriety while in the Kingdom's army.
m920189.貴方ならキョンシーでありながら、\n仙人の道を歩めるかもしれません。:
You might be able to walk the path of an immortal,
even as a jiangshi.
m920189.賛成、かな。話したいこと、いっぱいあるから。: I'm in. I have so much I want to talk about.
m920189.遅いよシロガネ！ もうみんな待ってるよ！: You're late, Shirogane! Everyone's been waiting for you!
m920189.馬鹿言うんじゃない、美しき姉妹愛を汚すな。: Don't be ridiculous. You're defiling the beauty of sisterly love.
m920189.騎兵──それは戦場の花形。\nパワー・スピード・タクティクス、\n全てを兼ね備え:
Cavalry—the stars of the battlefield.
Power, speed, and tactics,
here are the riders who possess it all.
m920189.鳥人の威信を任せたぞ鷹翼のー！: I leave the birdman's honor to you, Hawk-Winged!
m920189.（いやいやいや、本気の亜神の相手とか無理無理無理）: (No no no, dealing with a serious Demigod is impossible, absolutely impossible.)
m920189.（なんだか少し、心配になる方ですね……）: (She seems like someone who might cause a little trouble...)

m920206.…………誅子様はああ言っていたけど、\n事情を話さないわけにもいかないだろう。:
...Chushi-sama said it that way, but
I can't just let things go unsaid.
m920206.……あの方はそんな人じゃない。\n確かに一度は大きく間違えてしまったけれど、\n:
……He is not that kind of person.
Yes, he made a grave mistake once,
but he will never abandon his people again.
m920206.……この武王大宴は、\n誅子様の名誉を回復するための、\nうってつけの機会だった:
……This Martial King's Grand Banquet was
the perfect opportunity to restore Shu Zi's honor.
m920206.……それだけ、武王の称号は特別なんです。\n特に前回の武王の名声は歴代でも際立っ:
……That is just how special the title of Martial King is.
In particular, the previous Martial King's reputation stands out among all who have held the title.
Even as a child, I often heard my father speak of him.
m920206.……それはこちらの台詞ですよ、姉弟子。\n一体どんな修羅場を潜ってきたんですか？: ...That's what I should be saying, senior sister. What kind of hell did you go through?
m920206.……亜神殿、丸くなったなぁ。: ...The Sub-Temple has become quite gentle, hasn't it.
m920206.……何の話だ、銀月の亜神よ。: ...What are you talking about, demigod of the Silver Moon?
m920206.……始まった割には誰も挑んで来ませんね。: ……For a start, no one is coming to challenge us.
m920206.……官民分離の原則を破り、\n華王、誅子を強引に出場者に捻じ込んだ。\n先に神聖:
……You violated the principle of separation between government and the people,
and forcibly shoved the Flower King, Shu Zi, into the lineup.
You are the ones who defiled the sacred Martial King's Grand Banquet first.
m920206.……我々としては他人事ではありませんが、\n王国としては大変な面倒に巻き込まれま:
……It is not a matter we can simply ignore,
but it seems the Kingdom has been dragged into a rather troublesome situation.
m920206.……改めて凄まじいのですね、王国の精鋭とは。\n予選とはいえ華の国の猛者たちがこ:
……Truly formidable. The Kingdom's elite.
Even in the preliminaries, the Flower Kingdom's warriors were so easily…….
m920206.……東天君、俺が必ずお前を救い出す。\nだからそれまで、もう少しだけ耐えてくれ。:
...Tenten, I will definitely save you.
So please, hold on a little longer.
m920206.……誅子が武王大宴に参加を表明した時点で、\n前回の武王を筆頭に古強者たちは国を:
……The moment Chushi declared her intention to participate in the Martial King's Grand Banquet,
the former Martial King and the other ancient powerhouses withdrew,
concerned for the fate of the nation.
What remained was a roster dominated by young warriors—
energetic, but lacking experience.
m920206.……誅子はあなたの嫌う人種かと思いましたが、\nここまで肩入れするとは意外ですね:
……I thought Chushi was one of the people you despise,
but I didn't expect you to take her side so strongly.
m920206.……赤い鳥人に、白い獣人？: ……A red bird-man and a white beast-man?
m920206.──いや、そこまでだ。決着はついた。\nよく吠えたが、その動かぬ足では戦えまい。:
──No, that's enough. The outcome is decided.
You barked loudly, but you can't fight with legs that won't move.
m920206.──いやぁ、お二人とも実に見事な腕前でしたねぇ！\nそれはそうと、武王の二番弟子: —My, my, you two put on quite the show! Now then, the Martial King's second disciple... could it be that...?
m920206.──この会場の参加者は粗方倒しましたかね。: ──We have defeated most of the participants in this venue.
m920206.──さあ、時間だ武人たちよ！\nこれより戦神コロッセウム・武王大宴！\nその決勝:
──Now then, it is time, warriors!
The War God Colosseum, the Martial King's Grand Banquet!
I hereby declare the opening of the finals!
m920206.──さあ、武王大宴も総仕上げだ！\n客席の貴様らも自由に参加して構わん！: —Now then, it is time for the grand finale of the War King Feast! You in the audience are free to join in as well!
m920206.──それで、\nどうしてこんなに険悪な雰囲気なんですか？:
──So then,
why is the atmosphere so tense?
m920206.──は、ははははっ！\nまだだ、まだ終わっていない！\n余はまだ戦える、そうだろ:
──Ha, ha, ha, ha!
Not yet, it's not over yet!
I can still fight, can't I, Prince?
m920206.──まさかの時に戦神コロッセウムの時間だァ！: —And just when you least expect it, it's time for the War God Colosseum!
m920206.──ッ、突風！？ いや、真空波か！: —! A gale? No, it's a vacuum wave!
m920206.──今日も王城は静かみたいですね。: The royal castle is quiet again today, isn't it?
m920206.──大変ですマレス様！ 会場に侵入者が！: ──It's urgent, Mares-sama! There are intruders in the venue!
m920206.──待たせたな王子、そして華の国の武人たちよ！: ──Sorry to keep you waiting, Prince, and warriors of the Flower Kingdom!
m920206.──死ぬ気で行くぞ、王子。: ──I will fight with my life, Prince.
m920206.──突然だがここでエキシビションマッチを執り行う！: —Suddenly, but we're holding an exhibition match right here!
m920206.──警告。どうやら挑戦者が決まったようです。: —Warning. It seems a challenger has been decided.
m920206.──！ ふふ、手合わせも懐かしいですね！: —! Heh, it's been a while since we've had a match!
m920206.ああ……はい、お察しの通り、\n私たちの師匠は前回の武王です。: Ah... yes, as you've guessed, our master is the previous Martial King.
m920206.あっ、ごめんなさいクーシン。続けて？: Oh, I'm sorry, Ku-Xin. Go ahead.
m920206.あなたは、いつぞやの……？: You are the one from that time...?

m920231.フィノーラ様、ごめんなさい。\n私の代で、技術を途絶えさせてしまって……。:
Lady Finora, I'm sorry.
I let the technology die out in my generation...
m920231.フィノーラ！？\nあ、あのっ、伝説の大魔法使いフィノーラですかぁ！？:
Finora!?
A-Are you the legendary great mage Finora!?
m920231.ユージェンの勘はよく当たりますし、\n私も周辺警戒を続けておきましょう。:
Yuugen's instincts are usually accurate,
so I'll continue monitoring the perimeter.
m920231.ラシュマシュ、やっぱ今日のエっちゃん変だよ。: Rashmash, E-chan is definitely acting weird today.
m920231.一度失敗したことを、無かったことにする。\nそんなの、後ろ向きすぎて美しくないじ: Erasing a failure as if it never happened. That's far too negative to be beautiful, don't you think?
m920231.不意にあなたが、\n空から降ってきた時には驚きましたよ。:
We were all surprised when you
suddenly descended from the sky.
m920231.不服そうね。\nでも、今あなたと殺し合いはしたくないの。\nだって、もっと楽しく:
You look like you're not convinced.
But I don't want to kill you right now.
After all, it seems like it could get a lot more interesting.
m920231.世界の滅びを退けた魔術師団。\nその最後の生き残りにして、\nいつかこの世界に蘇:
A mage corps that averted the world's destruction.
Its last survivor, and a great sorcerer destined to one day return to this world, and so on……
m920231.了解――って、ラシュマシュも戦うんだってば！\n行くよ、ディアスを倒した人間たち:
Understood――wait, Rashmash, are you fighting too?!
Let's go, you humans who defeated Dias!
m920231.事後報告を受けた彼女は激しく怒り狂いました。\nアクゴローからすれば、無二の親友:
When she was informed of this after the fact, she flew into a rage.
From Akugorou's perspective, it was as if we humans had stolen her one and only close friend and rival from her.
m920231.五郎左衛門よ、此処で会ったが千年目。\n昔日の約定、今こそ果たしてもらおうか。:
??? : Gorozaemon. It has been a thousand years since we last met.
It is time you honored the promise we made long ago.
m920231.今は救助が優先です、大人の私！\n周囲の魔物を排除します！:
First, we need to help her, my grown-up self!
I'll deal with the monsters around us!
m920231.仲良く遊んであげましょう。\nエンキドゥも随分と楽しそうだし。: Let's play nicely with them. Enkidu seems to be having quite a time of it, too.
m920231.伝説なんて尾ひれ背びれが付くものだろう？\n僕はただ、時の魔術を悪用する輩から、:
Legends always grow tails and fins, don't they?
I'm just a researcher from an organization dedicated to protecting the normal flow of time from those who would abuse time magic.
m920231.何か、お気に召しましたか？\nそれでは、私も最後の戦場に参ります。\n次に会うと:
Does that please you?
Well then, I shall join the final battle.
When we meet again, it will be in the underworld. Perhaps we can share a drink――
m920231.何か記憶がざわざわする……ってことは、\n無事にやりたいこと、やり遂げてきたのか: My memory is feeling a bit fuzzy…… Does that mean they managed to accomplish what they set out to, safely?
m920231.何のつもりだ、これは。\nここはいったいどこだ！？:
What is the meaning of this?
Where exactly are we?!
m920231.俺たちの間で賭けって言ったら決まってんだろ？\nもちろん、どっちがより人間を驚か:
When it comes to wagers between us, it's always the same, isn't it?
Of course, it's about who can startle humans the most!
m920231.僕が目覚める時――即ちタイムスリープ装置が破壊され、\n何者かが時空に干渉しよう: When I wake up—meaning, when the time-sleep device is destroyed and someone tries to interfere with spacetime—I left behind allies to help me, generation after generation.
m920231.僕は死ぬかもしれないが、\nその名前を追って、僕の親友の後継者が、\n必ずお前の:
I may die,
but my best friend's successor will track down that name
and come to crush your neck.
m920231.僕を襲撃した仮面のやつも、\n『時の破片』を集めているはず。\nたぶん距離が近付:
The masked one who ambushed me
must also be collecting "Fragments of Time."
He's probably getting closer.
m920231.元々、アクゴローは人間寄りの妖怪ではない。\n人間のために自分やザエモンが犠牲に:
Akugorou was never particularly human-oriented to begin with.
The idea that he or Zaemon would sacrifice themselves for the sake of humans was something he could never accept.
m920231.元々ザエモンとアクゴローは、\nアヤカシの王の座を懸け争った、\n好敵手にして親:
Originally, Zaemon and Akugorou were
rivals and close friends who competed
for the throne of the King of Ayakashi.
m920231.先祖伝来のーとか言ってたけど、\nさっきの機械兵団、君が整備してたんでしょ？\n:
You were saying it's something passed down through generations, right?
But you were the one maintaining that mech unit earlier, weren't you?
And there were some new models in there with a different design philosophy.
m920231.其方が入れ込むだけはある、か。: No wonder you're so obsessed with him.
m920231.其方にだけは馬鹿と言われたくないわ！: I hate being called a fool by you of all people!
m920231.北部城塞を突破した魔物も多数！\n現在、王国にも支援要請を――あ、あれ？: A large number of monsters have also breached the Northern Fortress! We're requesting reinforcements from the Kingdom――Wait, what is that?
m920231.北部戦線――人類の生存圏の、その先です。: What about the enemy's retreat route?
m920231.北部戦線近くの廃村ね……。\nこの音は――戦場の近く……？:
……Hah.
This looks like somewhere in the Northern Great Power.
m920231.千年戦争以前の、時の魔術の研究者……。: A researcher of time magic from before the Millennium War……
m920231.協力なんてした覚えはないぞ。: I have no memory of cooperating with you.
m920231.反省会は後にしましょう。\n悔やむことはいつでもできます。\n今は――敵の軍勢を: We can hold the postmortem later. There's always time to regret things. Right now――it's time to push back the enemy!
m920231.君たちは、武装集団のようだけど……。\n王国の正規軍か？\nならば、伝えなければ:
You look like an armed group……
Are you the Kingdom's regular army?
If so, there's something I need to tell you.
m920231.問答無用！\n話はぼこぼこにしてから聞きます！\n行けー！ 先祖伝来の機械兵団ー:
??? : No questions asked!
We'll hear you out after we've beaten you to a pulp!
Go! Ancestral mechanical legion!
m920231.問題ありません。\nなにしろ、すでに一度、実証済みですから。:
No problem.
After all, we have already proven it possible once.
--- scene: The Masked Man (battle, start) ---
m920231.問題は千年戦争終結後のことですね。\n神獣ヤマタノオロチが突如暴走を始めて、\n:
The problem arose after the Millennium War ended.
The Divine Beast Yamata no Orochi suddenly went berserk,
and the Eastern Kingdom faced a crisis of survival.
m920231.囁きかけるは魔なる甘言。\n諦めも決意も、すべてこの胸に抱きとめて、\n愛してあ:
I whisper sweet, demonic words.
Embracing both surrender and resolve within my heart,
I will love you, along with your fate.
m920231.大丈夫、こういう時には人手が必要でしょう？: Don't worry. We'll need the manpower when the time comes, won't we?
m920231.山ン本五郎左衛門がその身を楔にして、\nヤマタノオロチを封印したっていうあの話？: The story about Sanmoto Gorozaemon using his own body as a wedge to seal Yamata no Orochi?
m920231.己の無知をこうも堂々と……。\nうん、お嬢さんは将来、いい技術者になれるな。:
To display one's ignorance so boldly……
Yes, I think the young lady will make a fine engineer in the future.
m920231.幾度も繰り返して、ようやく成功しました。\nそれでは、未来へ帰りましょうか。:
Enkidu?: After countless attempts, I have finally succeeded.
Now, let us return to the future.
m920231.強要はしません。\nもとより、計画の内に、\nあなた方の関与は含まれていませんで:
I will not force you.
Besides, your involvement
was never part of the plan to begin with.
m920231.形のないものを形にする……？\n操作が可能な以上、不可能だとは言いませんが、\n:
Turning the formless into form……?
I can't say it's impossible, given that it can be manipulated, but was it an established technology in your era?
m920231.彼ら――あっ、さっきの王子たち？\n……んふふ、それはちょっと興味あるかも。:
Them――ah, the Princes from earlier?
……Mm-hmm, that might be a little interesting.
m920231.待ちなさい、王子君に手を出すのは許しませんよ。\nいくら東の国の伝説の大妖怪──:
Hold on, I won't allow you to lay a hand on the Prince.
No matter how legendary a great yokai you are from the Eastern Kingdom—Shinno Akugorou—
you can't take on this many heroes all at once.
m920231.待て待て、そう慌てんなよ悪五郎。\nここは昔みてぇに賭けで決めようぜ？:
Easy, easy, don't get so worked up, Akugorou.
Let's settle it with a wager, like we used to?
m920231.後にも先にもアクゴローだけであったな。\n英雄王を殴り飛ばし、ありったけの罵声を:
Akugorou was the only one to do such a thing, before or since.
She punched the Hero King, hurled every insult she had, and slammed a letter of severance on the Kingdom while flipping him off.
m920231.御名答、さすがは時の女神。: Enkidu?: Correct. As befits the Goddess of Time.
m920231.悲劇も、喜劇もね、\n前を向いて転がり落ちていくのが素敵なのよ。: Whether it's tragedy or comedy, it's lovely when you keep rolling forward, no matter what.
m920231.我々は王国の者です。\nいったい何があったのですか？:
We are of the Kingdom.
What happened here?
m920231.手伝ってくれるのか？\nありがたい、戦闘は僕の本職じゃないからね。:
You'll help us?
Thank you. Combat isn't really my forte, after all.
m920231.散乱した『時の破片』を探すにも、時間がかかる。\n僕が眠った後の世界のこと、君の:
It will take time to find the scattered "Fragments of Time."
Tell me about the world after I fell asleep, and about your family.
I'd like to hear all about it.
m920231.敵の撤退先については？: Enkidu has likely already used up the power to alter history.
m920231.敵は秘匿されたタイムスリープ装置を見つけ出し、\nほぼ一瞬で破壊し尽くし、\n『:
The enemy found the hidden time-sleep devices,
destroyed them almost instantly,
and stole the "Fragments of Time." They're skilled professionals.
m920231.敵兵の言うことなど信用できぬ！\n我が同胞たちよ、ここが死に場所だ！\n祖国のた:
We can't trust a word the enemy says!
My comrades, this is where we die!
For our homeland, cut down the enemy's heads!!
m920231.時の女神に干渉されず、\n世界による時空の修復も回避し、\n歴史のある一点のみを:
A method to rewrite a single point in history,
without interference from the Goddess of Time,
and avoiding the world's temporal restoration.
m920231.時の監視者フィノーラ。\n超古代文明の遺物たるその叡智、\nここで終わらせておき:
Finora, the Guardian of Time.
Let us put an end to the wisdom
of that ancient civilization's relic right here.
m920231.時の魔法が行使されたなら、\n私たちが感知できるはずです。何か、他の原因ですか？:
If any time magic were being used,
we should be able to sense it. Is there some other cause?
m920231.時の魔術の難しいところですよね。\nどうしても初歩の初歩が難しすぎるのです。: Time magic is tricky, isn't it? The very basics are always the hardest part.
m920231.時代がどうの、というのですか？\nその辺りは、さっぱり分かりませんが……。:
Something about the times?
I don't really understand that part……
m920231.時空の歪みぃ……？\n別に、風景が歪んだりしてないぜ？:
A spacetime distortion……?
But nothing looks distorted, does it?
m920231.時間遡行？\nあいつら正義の味方みたいな連中だよ？\n協力してくれるはずなくない:
Time travel?
Those guys are like the good guys, aren't they?
They'd never agree to that, would they?
m920231.最後に、聞かせてくれませんか？\nあなたはなぜ、そんなに死にたがっていたのですか:
May I ask you one last thing?
Why did you want to die so badly?
m920231.本隊は待機、精鋭に追わせて。\n北部城塞より\n北に向かうようなら追跡を打ち切っ: Hold the main force in reserve and send the elite units to pursue. If they head north of the Northern Fortress, you may cut off the pursuit.
m920231.案外乗り気なところ、好きよ？: I like that you're surprisingly eager.
m920231.次で決着を付ける。首を洗って待っておれ。: We will settle this next time. Wash your neck and wait.
m920231.次に会うときには謝っておけよ。\nこの件に関しては完全に汝が悪い。:
You should apologize the next time you see her.
You are completely in the wrong about this.
m920231.正確には、本来起きなかった戦闘が発生するような、\nほんの小さな乱れは生じました: To be precise, there were a few minor disturbances, such as battles that shouldn't have occurred, but those are just byproducts of the time travel.
m920231.歴史に影響を与えない、\n誰にもその変化を感じさせないような――: They were changes that would have no impact on history,
m920231.歴史を作り変えるために必要な要因を、\nひとつずつ、揃えているだけですよ。:
Enkidu?: I am merely gathering the necessary elements,
one by one, to rewrite history.
m920231.死兵ほど怖いものはないものね。: There is nothing more frightening than soldiers who have nothing to lose.
m920231.気を落とさないでください。\nここまで保たせることができたのが奇跡なんです。:
Don't lose heart.
Holding out this long was a miracle.
m920231.無意味ですよ、『時の破片』の力は、\n時の魔術とも、次元転移とも異なるものなので:
Enkidu?: It is futile. The power of the "Fragments of Time"
is distinct from both time magic and dimensional transfer.
m920231.無理でーす！\nこれは次元転移でも時空転移でもなくて――:
No way!
This isn't a dimensional shift or a spacetime shift――
m920231.王国の助力も得られたが、\n機械技術を扱える君の腕が必要で――:
I've secured the kingdom's assistance, but
I need your expertise in mechanical technology――
m920231.王子、『時の破片』を狙う襲撃者を野放しにはできません。\nこれは世界――いえ、す: Prince, we cannot leave the attackers targeting the "Fragments of Time" unchecked. This is a crisis for the world—no, for all of time.
m920231.王子、この周辺は時の流れが速くなっています。\nその分、兵の配置も普段より迅速に:
Prince, the flow of time is accelerated in this area.
That means we should be able to deploy our troops faster than usual.
Please give your orders with that in mind!
m920231.王子、一度城塞に退きましょう。\nフィノーラ、状況の説明をお願いできる？: Prince, let's withdraw to the fortress for now. Finora, could you brief us on the situation?
m920231.王子殿下、シビラ殿下！\nどうして戦場に……！？:
An abandoned village near the Northern Front…….
That sound is――near a battlefield……?
m920231.現在、仮面の騎士団、\n及びラシュマシュ、ズィズィーの手勢との戦闘中です！: We're currently engaged in combat with the Knights of the Mask, as well as Rashmash and Zizi's forces!
m920231.生きる、希望……戦う意志……。\nえい、ゆう……。:
The hope to live... the will to fight...
Courage...
m920231.生き残りというのも、ただ貧乏くじを引いて、\nあの洞窟で装置を守る役割を担っただ: As for being a "survivor," I simply drew the short straw and was tasked with guarding the device in that cave.
m920231.目的は、ただひとつ。\nこの時代、この場所に、\n『時の破片』を残していくこと。:
Enkidu?: My purpose is singular.
To leave the "Fragments of Time"
in this era, in this place.
m920231.眠り姫……？\nガラスケース……ああ、タイムスリープ装置のことか。:
Sleeping Beauty...?
Glass case... Ah, you mean the time-sleep device.
m920231.確実に死んでいるだろうな。\nだがあいつとは、ひとつの約束をしたんだ。:
They're definitely dead.
But I made a promise to them.
m920231.私……半人前で……。\n全部の技術を教わる前に、\n母も、おばあちゃんも亡くなっ:
I... I'm not good enough...
My mother and my grandmother both passed away
before I could learn everything from them...
m920231.私たちは、元通りの世界、\n元通りの時間に戻ってきました。: We have returned to the world as it was, and to the timeline as it was.
m920231.私たちは歪みの内部にいますから。\n時空というものは主観的なものなので、\n外か: We are inside the distortion. Since spacetime is subjective, from the outside, it would probably look like we're walking very fast.
m920231.端的に言えば、これを用いることで、\n過去や未来の事象を操作することが可能になる:
To put it bluntly, using this allows one to manipulate events in the past or future.
It could be called a disposable time machine.
m920231.簡単に言えば、この洞窟の外より、\n私たちはちょっとだけ早く\n歳を取っていると: Simply put, we are aging just a little faster than the world outside this cave, and――
m920231.結論から述べるなら、\n驚くほどに、何の変化もありません。:
To state the conclusion,
there are surprisingly no changes at all.
m920231.絶縁状って……な、何が原因だったんですか？: A letter of severance… W-what was the cause?
m920231.継承者とか、よくわからないですけど！\nぶっ殺す！ 死ね！ フィノーラ様に手を出:
Inheritor? I don't know what that means!
I'm going to kill you! Die! Don't you dare touch Finora-sama!
m920231.自分なりに、色々頑張ろうとしたのが分かる。\nだったら、そんなさ、\n泣きそうな:
I can tell you've been trying to do things your own way.
So I don't think you need to
look like you're about to cry.
m920231.良いでしょう。\n死にゆく者への餞別です。我が名は――:
Very well.
As a parting gift to the dying. My name is――
m920231.街の皆は屋内に避難を！\n王子、黒冠の魔物を退けましょう！:
Everyone in the town, take shelter indoors!
Prince, let's drive off the Black Crown monsters!
m920231.装置は破壊され、『時の破片』は周囲に散乱し、\n僕も危うく死ぬところだった。: The device was destroyed, the "Fragments of Time" scattered all over the place, and I nearly died in the process.
m920231.話を聞かせてください。\nこの時空の歪みを見れば、\nとんでもない事が起きている:
Please tell us what happened.
Looking at this temporal distortion,
it's clear something extraordinary is going on.
m920231.説得不能……まぁ、そうよね。\n王子、敵が来るわ。構えて！:
They're beyond reason…… Well, I suppose that's to be expected.
Prince, the enemy is coming. Get ready!
--- scene: The Beginning of a Story (battle, end) ---
m920231.誰が何を食べるって？\n悪食なのはラシュマシュの方でしょ。:
Who's going to eat anything?
You're the one with the bad eating habits, Rashmash.
m920231.調子に乗るでないぞ、五郎左衛門。\n今回の賭けは百歩、いや万歩譲って引き分けよ。:
Don't get cocky, Gorozaemon.
I'm allowing this wager to be a draw, giving you a hundred, no, ten thousand steps.
The match is postponed, but that does not mean I have forgiven you.
m920231.転移に巻き込まれる！\n全員離れるな！:
We're being swept into a teleport!
Everyone, stay close!
m920231.違和感……？\n敵が『時の破片』で時間に干渉しているということか？:
Unease……?
Are you suggesting the enemy is interfering with time using "Fragments of Time"?
m920231.遥かな過去、かつて絶望を抱いたあの時代に。: To a distant past, to that era once filled with despair.
m920231.長い付き合いになるでしょうし、\n第一印象は大事よ？\nちゃんと名乗ってあげまし:
We'll likely be dealing with each other for a while,
so first impressions matter, don't they?
Let's properly introduce ourselves.
m920231.関係あるものか、此方はこの時を千年待った。\nこの期に及んで約定を果たさぬという:
What does that have to do with anything? I have waited a thousand years for this moment.
If you refuse to honor the promise at this crucial juncture—
m920231.随分と高尚な偽名もあったものだ。\n自分に悲劇を重ねるなんて、\nお前もロマンと:
What a pretentious alias.
Piling tragedy onto yourself……
You're one who indulges in romance and yourself, aren't you?
m920231.雪崩……いや、ここは平野部ですから……。\n――ッ！！ 見えました！\n遠方より:
An avalanche... No, this is a plain...
—!! I see it!
A horde of monsters is approaching from afar!
m920231.面白い顔とかいうな！\nただ理解できてないだけだ！:
Don't call it a funny face!
I just don't understand it!
m920231.駆け抜けるは荒野の風。\nこの手に暗き熱情掲げ、\n殺してみせよう退屈なる世界！:
I am the wind that races across the wilderness.
Holding dark passion in my hands,
I shall slay this boring world!
m920231.魔力ではない、何か別の要因……？\n時間をもう一度、やり直させられているような…:
Not mana, but some other factor……?
It's as if time is being forced to restart……
m920231.黒冠の魔物の出現も、\n『時の破片』を狙った襲撃者の仕業だと？:
So the appearance of the Black Crown monsters
was also the work of the attackers targeting the "Shard of Time"?
m920231.黒冠の魔物も交じっています。\nどうやら、あの仮面の男が\nこの魔物たちを呼び寄:
There are Black Crown monsters mixed in.
It seems that masked man
was the one who summoned these monsters.
m920231.黙れ、此方の前であの男の話をするな。: Be quiet. Do not speak of that man in my presence.
m920231.（……何か、事情がありそうだな）: (...It looks like there's some backstory here.)
m920231.（あん？ どういうことだ？\n約束してたって言ってなかったか？）:
(Huh? What's going on?
